Project: Jomlatna - social e-commerce platform
Problem: The project would be addressing two main problems: 1. High selling costs for producers/importers at traditional points of retail (whether considering listing fees/rebate structures, product returns, or the logistical costs implied). 2. The lack of channels for consumers to pool their purchasing power when entering the market, which skews the balance of pricing power for products in the favor of retailers.
Solution: Create new channels for B2C commerce for producers/importers which mitigate the high selling costs associated with traditional points of retail ... while also offering consumers the ability to pool their purchasing power in order to obtain discounts on desired goods. While still in the idea stage, the social commerce model in mind would be akin to the model of Chinese online retailer pinduoduo - however localized to account for local sensibilities, market structures and consumer preferences. The pinduoduo model is centered around agricultural produce, which -while not impossible to replicate in Bahrain- does limit the product/market scope for the business. It is also catered around local Chinese social media behaviors. Yet the main takeaways from that model is that it is focused on products with recurring purchase potential, and that it adopts a tiered discount program depending on the volume purchased (giving consumers access to "wholesale" prices). So, and as to clarify the proposed solution, a social commerce platform would serve to: - Connect producers/importers directly to consumers, alleviating the selling costs associated with traditional retail. - Eliminate losses incurred by producers/importers due to product returns - control over inventory management is effectively handed back to them due to the fact that products only need to be dispatched upon confirmed purchases on the social commerce platform. - Allow consumers to pool their purchasing power (team purchasing) through a tiered discount structure to obtain products at fair value. Team purchasing: To further elaborate on the final point, the vision for the social commerce website is to have products listed which clearly specify the shelf price and the volume needed to be purchased in order to unlock a discount tier. It is then up to consumers to share their purchase order -or join an ongoing purchase order- to get a discount before a predetermined time is over.
Differentiation: I'm not aware of any competitors with the same model applied ... however the social commerce model in mind clearly differentiates itself from other online retailers that act as simple B2C intermediaries (Talabat/instashop, Jahez). It aims at providing both consumers and suppliers the ability to price products.
Impact: The main impact would be to give both suppliers and consumers a way to price products in a manner that is beneficial to both parties.
Keywords: social commerce platform, team purchasing, b2c commerce, discount tiers, producer direct

Project: D'Lending
Problem: Complex Loan Application Process Lengthy Onboarding Process Limited Accessibility Lack of Transparency
Solution: I'm aiming to make life easier for customers by using an Open Banking API-based Digital Lending platform that enriches the customer loan experience. I’m introducing the first-of-its-kind digital lending platform; the app will make the lending lifecycle easier than ever. The app provides customers with a seamless onboarding experience. By using the most innovative E-KYC technologies, customers can simply get onboarded to our platform and start applying for their first digital loan! Leveraging Open Banking Technology makes this product extraordinary. Customers can simply register and choose among the bank’s lists to provide their consent. The customer will be redirected to the banks’ apps to authorize access to his account data. The D’Lending app is built on very strong analytical tools that are far more accurate than our traditional analysis. The app will efficiently analyze everything about customers' financial data, their income, expenses, spending behavior, and their previous loan repayment history. With the D’Lending app, customers can get their first Digital Credit Passport that demonstrates their financial health in real-time. This will give the banks a meaningful transaction insight to offer customers a great loan deal! The last, and most amazing feature of the app is the unlimited and Instantaneous loan offers customers will get from different banks. Customers can simply accept the offer and then digitally sign the loan documents, or they can even negotiate with the bank. Upon the customer's acceptance of the loan offer, and upon validating their information. Customers can get their loans in a matter of minutes.
Differentiation: 1- Open Banking API Integration: Our platform leverages Open Banking API, which allows for secure and seamless integration with customers' bank accounts and financial data. This integration enables a faster and more accurate loan application process, as well as real-time verification of financial information. 2- Innovative E-KYC Technologies: using innovative E-KYC technologies that simplify the onboarding process. By utilizing advanced identity verification and authentication methods, we can offer customers a hassle-free and efficient way to verify their identity and get onboarded to the platform. 3- Seamless User Experience: the intuitive and user-friendly interface of our app, provides customers with a seamless and enjoyable loan application experience: simplified application form, personalized loan recommendations, and easy-to-understand loan terms and conditions. 4- Quick Loan Approval and Disbursement: The speed and efficiency of the loan approval and disbursement process. Our platform can leverage automation and real-time data analysis to expedite the decision-making process, customers can benefit from faster loan approvals and quicker access to funds compared to traditional lenders. 5- Enhanced Transparency and Communication: This includes providing customers with a clear understanding of loan terms, interest rates, fees, repayment schedules, and any other relevant information. Additionally, our platform provides customer support channels and responsiveness to inquiries or concerns 24/7. 6- Personalization and Customization: Our platform offers personalized loan recommendations based on individual financial needs and preferences. By tailoring loan options to each customer's unique circumstances, we can provide a more personalized and customer-centric lending experience. By focusing on these differentiators, we can position our digital lending platform as a unique and superior solution compared to our competitors.
Impact: If we are able to successfully deliver our proposition/solution to the market, it can have several positive impacts: 1- Enhanced Customer Experience: By providing a seamless onboarding experience, a simplified loan application process, and transparent loan terms, our platform can significantly improve the overall customer experience. project_name: Water cooling and heating using thermoelectric modules
text:
Project: Water cooling and heating using thermoelectric modules
Problem: To decrease electricity consumption significantly. To decrease costs associated with cooling and water heating methods existing today. To reduce E-waste. To improve the general public's wellbeing and quality of life.
Solution: We are not just theorizing. We have a working concept prototype that demonstrates the effectiveness of our solution. Our goal is not only to help the general public to save on the electricity bill but also to contribute to a greener, quieter, and healthier environment. Conventional household water heating and cooling solutions have long been a source of multiple issues, including high electricity consumption, expensive operational costs, a significant contribution to e-waste, and a negative impact on the quality of life due to their inconvenient nature, where the conventional devices, do not have an efficient temperature control user interface. However, our innovative solution, can effectively address these problems. Firstly, our Peltier based device offers a more energy-efficient solution, reducing the high power consumption associated with traditional systems. We are forecasting a power saving of up to 91% compared to traditional heating and cooling systems. Our concept prototype is optimized for the temperature ranges typical in household water heating and cooling applications. Secondly, our solution promises to reduce operational costs significantly as it requires minimal maintenance compared to traditional compressor-based devices. Due to our device’s solid-state design, it has fewer moving parts, reducing the likelihood of mechanical failure. This longevity contributes to reducing the overall e-waste produced by frequent replacement of traditional heating and cooling devices. Lastly, for the public's wellbeing. Our device operates quietly, free from the noise pollution associated with conventional systems. Also, it does not rely on harmful refrigerants, contributing to a safer and healthier living environments.
Differentiation: Conventional competitors in the water heating and cooling industry typically offer separate devices for each function, lacking the convenience of a combined 2-in-1 solution. (homeowners typically buy and install water heaters and water chillers separately) In rare cases where such combined units do exist, they often employ inefficient methods, such as repurposing household air conditioners by inserting their coils into water tanks. This approach poses significant hazards and potential water contamination risks, compromising both safety and water quality. Conventional water heaters typically have shorter warranties – often half the length of tankless heaters – because when a conventional water heater's tank breaks it is irreplaceable. The storage tank is susceptible to multiple corrosive factors, such as oxidization. Whereas, our device can be easily maintained, longer warranties can be obtained, and the components are easily replaceable independently and cost effectively. Conventional water coolers/chillers, typically consume a significant amount of power, ranging from 1,000 to 3,500 watts, depending on their capacity and size. In contrast, our Peltier-based water cooler/heater operates with an estimated low power consumption of 300 to 500 watts, depending on the size of the application.
Impact: If we were able to deliver our proposition/solution of Peltier-based water cooling and heating devices to the market, it would have a significant impact. Here's an overview of the potential outcomes: Cost Savings: By offering an energy-efficient alternative to conventional cooling and heating methods, customers would experience substantial savings in their electricity bills. The low power consumption of Peltier devices compared to traditional devices means reduced energy expenditure, benefiting both households and businesses. Environmental Benefits: Our Peltier-based solution eliminates the need for harmful refrigerants commonly found in conventional cooling systems. This significantly reduces the environmental impact, as harmful emissions and ozone depletion are minimized. By offering an eco-friendly option, we contribute to a greener and more sustainable future. Convenience and User-Friendliness: The easy user interface of our Peltier-based water cooler and heater allows customers to control the temperature of their main water supply from inside their homes. This eliminates the inconvenience of having to manually adjust rooftop heaters or coolers, providing added comfort and convenience to users. Versatility and Efficiency: Offering a 2-in-1 cooling and heating device fills the gap in the market where separate cooling and heating devices are sold. This versatility ensures customers have a comprehensive solution for year-round temperature control, eliminating the need for multiple devices. Furthermore, the efficiency of Peltier devices ensures optimal performance and reduces energy waste. Market Differentiation: By introducing an innovative and efficient solution to the market, we would establish a unique selling proposition. This differentiation would allow us to capture the attention of customers seeking cost-effective, environmentally friendly, and user-friendly water cooling and heating solutions. Overall, delivering our Peltier-based water cooler and heater solution to the market would lead to substantial positive impacts, including cost savings for customers, environmental benefits, enhanced user experience, and market differentiation. It positions us as leaders in the industry, addressing the growing demand for energy-efficient and sustainable solutions.
Keywords: peltier, water cooling, water heating, energy efficient, e-waste

Project: The Nail Bar
Problem: Current nail salons overlook the importance of a holistic aesthetic experience, often compromising on ambiance, customization, and the use of environmentally-friendly, non-toxic products. Customers are seeking a nail care service that prioritizes not only the beauty of their nails but also their overall well-being and the environment.
Solution: At "The Nail Bar", we're not just redefining nail care; we're transforming the entire salon experience. Here's how: Ambiance & Experience: Understanding the importance of environment in relaxation and self-care, The Nail Bar is designed to be an oasis. From the lighting to the decor, every element is meticulously chosen to provide a calming and upscale atmosphere. Our spaces aren't just about getting a service done; they're about enjoying the time spent during the process. Gentle, calming music, aromatic diffusers, and comfortable seating ensure that our customers begin to relax the moment they step in. Personalized Nail Artistry: Gone are the days of choosing from a limited set of designs. Our trained nail artists conduct a brief consultation for every client, discussing not just colors but themes, inspirations, and personal stories. This approach ensures that every nail design is as unique as our client's fingerprint. We also continuously update our skills and techniques, ensuring we're on top of the latest global trends. Eco-friendly & Safe Products: Sustainability isn’t an afterthought; it’s integrated into our core ethos. We strictly use products that are non-toxic and environmentally friendly. We prioritize brands that have cruelty-free testing policies, use organic ingredients, and package responsibly. This ensures that our clients aren't exposed to harmful chemicals, and their choices at our salon are eco-conscious. Hygiene & Safety Standards: We understand that health and safety concerns, especially post-pandemic, are paramount. At The Nail Bar, we adopt a rigorous sanitation protocol. Every tool is sanitized after use, workstations are cleaned regularly, and our staff is trained to maintain the highest hygiene standards. We also provide personal kits for regular clients, ensuring tools used on them are exclusive to them. Community Building & Education: Apart from our services, we aim to create a community. Hosting monthly nail art workshops, discussions on sustainable beauty, and self-care sessions, we ensure that our clients are not just customers but members of the 'The Nail Bar' family. We also take pride in educating our clients about the products we use, why we use them, and how they can make sustainable beauty choices outside our salon too. In essence, The Nail Bar isn't just a place to get your nails done. It's a haven for those who believe self-care is a holistic experience that should be personal, safe, and environmentally responsible. We're offering an amalgamation of beauty, wellness, and community.
Differentiation: Exceptional Professionalism: At the core of The Nail Bar is our top-notch service provided by professionally trained and highly skilled employees. While competitors might have experienced staff, our rigorous training regimen ensures consistent, high-quality service, setting a benchmark in the industry. Exclusive Product Selection: Venturing beyond the standard offerings found in many Bahraini nail salons, The Nail Bar introduces unique products previously unavailable in the local market. Our distinct range not only ensures premium nail care but also establishes us as trendsetters, always ahead of the curve. Enhanced Salon Experience: Our ethos emphasizes not just nail care, but a holistic salon experience. Our unwavering focus on customer service, from greeting to farewell, ensures every patron feels valued, pampered, and indulged throughout their visit. Tech-Savvy Approach: Recognizing the importance of technology in today's world, The Nail Bar stands out with its integrated online presence. Our easy-to-use online booking system, detailed website, and web store cater to the modern, tech-savvy customer, offering not just convenience but also a wide range of unique products at their fingertips. Branded Merchandise: Further stamping our mark in the beauty landscape, our customized branded merchandise serves as a dual function: a token of our quality and a stylish accessory for our patrons. These items are not just souvenirs but symbols of belonging to the exclusive Nail Bar community. The Pop-Up Bar Advantage: Adding to our unique salon atmosphere is our pop-up bar stocked with a fridge. But we don't just offer any refreshments; we've partnered with local Bahraini vendors to provide a range of trendy, fresh, and nutritious meals and snacks. This initiative not only supports local businesses but ensures our patrons receive wholesome, delicious refreshments during their visit. In summary, while many salons offer nail care services, The Nail Bar redefines the experience through its unparalleled professionalism, unique product range, customer-centric approach, technological integration, exclusive merchandise, and a commitment to supporting local Bahraini vendors. It's not just about getting nails done; it's about immersing in a premium, uniquely Bahraini experience.
Impact: If The Nail Bar is successful in delivering its unique proposition to the market, the impact could be multifaceted, spanning business, cultural, and even societal realms: Elevating Beauty Standards in the Region: By introducing unique products and high-quality services previously not available in the Bahraini market, The Nail Bar has the potential to redefine and elevate beauty and grooming standards. This could inspire other businesses to up their game, resulting in a collective elevation of the beauty industry in the region. Boosting Local Economy: By partnering with local Bahraini vendors for the pop-up bar, The Nail Bar would be supporting local businesses, leading to mutual growth. This strengthens the local economy, fosters community relationships, and emphasizes the importance of local collaboration. Setting a Precedent in Customer Experience: With a keen focus on enhanced customer service and the integration of technology for ease of booking and shopping, The Nail Bar would set a benchmark for what clients should expect in terms of service. This could drive other businesses to improve their customer service and adopt technological enhancements. Promotion of Sustainable Beauty Practices: If The Nail Bar uses eco-friendly, sustainable, and non-toxic products, it would be championing sustainable beauty practices. This could influence customer choices, making them more eco-conscious and encouraging other businesses to adopt sustainable practices. Economic Impact: A successful Nail Bar, given its premium positioning, can contribute significantly to the economy, not just through its direct services but also via the ripple effect of supporting local vendors, creating jobs, and potentially even attracting tourists looking for unique beauty experiences. Creating Employment Opportunities: A thriving business means more job openings. From professionally trained nail technicians to customer service representatives and management roles, The Nail Bar could become a significant employer in the region. Fostering Cultural Exchange: The Nail Bar could become a hub for cultural exchange, where locals, expats, and tourists come together. This blend of cultures in a salon setting could lead to enriching discussions, shared beauty tips from different parts of the world, and a better understanding of global beauty trends. Brand Expansion and Franchising: If the model proves successful, it could pave the way for franchise opportunities, expanding the brand's reach and influence across the Gulf region and potentially even further. Inspiring Entrepreneurship: The success of The Nail Bar could serve as an inspirational case study for aspiring entrepreneurs in Bahrain and the wider region, showcasing that with the right blend of innovation, customer focus, and quality, one can carve out a unique niche in even established markets. In summary, the successful delivery of The Nail Bar's proposition has the potential to not just disrupt and elevate the beauty industry in Bahrain but also create positive ripple effects in the economy, society, and culture of the region.

It also gives wider reach across Bahrain, especially to the target group interested in booking hair and makeup appointments at a specific time and for a specific occasion at a price that suits their budget (whether the customer is a bride or has another occasion such as a wedding, graduation party, or other occasions), while providing joint offers between makeup artists and hairdressers so the customer can book each one separately or book two together. I also aspire for the app to be the starting point for every girl with a talent in makeup or hair, so she can start by creating a free account on the app and publishing her work with contact methods to give her the opportunity, as well as providing special discounts from Bahraini projects interested in hair and makeup to help her start her project in an easy way with simple steps that include creating an account and publishing photos of her work with contact methods. Then in the future, I aspire for this app to spread to include Saudi Arabia and Kuwait. Problem: Creative Photography for Corporates & Personal.
Solution: This is an initial draft of the concept, the concept will be refined and more details will be added to make sure that the experience for both content creators and event sponsors is seamless. – SORA! "Surah" is a content creation app for media enthusiasts. It is a way of providing corporates and personal businesses with high-quality content without the need for research, and without paying excessive fees for professional media companies or content creators. The app is a platform for media gurus to get quickly paid for practicing their passion, and for companies to get alternative media solutions without high expenditures. Overall, the concept of the app will be similar to the concept of the “best photo” contests that are popular on social media, but in a more organized and structured way that can be monetized by creators, and easily controlled and managed by corporates. The event sponsor (corporate or personal) can post an event, contest, or a requirement on the app where it will set the location, reward, and the type of content needed. The content creators will then visit the location, produce the content and upload it using a trackable code for the event. Open voting will be conducted to determine the best piece of content and then the best content creator with the highest votes will be rewarded by the event sponsor. A corporate vote will be worth more than a normal user’s vote, to make sure that corporates are having strong input into which content is selected. Voting will only be accepted by registered users and corporates. Voting will not have a fee and will be open. The ratio of the weight (users/corporate) of the voting will be determined in a later stage of this proposal. The app will target industries such as auto, events, tourism, real estate, apparel, food & beverage, and more. It will also support a casual content section, focusing on creative personal content. The fee for posting an event will be different from corporate to personal. The app will support various types of content such as photos, videos, and others. There will be a list of ranking for the most active content creators, and those content creators will be prioritized in the featured and “hot content” sections. Featured content creators will be the first to be recommended to corporates when they are sponsoring an event/contest. The currency on the app will not be in real-life money, but in points/gold that can be liquidated through an in-app wallet and then withdrawn as cash. This is a general concept of the app, more details will be added to ensure a safe and seamless user experience for both content creators and corporates. Project: TASLIH BAHRAIN
Problem: The problem to solve is the inconvenience and privacy concerns associated with traditional mobile repair services. Many customers hesitate to leave their smartphones and other devices at repair shops due to worries about their personal data privacy, potential tampering, and the inconvenience of going to a physical location. By offering a mobile repair service that comes to the customer's location, the application aims to address these concerns and provide a more convenient, secure, and customer-centric solution for mobile device repairs. Additionally, the application seeks to offer a one-stop platform where customers can not only book repairs but also purchase accessories for their devices, providing added value and convenience.
Solution: The proposed solution is a mobile application that offers on-demand mobile device repair services directly at the customer's location, along with a platform for purchasing accessories for their devices. On-Demand Repair Services: Customers download and install the mobile application on their smartphones. The application offers: Service Selection: Customers can select the type of repair service they need, such as screen replacement, battery replacement, camera repair, etc. Location and Scheduling: Customers input their location and select a convenient date and time for the repair visit. The application provides a list of available time slots. Real-time Tracking: Once the booking is confirmed, customers can track the technician's real-time location as they approach the customer's home. Technician Profile: Customers receive information about the assigned technician, including their experience and certifications. Secure Communication: The application ensures secure communication between the customer and the technician, allowing them to discuss repair details and concerns. Privacy and Security: Technicians are thoroughly vetted and trained to handle repairs professionally and with respect for customer privacy. Technicians are required to sign privacy agreements to ensure they handle devices and data responsibly. Mobile Repair Van: The application coordinates a mobile repair van equipped with tools and equipment necessary for various types of repairs. Technicians arrive in the mobile repair van, equipped to perform the repair at the customer's location. Repair Process: Upon arrival, the technician verifies the customer's identity and the device to be repaired. The technician performs the repair inside the van, ensuring the customer can witness the entire process. Customers can ask questions, learn about the repair process, and see that their data remains secure. Accessory Marketplace: The application includes an online marketplace where customers can browse and purchase accessories for their devices, such as cases, chargers, headphones, and more. Accessories are sourced from local stores The suggested mobile application offers customers looking for mobile device repairs and accessories a complete solution that blends convenience, security, and value by providing on-demand repair services at the customer's location and addressing privacy issues.
Differentiation: On-Site Privacy and Transparency, Trained and Certified Technicians, Real-Time Tracking and Communication, Comprehensive Accessory Marketplace, Customer Education and Empowerment, Clear Pricing Structure, Continuous Innovation
Impact: A significant change in how people perceive and engage with mobile device repairs would be prompted by the market launch of our privacy-focused mobile repair and accessory platform. The effects would be many-sided, beginning with the promise of increased privacy and security - the confidence that their personal information is safe during the repair process. This guarantee would increase users' trust and confidence, motivating them to proactively handle repair needs. Our on-site repair approach would also raise the bar for convenience by effortlessly blending into users' busy lives without sacrificing their privacy. We would encourage a greater understanding of consumers' gadgets and enable them to observe repairs firsthand, resulting in more informed choices and longer device lifespans. Our innovative approach to privacy-conscious repairs would set us apart from the competition and establish a distinctive brand identity that strongly appeals to consumers who value their privacy. Our success may have an indirect impact that changes the entire industry towards better privacy protection. In summary, our approach has the potential to revolutionize not only the repair sector but also consumer expectations for ease, privacy, and security.
Keywords: mobile repair, on-demand service, privacy protection, accessory marketplace, real-time tracking

project_name: Automated Spice Manufacturing and Dispensing Machine
text:
Project: Automated Spice Manufacturing and Dispensing Machine
Problem: Support for development
Solution: To Design a powerful vending machine containing the following features: 1. Create Spices/Masalas based on an unlimited number of recipes/combinations either locally hosted or retrievable from a server. 2. Do On-board Storage, processing and packaging, be it pure spices or a blend (also called Masala) and brand them according to the Owner of the recipe used. 3. Provide compensation to the recipe owner as a percentage of the selling price. 4. Encrypt each recipe to Protect the IP of each recipe creator/Owner. 5. Accept money in the locally prevalent currency or on-line payment in addition to accepting money by card. 6. Return money when transaction fails or on order cancellation. There will be Raw spices Stored in Airtight Containers in a Nitrogen Environment, to prevent oxidization and degradation. Initially when the reset button is pressed, the machine will be ready for the users to select the product. This state is the initial state of the design. After this the user will select the product to be dispensed. Entry is via Touch Screen, All Recipes Will be listed, can be searchable, these could be single ingredient or multiple ingredients Further there is a selection of how it is to be treated, and finally there are packing Instructions. This whole Process will be done without human intervention. The machine will first check whether the ingredients are available in the machine or not. When the desired amount is inserted, the machine will start processing in the following manner. Products will be dispensed in Quantities in multiples of 50 grams controlled by a processor which will send instructions to valves mounted at the bottom of each bottle as per recipes selected by users.
Differentiation: PROBLEM STATEMENT Definition : Spice – Single Ingredient / Minimal Processing, Masala – Combination of spices in varying proportions depending on recipe with additional processing Issues faced by stake-holders Consumers: It is difficult to get Pure and unadulterated spices/masalas in local markets, if they are processed locally, there is the danger of addition of harmful additives and unauthorized volume enhancers. Also in smaller brands, it is difficult to find them in the local market, so you do not get the quality and taste you are used to. Farmers: Have to depend on major Corporations, who have the necessary storage and distribution networks. They will decide where to sell, Farmers typically have very little possibility of Value Addition, since they have no connection with the market. Manufacturers: The Entry barriers are very high since you should have facilities for large Storage, Processing and Packaging plants. Since this is a fast moving product with very little differentiation among Brands, absence from any market is not an option, Large inventories have to be maintained. Additional issue with the supply-chain is, the time between production and final consumption, hence some additives are used, which further undermines the quality and taste. New Entrants, while they may have an edge over other manufactures in terms of taste and quality, will either have to raise large funds or grow organically, in which case, they will have to spend a lot of time, usually decades in building up customer base and resource outreach. OUR SOLUTION Using Technology and the Internet to remove almost the entire supply Chain, and with it, Barriers between the farmers, Chefs and Consumers and get them communicating directly. The consumer is King, and the creator of the fantastic flavours, making the blends that lead to the finest culinary delights, is the merchant prince, and Taste in the only factor that chooses the winner. Presenting a spice vending machine which will dispense spices in raw and processed form as per instructions stored on-line or pre-programmed and operated with the help of an on-board computer.
Impact: This will cause a major Disruption in the spice Business, completely levelling the playing field and empowering, small businesses and recipe creators to compete with the biggest names in the market Apart from procurement cost and one time transport, all other supply chain costs will vanish and the benefits could be passed on to the Farmers/Consumers The Carbon footprint will also reduce, With multiple companies supplying similar products albeit with subtle variations, simply uploading the recipe and packaging Instructions and Manufacturing the product at point of sale.
Keywords: spice vending machine, masala recipes, automated packaging, recipe encryption, supply chain disruption

Project: E-Recycling
Problem: I'm trying to set up a virtual system to recycle most of the Domestic and Industrial waste as the waste is increasing due to the urbanisation.
Solution: Our solution is divided into two stages. The initial step is to purchase plastic and metal waste from customers, who might be either household commercial or industrial sector. Domestic, commercial and industrial parties will be given recycling bags. Once the recycling bags are full, the customer can contact us via our app, and we will dispatch our drivers to collect the waste while also paying the client. Otherwise, the customer can ask us to send the waste money to a local charity in the recipient's name. After we collect the trash, it will be transported to our processing facility, where the metals will be sold to a local scrap firm. While the plastic materials will be recycled into tiny granules at our centre, they will be sold to local producers in Bahrain. When the first phase of the project is completed successfully, the second phase will begin. The second phase will incorporate additional recyclable items, such as e-waste.
Differentiation: We are developing an application via which we will stay in touch with our clients online, allowing them to reach us anytime they want. We will give free collection service of waste. In addition, the clients will be paid and their rubbish will be removed. Furthermore, in our facility, we will recycle plastic trash in order to reintroduce it to the market as a recyclable plastic product.
Impact: Our project's influence will enhance the recycling attitude in Bahrain society. It will also raise awareness of the importance of environmental stewardship. The recyclable garbage will lessen pollution in Bahrain since the majority of the waste will be recycled and repurposed. Our project will also lower the amount of rubbish placed in government landfills. The recycling centre will also help Bahrain achieve its 2030 aim of being a sustainable society.

Problem: We're not only tackling the challenge of disconnected healthcare systems in Bahrain and the broader GCC region, but we're also aiming to position Bahrain as a hub for the technology service sector. As patients transition between hospitals in Bahrain or from Bahrain to different GCC countries, crucial medical data often gets lost or delayed, resulting in fragmented care, unnecessary tests, treatment delays, and increased costs. For instance, when Mohanad's father is transferred, all his medical records, including diagnoses, treatment plans, and test results, are seamlessly accessible to healthcare providers in Saudi Arabia. This ensures continuity of care, eliminates redundant tests, and expedites treatment decisions, ultimately improving Mohanad's father's chances of recovery while alleviating stress and uncertainty for his family. Hence our software would act as a central hub where healthcare providers can securely access and share patient records, treatment plans, and other relevant information. This system promotes continuity of care and reduces the risk of errors that can occur during transitions between hospitals. Through features such as secure messaging, care coordination tools, and real-time updates, our platform facilitates efficient communication and collaboration among healthcare teams across the GCC region, ultimately improving patient outcomes and enhancing the overall quality of healthcare delivery.

Project: C.I.R.I.S. Comprehensive Intelligent Resource & Information System
Problem: In the healthcare industry, efficient staff scheduling, including the management of annual leave, unexpected absences, and the optimal allocation of personnel, stands as a critical operational challenge. On average, a hospital employs around 700-900 staff, this is only including doctors and nurses. The intricate balance of ensuring adequate staff coverage—preventing both understaffing, which can compromise patient care and safety, and overstaffing, which inflates operational costs—is compounded by the dynamic nature of healthcare demands. Implications of Inefficient Scheduling: 1. Patient Care and Safety: Understaffed wards can lead to increased patient wait times, decreased time per patient, and potentially higher rates of medical errors, directly impacting patient outcomes and satisfaction. 2. Staff Well-being and Morale: Inadequate scheduling can result in staff burnout, high turnover rates, and general dissatisfaction, further exacerbating staffing challenges and affecting the quality of care. 3. Addressing the Complexity of Scheduling: The challenge of scheduling in the healthcare sector is compounded by the number of staff involved and the complexity of their roles. For instance, managing the schedules of over 500 employees, including doctors who often find it difficult to take their leave due to scheduling conflicts, can be a daunting task. Problem: Mental health access is limited to those who can afford it. Most people don’t have access to a good therapist even in the most critical situations. On the other hand you may not be able to pay for therapy sessions consistently to get the support you very much need. Here is where an emotional healing journal comes into place teaching you how to get that support and validation through therapeutic writing allowing you to have full control of the situation in your most vulnerable states which restores the feeling of safety within you and you start feeling more calm and capable. ultimately, a healing journal is a powerful tool to alleviate suffering without creating financial strain for people in distress. it’s an expansion in the healing world to make healing available for everyone, anytime and anywhere as a healing journal can be provided digitally for even more access to individuals in need of healing no matter the barriers they may face with conventional therapy wether it’s time conflicts, waiting lists or finances.

Project: Bahrain Uniforms
Problem: When school uniforms are purchased in physical shops, several issues can arise. Additionally, purchasing uniforms in physical shops often entails higher costs, as retailers may include markups or additional fees. They may end up buying subpar or overpriced uniforms, leading to dissatisfaction and the need for frequent replacements. The app can provide a user-friendly interface for parents and students to select the required uniform items, choose the appropriate sizes, and make online payments. This eliminates the need for manual paperwork, reduces administrative burden, and ensures accuracy in uniform orders. Additionally, the app can offer features such as virtual try-on, where students can see how the uniform will look on them before making a purchase. It can also provide notifications and updates regarding uniform availability, delivery status, and any changes in uniform policies. By leveraging technology in this way, it can enhance efficiency, convenience, and overall satisfaction when it comes to school uniforms.

Project: CoAuthor
Problem: The current research community, particularly in the medical field, often faces challenges due to a disconnect between clinicians and academic researchers with complementary skillsets. We have observed that itâ€™s common for clinicians to encounter unique medical cases suitable for case reports or to generate innovative ideas for systematic reviews and original research. However, they often lack the necessary time, skills, or resources to transform these concepts into published works. This gap leads to a considerable loss of valuable insights that could otherwise significantly contribute to the advancement of medical research and public health in Bahrain. "CoAuthor" is a platform designed to bridge the existing gap in the medical research community by offering a collaborative space for researchers to share proposals and abstracts. By doing so, we facilitate connections with other researchers who have the time, expertise, and desire to collaborate on these projects. Our website caters to a range of needs, from data collection and manuscript writing to AUDIT and data analysis, providing a supportive environment for researchers to bring their research papers to life. In essence, our business is solving the problem of underutilized research potential by fostering collaborative partnerships that can lead to successful publications and advancements in the field of medicine that will raise the bar for the Bahraini jounrals among the rest.
Solution: CoAuthor is a user-friendly online platform tackles the issues addressed previously by offering several key functionalities. First, researchers can post their research proposals, abstracts or specific tasks they need help with. Our intelligent posting and matching system then connects them with other researchers who possess the necessary skills and experience. To ensure trust and credibility within the platform, CoAuthor implements a verification system for researchers. This verification process may involve checking academic credentials, affiliations, and references. Researchers will also be able to verify their identity through their ORCID or "Research Gate" accounts. CoAuthor will foster seamless collaboration by providing integrated features like data/document sharing, messaging, and task management. We also understand the importance of clear communication and dispute resolution. CoAuthor aims to establish clear guidelines for intellectual property (IP) rights and authorship to prevent disagreements. The platform will also offer resources and templates for collaboration agreements, ensuring all parties are aligned from the beginning. A reputation system will be put in place allow researchers to rate their collaborators, fostering accountability and building trust within the platform. We do not plan to stop at connecting researchers. We aim to empower them throughout the research lifecycle. By partnering with funding agencies and research institutions, CoAuthor can showcase promising collaborative projects to potential sponsors. Additionally, we will provide resources and guidance to researchers on navigating the grant application process, and there will be options for paid collaboration. CoAuthor also recognizes the challenges associated with publication. The platform will offer resources and guidance on academic writing, peer review, and journal selection. This could include access to writing guides, workshops, or partnerships with editorial services. By offering these comprehensive functionalities, CoAuthor empowers researchers and fosters a collaborative environment that streamlines the research process. Ultimately, this leads to more efficient project completion and potentially higher quality research outcomes.
Keywords: medical research collaboration, researcher platform, coauthor, academic publishing

Project: SILFA
Problem: In Bahrain, securing a loan often involves a tedious and confusing application process. Individuals must manually research and compare loan options across different banks, leading to several issues: Wasted Time: Contacting each bank individually to inquire about loans is time-consuming and inefficient. Missed Opportunities: Limited information can cause borrowers to miss out on the most suitable loan offer with the best interest rates and terms. Uninformed Decisions: Without clear comparisons of interest rates, installments, and repayment periods, it's difficult to choose the most favorable loan for their specific needs. My Fintech application idea tackles this problem by centralizing the loan application process and providing transparency. Users can submit applications to participant licensed Bahraini banks through a single platform. The app offers clear comparisons of loan options, empowering Bahrainis to make informed financial decisions and secure the most suitable loan for their needs.
Solution: Many people in Bahrain encounter challenges when applying for loans. They often struggle to find the best loan options, compare terms, and navigate the application process across multiple banks. Additionally, the lack of transparency can lead to confusion and delays. My fintech application idea seeks to simplify and streamline this process. Hereâ€™s how it addresses the problem: 1. Loan Eligibility Assessment: o Users input their salary, place of work, and desired loan amount. o The app analyzes this information to determine their eligibility for loans. 2. Bank Recommendations: o Based on the userâ€™s details, the app identifies banks that can provide loans for the desired amount. o It presents a list of suitable banks, ensuring transparency and choice. 3. Comparison and Decision-Making: o The app provides a summary comparison of loan options from different banks. o Users can compare installments, loan durations, and total repayment amounts. o Armed with this information, they can make an informed decision. 4. Efficient Application Process: o Users can initiate loan applications directly through the app. o They can choose a single bank or apply to multiple banks simultaneously. o The app acts as a central hub, simplifying paperwork and reducing redundancy. 5. Application Tracking and Communication: o Users can monitor the status of their loan applications. o The app notifies them if additional documents or details are required. o It keeps them informed until the application is either approved or rejected. 6. Bank Portal Integration: o Banks receive applications through a dedicated portal. o This streamlines their processing and ensures timely communication. Benefits: â€¢ User Convenience: Applicants can manage the entire process from their smartphones. â€¢ Transparency: Clear comparisons empower users to choose the best option. â€¢ Time Savings: Eliminates the need to visit multiple banks physically. â€¢ Efficiency: Banks receive well-organized applications, expediting approvals. In summary, my fintech app idea bridges the gap between borrowers and lenders, making loan applications more accessible, transparent, and efficient. It empowers users to make informed decisions while simplifying the process for both applicants and banks.
Keywords: loan comparison, fintech app, banking, loan application, financial transparency

Project: Spectrum Hub - Understand. Support. Empower
Problem: Autism is a neurodevelopment disorder that affects social interaction, communication, and behavior. Many individuals with autism face challenges in accessing appropriate support and resources to help them thrive into teenage & early adulthood. This can lead to feelings of isolation, limited relational, educational & employment opportunities, therefore difficulty transitioning into independent living. The main problem the this Autism Hub is trying to solve is the lack of accessible & comprehensive support for youth with autism. As well as not having a one stop shop for programs that promote social inclusion with peers & other neurotypical people, skills development in different areas of life, & community engagement in different aspects of society. Many of youth on the autism spectrum disorder face difficulties making friendships, having a place that makes them feel they belong & that they are accepted the way they are will make a huge difference in their lives.
Solution: An autism hub for youth on the spectrum can provide a range of solutions & support such as -Peer support space where individuals on the spectrum can come together to share their experiences, challenges, and ideas or special interests. -Group support space for individual on the spectrum to encourage one another, fostering a sense of belonging & understanding. -Relationship building through helping individuals on the spectrum developing effective communication skills. -Showcasing & developing their special interest such as a club where it can focus on art, music, technology, reading, science & potentially collaborate on projects. The hub can also offer workshops on specific topics like photography in order to create an employment opportunity for individuals on the spectrum. -Socialization community through organizing social events. By providing these solutions, an Autism Hub for youth can significantly improve the quality of life for individuals on the autism spectrum disorder & their families.
Keywords: autism support, youth autism, social inclusion, skills development, community hub

Project: XR Building
Problem: One significant challenge faced by customers in the architectural design process is the difficulty in visualizing measurements and spatial proportions accurately. Many clients struggle to translate numerical measurements and technical drawings into a tangible understanding of the space they are envisioning. This becomes particularly problematic when considering complex architectural designs or large-scale projects where the scale of the space may be difficult to grasp solely from traditional blueprints or computer-generated models. For these customers, the inability to see the space in real life poses a significant obstacle. They may find it challenging to gauge how rooms flow into each other, the height of ceilings, or the overall sense of openness within the design. This lack of visualization can lead to uncertainty, hesitation, and even dissatisfaction with the proposed design. Furthermore, without a tangible sense of scale and proportion, clients may struggle to make informed decisions about design elements, furniture placement, or interior finishes. This can result in design revisions, delays, and increased costs as clients attempt to reconcile their mental image with the reality of the built environment. In essence, the inability to perceive measurements and spatial relationships accurately creates a gap in understanding between architects/designers and clients. Addressing this gap with a more immersive and realistic visualization solution is essential to facilitate better communication, enhance client satisfaction, and streamline the architectural design process.
Solution: Our solution involves transforming engineering blueprints and architectural plans into dynamic, interactive 3D models. Through cutting-edge virtual reality technology, clients will have the opportunity to immerse themselves in their property by donning a virtual reality headset. This revolutionary experience enables them to explore every aspect of their future space as if they were physically present, granting them unparalleled insight into size, dimensions, distances, and the overall flow of the design. They can navigate through rooms, examine spatial relationships, and even visualize furniture placement with astonishing accuracy. By providing this lifelike representation, clients can make informed decisions, identify potential issues, and ensure that the design aligns perfectly with their vision. This approach minimizes costly errors and revisions while maximizing client satisfaction and confidence in the final outcome.
Keywords: virtual reality, architectural visualization, 3d modeling, interior design, client experience

Problem: Many patients do not know which medical center or doctor is best for treating their medical condition in terms of the doctor's experience, price, appointment availability, trust, general service and follow-up after treatment, or whether health insurance covers it or not. Original: كثير من المرضى لا يعرفون اي مركز طبي او دكتور افضل لعلاج حالتهم الطبية من حيث خبرة الدكتور او السعر او قرب المواعيد او الثقة او الخدمة العامة و المتابعة بعد العلاج او هل يشمل التامين الصحي ام لا؟

Project: CRM platform
Problem: Many businesses face challenges in managing customer relationships, sales pipelines, and service operations due to disjointed systems and manual processes. This leads to scattered customer data, poor cross-department communication, delayed responses, and missed revenue opportunities. Additionally, tracking customer interactions and nurturing leads becomes inefficient, causing frustration for both customers and employees. Our business addresses these issues by providing a unified, cloud-based platform that automates key processes, centralizes customer data, and offers real-time insights. This ensures seamless collaboration across teams, improves customer engagement, and drives business growth by optimizing efficiency and enhancing the customer experience.
Solution: Our solution is a comprehensive, cloud-based Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform that centralizes and automates critical business processes such as sales, customer service, and marketing. By consolidating customer data into a single, accessible hub, it eliminates the inefficiencies of fragmented systems and manual tasks.Provides multi-channel support, enabling faster response times and better customer satisfaction.
Inspiration: Our inspiration to address this problem came from witnessing the challenges businesses face in managing customer relationships and sales processes due to disjointed tools and outdated methods. We saw companies struggling with scattered data, inefficient manual workflows, and lost opportunities, all of which directly impacted their growth and customer satisfaction. Recognizing the critical role customer relationship management plays in business success, we wanted to create a solution that simplifies and automates these processes, empowering businesses to focus on building stronger customer connections and driving sustainable growth. This motivated us to develop a unified platform that addresses these pain points effectively.
Keywords: crm platform, customer relationship management, sales automation, cloud-based, customer data

Project: finditbh.com
Problem: KPMG report most businesses in Bahrain have no online presence, most just don’t know where to start, or it’s not a feasible investment. We are facing a major disconnect as more than 86% of the population are digital consumers, but Bahrain businesses aren’t online, so we revert to buying internationally. Existing local directories, have no product search functionality, and outdated results. Most local businesses don’t appear in google, Instagram, relies on knowing the business name or hashtags.
Solution: Finditbh, gets local businesses online instantly and is the go-to source, for consumers to easily and quickly search, buy and support local - keeping Bahrain money, in Bahrain. Finditbh, helps businesses showcase their products and services without the delay and cost of developing their own platform, whilst also gaining access to an unprecedented range of business tools, so they can, market and track their products, services, and VAT. Local consumers can search for specific products and brands from an up-to-date source, connecting with the local distributor, making shopping easier, cheaper, and faster.
Inspiration: Having lived all over the world, I was shocked and very surprised that it was so difficult to find local businesses and distributors of specific brands and products. Like myself, when moving to Bahrain, many people need to purchase a variety of products and services to establish themselves, most of which have reported its almost impossible and as such they revert to buying online internationally. In my research I have identified that this problems doesn't just apply to expats, the local community reports the same problem. Consumers having to order online results in increased costs and delays while waiting for products ordered to be shipped and delivered. The lack of online presence from local businesses, not only effects the success and results the business can achieve as they are missing many sale opportunities, it also has a major impact on the Bahrain economy as Bahrain money is not staying within the Bahrain economy.
Keywords: online marketplace, local businesses, product search, Bahrain, digital presence

Project: LAB HUB
Problem: With over 25 years in regulatory compliance, business establishment, and quality control, I am well-equipped to support aspiring entrepreneurs in the cosmetics and detergent industries. Many face barriers like high startup costs, lack of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) certification, and insufficient production knowledge. These challenges hinder talented individuals from launching businesses, limiting job creation and economic growth. My project addresses these issues by providing a fully equipped manufacturing facility and essential training. By sharing my expertise in inspection and productivity enhancement, I can guide entrepreneurs through regulatory complexities and help them establish their brands with confidence. This initiative promotes local manufacturing, strengthens the community’s economic foundation, and fosters a vibrant local economy built on quality products and sustainable practices.
Solution: Our solution involves providing a fully equipped manufacturing facility tailored for aspiring entrepreneurs in the cosmetics and detergent industries. This facility will include the necessary machinery, access to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) certification, and lab testing services. We will also provide the requirements for regulatory compliance and ISO certification standards. Additionally, comprehensive training and guides on production processes will be offered. By equipping individuals with the right tools and knowledge, we empower them to overcome entry barriers, confidently launch their businesses, and produce high-quality products. This approach not only fosters individual success but also strengthens the local economy through job creation and sustainable manufacturing practices.
Inspiration: It became clear to me over the years that many talented individuals in the cosmetics and detergent industries, despite having innovative ideas, were unable to move forward due to financial and regulatory challenges. I have witnessed firsthand how the lack of affordable manufacturing spaces and access to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) certification often stifles creativity and ambition. Seeing so many bright entrepreneurs struggle with these barriers was disheartening, and I realized that if given the proper tools, guidance, and access to facilities, they could create successful, sustainable businesses. This motivated me to leverage my extensive experience in regulatory compliance and business establishment to create a solution that removes these obstacles. By providing a fully equipped facility and the necessary regulatory and operational training, I want to bridge the gap between ambition and action, allowing local entrepreneurs to bring their ideas to market. The potential to foster innovation, create jobs, and strengthen the local economy drives me to solve this problem.
Keywords: cosmetics manufacturing, detergent manufacturing, gmp certification, regulatory compliance, entrepreneurship

Project: TRYBE BH
Problem: The problem TRYBE aims to solve is the lack of seamless tools for individuals to manage their time, tasks, and personal growth in a productive and meaningful way. Many people face overwhelming schedules, disorganized to-do lists, and inefficient time management, leading to stress and decreased productivity. Current tools often focus on either digital or physical solutions, but few bridge the gap between the two in an intuitive way. TRYBE addresses this by providing a hybrid of digital and physical products—such as a journal and app—that allow users to organize, reflect, and manage their time effectively, while integrating AI to offer personalized insights and reality checks to optimize daily routines.
Solution: TRYBE offers a hybrid solution combining a physical journal with a cutting-edge app to help users manage their time, tasks, and personal growth more effectively. The journal allows for traditional note-taking, while the app digitizes, syncs, and makes the content searchable. By integrating AI, TRYBE provides personalized insights, such as flagging overly ambitious schedules, checking real-time traffic before meetings, and offering productivity suggestions. This dual platform bridges the gap between physical and digital tools, giving users the flexibility to plan and optimize their day seamlessly while making data-driven improvements to reclaim their time.
Inspiration: In different situations in our busy world I noticed people kept on over planning and not hitting their goals and targets. This applies to large construction projects or even personal goals such as going to the gym. I thought what if our notes, journals or planners talk back to us then thought if I can use AI to do it this can solve that issue of people.
Keywords: time management, productivity journal, hybrid app, artificial intelligence, personal growth

Project: النقل الآمن
Problem: It aims to transport young children (males and females) of young ages (3-10) years from their homes to educational facilities and back, while providing maximum protection, safety, and comfort. Through a medium-sized transport bus that uses a hybrid system, charged through a bus parking garage equipped with solar energy systems. The bus door is parallel to the driver's seat and is used by everyone to enter and exit the bus. Children's seats are designed in an appropriate size and independent for each child, and the distribution is U-shaped to provide visual exchange between everyone and designed so that children cannot hide. The bus supervisor's seat is facing the children at the entrance. There are TV screens to entertain children during the round trip. The bus is equipped with a tracking system so parents can track the children's movement. The technical system in the bus gives an alert to parents when the bus approaches the home, in preparation for the child handover process. The technical system in the bus sends notifications to the operations room in case the speed limit is exceeded. Inspiration: Incidents of children being forgotten in buses and traffic congestion for parents in front of educational facilities. Original: حوادث نسيان الأطفال في الحافلات والأزدحام المروري لأولياء الأمور أمام المنشآت التعليمية

Project: AGRI
Problem: Many farmers and gardeners in Bahrain struggle with poor soil quality, which directly impacts crop yields and plant health. Traditional soils often lack essential nutrients, leading to stunted growth, increased susceptibility to pests, and lower harvests. Additionally, the inconsistent supply of quality potting mixes and fertilizers makes it difficult for both urban and rural gardeners to sustain healthy plants. For instance, a small-scale farmer may invest significant time and resources into planting but face disappointing results due to inadequate soil conditions.
Solution: To address this issue, we are offering locally produced soil mixes that cater specifically to the needs of Bahraini citizens. Our goal is to raise awareness about the importance of quality soil and sustainable gardening practices. By manufacturing these products in Bahrain, we not only ensure freshness and suitability for local conditions but also support the local economy and promote self-sufficiency in agricultural inputs.
Inspiration: Our journey began in 2019 when we were in grade 10, driven by a passion for agriculture and a desire to make a positive impact in our community. Observing the struggles of local farmers and gardeners in Bahrain, we realized that poor soil quality was a significant barrier to successful cultivation. This inspired us to research and develop innovative soil mixes that would improve plant health and yields. We understood that by providing locally produced solutions, we could not only enhance agricultural practices but also promote sustainable gardening within our community. Our commitment to raising awareness about these issues motivates us to continue our efforts in helping others achieve their gardening and farming goals.
Keywords: soil mixes, agriculture, gardening, Bahrain, sustainable farming

Project: CyberCrest Consulting
Problem: The primary problem my target audience faces is the growing complexity and severity of cybersecurity threats, which often outpaces their internal capabilities to manage such risks effectively. Many organizations struggle with understanding the strategic implications of cybersecurity, finding themselves ill-equipped to develop robust security frameworks that align with their business objectives. This lack of preparedness not only exposes them to potential breaches and financial losses but also undermines their stakeholders' trust. My workshops and resources equip senior management and boards with the necessary insights and tools to transform cybersecurity from a technical challenge into a strategic advantage, ensuring comprehensive risk management and compliance with evolving regulations.
Solution: My solution involves delivering high-level cybersecurity workshops tailored specifically for boards of directors, senior executives, and CEOs. These workshops focus on demystifying the complexities of cybersecurity, presenting it as a manageable aspect of business strategy. By integrating real-world scenarios and practical strategies, I help leaders understand their pivotal role in cybersecurity governance, empowering them to make informed decisions that protect their organizations while aligning with business goals. This proactive approach not only enhances security but also builds a culture of cyber resilience.
Inspiration: I was inspired to address the problem of cybersecurity challenges in strategic leadership due to my extensive background managing information security and operational excellence in both governmental and fintech sectors. Working at BENEFIT—a pivotal network managing over $30 billion annually in Bahrain—and my long tenure in various governmental positions, I gained deep insights into the complexities of securing critical financial infrastructures. My role involved directly reporting to the chief executive and board-level committees, updating them on security maturity and risk mitigation strategies. Additionally, my exposure to regional practices through serving on jury and evaluation committees for eGovernment and digital transformation across the GCC further highlighted the strategic gaps in cybersecurity integration at the executive level. This experience motivated me to leverage my expertise to help organizations develop robust cybersecurity frameworks that enhance business operations and compliance, fostering a security culture that supports overall organizational growth and innovation.
Keywords: cybersecurity workshops, board of directors, strategic risk, governance, executive leadership

Project: Smart Building Services
Problem: The current situation in building management, especially in residential properties, is characterized by a set of shortcomings, outdated practices, and evolving challenges that often fail to meet expected standards. Many residential buildings are still slow in adopting integrated digital management solutions, making operations time-consuming, error-prone, and inefficient. Communication between residents, property managers, and the owners' association remains slow and weak through traditional communication methods or personal visits. Additionally, most building managements focus only on basic services such as fee collection, routine maintenance of the building, and security guards, making the quality of services inconsistent and overlooking the broader needs of residents, leading to dissatisfaction and exacerbating deficiencies due to the lack of technology-based solutions to monitor and manage service quality. Project: TinyTiger
Problem: Many commercial cat foods contain grains and fillers that are not only unnecessary but can also harm feline health. Cats are obligate carnivores, meaning their diets should primarily consist of meat. Grains like corn and wheat can lead to digestive issues, obesity, and even chronic conditions such as diabetes and kidney disease. Moreover, many pet foods are packed with artificial additives and low-quality ingredients, which can compromise a cat's overall health. Common health problems linked to poor nutrition include allergies, lethargy, and a weakened immune system. By focusing on high-quality meat and essential nutrients, our products aim to address these issues, providing cats with a diet that supports their natural dietary needs. This shift not only promotes better health but also enhances their quality of life, helping them thrive for years to come.
Solution: My business aims to revolutionize cat nutrition by providing healthier food options that eliminate harmful ingredients, particularly grains that can lead to long-term health issues. Unlike conventional pet foods, our products focus on high-quality meat and essential supplements, including omega-3s and vital vitamins, ensuring cats receive the ultimate nutrition they deserve.
Inspiration: My inspiration for this business stems from my personal experience as a cat owner. I struggled to find affordable, high-quality food options that met my cat’s dietary needs. Despite using high-end brands, my cat suffered from health issues directly related to her diet. This firsthand struggle highlighted the urgent need for healthier, grain-free alternatives that provide optimal nutrition without breaking the bank. Through this venture, I aim to create products that ensure other cat owners don’t face the same challenges and that their pets can thrive on a truly beneficial diet.
Keywords: cat food, grain-free, pet nutrition, healthy food

text:
Project: مؤسسه تنشئه الطفل وإعادة تنشئة الطفل
Problem: The target segment is parents, to raise their children properly and to educate them on the importance of raising a child correctly from the first five years, which are the most important years for forming the child's personality, and to prevent raising aggressive children or even aggressive adults who tend to cause problems and crimes in the world. This is done by conducting awareness courses for parents and also to help them raise their children, as many of them do not know the correct way, and many do not know the mistakes they make in upbringing and what those mistakes cause in the child's personality in the future. Also, to help children who were raised wrongly to overcome what they suffered and correct the mistakes they were raised on, strengthen their personalities, and help them achieve their dreams, as many of them may be stopped by something in their personality or their wrong upbringing from achieving a dream. Original: الشريحة المستهدفة هي أولياء الأمور لتربيه أطفالهم تربيه صحيحه ولتوعيتهم على أهمية تنشئه الطفل تنشئه صحيحه منذ خمس سنواته الاولى وهي اهم سنوات لتكوين شخصية الطفل وللحدّ من ان تنشئ أطفال عدوانين او حتى كبار عدوانين ويميلون إلا افتعال المشاكل والجرائم في العالم وذلك عن طريق فعل دورات توعيه لأولياء الأمور وايضاً لمساعدتهم على تربية أبنائهم فالكثير منهم لايعرف ماهي الطريقه الصحيحه لذلك والكثير لا يعرف الأخطاء التي يفعلها في التربيه وماذا تورث تلك الأخطاء في شخصية الطفل مستقبلا ايضاً لنساعد الأطفال الذين نشئو نشئه خاطه على تخطي ماعانوه وعلى تصحيح مانشئو عليه من اخطاء ولتقوية شخصياتهم ومساعدتهم على تحقيق أحلامهم فالكثير منهم قد يوقفه شيء ما في شخصيته او في تربيته الخاطئه من تحقيق حلم ما
Solution: First, I want to learn more about raising children, analyzing their drawings, providing psychological analysis tests for children to know what they are suffering from, and providing counseling sessions to help them. Also, providing awareness lectures for parents to teach them the correct methods of raising children and what wrong methods they should avoid. I also want to enhance love and affection between mother and child by providing activities for the mother and her child that enhance cooperation between them, such as sports sessions, drawing sessions, and other activities that the mother can share with her child instead of being constantly busy with work or at home. Original: اولاً أريد ان أتعلم اكثر عن تربية الاطفال وتحليل رسوماتهم وتقديم اختبارات تحليل نفسي للأطفال ومعرفه مايعانون منه وتقديم جلسات إرشاديه لهم لمساعدتهم وايضاً تقديم محاظرات توعويه لأولياء الأمور لتعليمهم الطرق الصحيحه في تربيه الاطفال وماهي الأساليب الخاطئه التي يجب عليهم ان لا يفعلوها ايضاً أريد ان اعزز المحبه والود بين الام والطفل ذلك من توفير فعاليات للام وطفلها يعزز التعاون بينهم مثل حصص رياضيه حصص رسم وغيرها من الفعاليات التي يمكن للام ان تشارك طفلها فيه بدل انشغالها الدائم في العمل او في المنزل
Inspiration: I see that society needs this awareness and guidance a lot. Many people do not know the mistakes they make in raising their children, and there are those who neglect their children and do not raise them, thinking that by being involved in society, children will be raised and learn. Others overindulge their children, making them dependent and unable to rely on themselves, along with many other wrong upbringing practices. Also, the thing that made me think of this project is my love for children. I love children very much and have the ability and patience to deal with them. My main university major is Islamic Studies, but I studied a minor in Educational Psychology and learned a lot about correct upbringing methods, and I want to learn more and more about the correct methods of raising children to help children and society. Original: ارى انه المجتمع بحاجه إلى هذه التوعيه والتوجيه كثيرا فالكثير لا يعلم الأخطاء الذي يرتكبونها في تربية أبنائهم وايضاً هناك من يهمل أبنائه ولا يربيهم ظنن منهم انه بانخراطه في المجتمع سوف تربى وتعلم ومنهم من يدلل أبنائه دلال زائد فيورث أبناء اتكالين لا يمكنهم الاعتماد على انفسهم والكثير من التربيه والأشياء الخاطئه التي يرتكبونها . ايضاً الشيء الذي جعلني افكر بهذا المشروع حبي للأطفال فأنا احب الاطفال كثيرا ولدي القدره والصبر على التعامل معهم ، تخصصي الجامعه الأساس اسلاميات لكني درست فرعي علم نفس تربوي تعلمت كثيرا عن طرق التنشئه الصحيحه وانا أريد ان أتعلم اكثر وأكثر عن الطرق والأساليب الصحيحه لتنشئة الطفال لمساعدة الاطفال والمجتمع
Keywords: parenting, child development, awareness courses, psychological analysis
