Project: Lemaiy
Problem: Bed covers for patients in hospitals or care institutions for the elderly and people with special needs cost a lot; they need a budget to buy them, then washing, sterilizing, stain removal, and ironing the sheets after use. The cost includes wages for labor, electricity, water, detergents, and sterilization materials. It also requires a large space in the hospital to accommodate all of that. The product saves all of that because it is a bed cover made of light, biodegradable cotton fabrics with cotton fillings to absorb any leakage, and it has an adhesive strip to ensure it stays on the bed. It is single-use and environmentally friendly in terms of its biodegradability, as it will reduce environmental pollution and reduce waste of energy and water. Original: اغطية أسرة المرضى في المستشفيات او مؤسسات رعاية للمسنين و ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصه تكلف كثيرا ؛ وتحتاج ميزانية عند شراءها، ثم تغسيل وتعقيم وإزالة البقع وكوي الشراشف بعد الاستخدام . وتكلفت في رواتب الايدي العاملة والكهرباء والماء و مساحيق الغسيل و مواد التعقيم . وكذلك توفير مساحه كبيرة في المستشفى لاستيعاب كل ذلك . المنتج يوفر كل ذلك عن لانه عبارة عن اغطية سرير من انسجه قطنيه خفيفه قابله لتحلل وبها حشوات من القطن لامتصاص اي تسريب كما فيها شريط لاصق لضمان ثباتها على السرير. ذات الاستخدام الواحد ومناسبه للبيئة من ناحية قابلتها لتحلل .. كما سوف في تقليل التلوث البيئي وتقليل هدر الطاقه والمياه.
Solution: The product is a bed cover made of light cotton fabrics that are biodegradable and contain cotton fillings to absorb any leakage, and it has an adhesive strip to ensure it stays on the bed. It is single-use and environmentally friendly in terms of its biodegradability... It will also help reduce environmental pollution and reduce waste of energy and water. Original: المنتج عبارة عن اغطية سرير من انسجه قطنيه خفيفه قابله لتحلل وبها حشوات من القطن لامتصاص اي تسريب كما فيها شريط لاصق لضمان ثباتها على السرير. ذات الاستخدام الواحد ومناسبه للبيئة من ناحية قابلتها لتحلل .. كما سوف في تقليل التلوث البيئي وتقليل هدر الطاقه والمياه.
Inspiration: I was taking care of my mother, may God have mercy on her. She was elderly and bedridden for many years. I used to think: if only there were an alternative to bed sheets that I could dispose of after each use and not need to wash, sterilize, and iron them. That would save the time consumed by that process... I also noticed that bed covers in hospitals sometimes get stained with blood or there are leaks of filth from patients... I used to think who might have used this cover before me and what might have happened to it before I used it. Original: كنت اعنتي بوالدتي رحمها الله .. كانت مسنه وتلازم الفراش لسنوات عديدة ، فكنت افكر لو كان هناك بديل لشراشف الفراش بحيث اتخلص منها بعد كل استخدام ولا احتاج لتغسيلها وتعقيمها و كويها. وبتالي اوفر في الوقت الذي تستهلكه تلك العمليه .. كما ولاحظت اغطية الأسرة في المستشفى تتلطخ بدم بعض الأحياناً او يحدث تسريب قاذورات من المرضي .. فكنت افكر من قد يكون استخدم هذا الغطاء قبلي وماذا قد حدث له قبل أن استخدمه ..
Keywords: disposable bed covers, hospital supplies, biodegradable

Project: icecream
Problem: The target group is children and those who want to adhere to a healthy diet free of sugars and low in calories. The problem lies in the lack of healthy food alternatives for children, which requires the working mother to spend more time preparing healthy food for her children. Also, there is a demand from children in the summer to buy ice cream. The goal of the project is to focus on making healthy ice cream for children, the elderly, and those on a diet. Solution: I had a virtual record and I worked on making healthy ice cream from home, and there was a great demand for all types of ice cream. The project was also hosted on Bahrain TV as one of the distinguished projects. From my point of view, I solved a simple problem that most people face, which is the lack of healthy alternatives for some food products. Also, making healthy ice cream reduces the incidence of diseases due to the presence of preservatives in the ice cream sold in supermarkets for children and individuals. Original: لقد كان لدي سجل افتراضي و قد عملت على صناعة الآيسكريم الصحي من المنزل و كان هناك إقبال كبير على جميع أنواع الآيسكريم كما أن تم استضافة المشروع في تلفزيون البحرين على أساس انه من المشاريع المتميزة و من وجة نظري فقد عملت على حل مشكلة بسيطة يواجهها أغلب الناس و هي عدم وجود بدائل صحية لبعض المنتجات الغذائية كما أن صنع ايسكريم صحي يقلل من حالات الإصابة بالأمراض بسبب وجود مواد حافظة في الأيسكريم الذي يباع في السوبرماركت للأطفال و الأفراد
Inspiration: My constant concern for my children's health and providing healthy alternatives. Original: اهتمامي الدائم بصحة أطفالي و تقديم بدائل صحية
Keywords: healthy ice cream, children, healthy food alternatives, preservatives, diet

Project: Esbitar
Problem: our Esbitar aims to solve the Prolonged wait times, declining patient satisfaction, and healthcare inequity are significant challenges in the current healthcare system. These issues disproportionately affect vulnerable populations, including the elderly, those with chronic diseases, and individuals with limited mobility. Addressing these problems is essential for improving health outcomes and ensuring equitable access to healthcare services
Solution: The idea is to establish a mobile clinic in our beloved Bahrain by providing health care services to the general population through dispatching physicians by our mobile unit at their door step. Our services aim to offer convenience as well as reduce time and cost for patients. In addition to the availability of medical services and daily basic medical care that would help diagnose and treat the patients across the board whilst targeting the disabled, the elderly, and people of determination
Inspiration: I am a general practitioner , with experience over a decade in general surgery, emergency medicine and general medicine, believe when I say I encountered a number of patients who would have been in a better condition if they were able to be provided daily health care service at their convenient place and time , yet because of the lack of having transportation or appointment booking they had reversible complications at that time , which became irreversible with the delay.
Keywords: mobile clinic, healthcare services, home visits, elderly, disabled

Project: نادي لأنشطة ما بعد المدرسة
Problem: I am the mother of a child with special needs. Naturally, these children need to have their time filled with various activities that help them acquire independence and self-reliance skills. They also need to be integrated with healthy children to learn from them through acquisition and interaction. Having this club daily after school hours greatly helps their parents in this aspect and keeps them away from electronic devices, which negatively affect their development and abilities, whether during school days or in the summer vacation. Original: أنا أم لطفلة من ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة، و بطبيعة الحال فإن هؤلاء الأطفال يحتاجون إلى ان يتم شغل أوقاتهم بالأنشطة المختلفة و التي تساعدهم على اكتساب مهارات الإستقلالية و الاعتماد على النفس ، كما أنهم يحتاجون إلى دمجهم بالأطفال الأصحاء ليتعلموا منهم بالاكتساب و المخالطة، وجود هذا النادي بشكل يومي بعد الدوام المدرسي يساهم و بشكل كبير في مساعدة أولياء أمورهم في هذا الجانب و أبعادهم عن الأجهزة الإلكترونية و التي تؤثر سلباً على تطورهم و قدراتهم سواءاً في ايام الدوام المدرسي أو في العطلة الصيفية .
Solution: In my upcoming project, God willing, I will work on providing a supportive, welcoming, and safe environment for all club members, both healthy children and those with special needs. Our program will also include various recreational and educational trips, in addition to focusing on developing the personal and educational aspects of children, such as speaking and dialogue skills, community participation, creativity, and critical thinking. It will also focus on independence skills, such as making simple dishes, dressing skills, and personal care for those with special needs. Original: في مشروعي القادم باذن الله سأعمل على توفير بيئة داعمة و مرحبة و آمنة لجميع منتسبي النادي من أطفال أصحاء و ذوي احتياجات خاصة ، كما سيضم برنامجنا رحلات ترفيهية و تعليمية متنوعة، بالإضافة إلى التركيز على تطوير الجوانب الشخصية و التعليمية للأطفال مثل مهارات التحدث و الحوار و المشاركة المجتمعية و الابداع و التفكير النقدي ، و مهارات الاستقلال مثل صنع اطباق بسيطة و مهارات ارتداء الملابس و العناية الشخصية بالنسبة لذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة
Inspiration: My situation with my daughter. Original: وضعي مع ابنتي
Keywords: special needs children, after-school club, life skills, integration, recreational activities

project_name: الابتكار في الطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد: من الأجزاء المخصصة إلى الرعاية الصحية
text:
Project: الابتكار في الطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد: من الأجزاء المخصصة إلى الرعاية الصحية
Problem: Many individuals suffer from difficulty finding customized products that suit their specific needs, such as custom parts for devices or food designed precisely for their nutritional needs. In the medical field, patients face challenges in obtaining prosthetic limbs that ideally adapt to their individual standards or suitable biological tissues, which negatively affects their comfort and quality of life. 3D printing offers a solution by providing customized products with precision and speed, meeting individual needs in multiple fields. Original: العديد من الأفراد يعانون من صعوبة في العثور على منتجات مخصصة تناسب احتياجاتهم الخاصة، مثل أجزاء مخصصة للأجهزة أو أغذية مصممة بدقة لاحتياجاتهم الغذائية. في المجال الطبي، المرضى يواجهون تحديات في الحصول على أطراف صناعية متكيفة بشكل مثالي مع معاييرهم الفردية أو أنسجة بيولوجية ملائمة، مما يؤثر سلباً على راحتهم وجودة حياتهم. الطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد تقدم حلاً من خلال توفير منتجات مخصصة بدقة وسرعة، وتلبية الاحتياجات الفردية في مجالات متعددة.
Solution: To print customized products using 3D printing technology, a process can be developed that includes collecting accurate data on individuals' needs, then designing 3D models that fit these requirements. These models are then printed using materials that suit the intended use, enhancing fit and comfort. In the medical field, 3D printing can provide prosthetic limbs and medical devices that are fully adapted to the patient's standards, raising their quality of life. This requires developing advanced design software, investing in printing technology, and enhancing collaboration between design and health specialists. Original: لطباعة المنتجات المخصصة باستخدام تقنية الطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد، يمكن تطوير عملية تتضمن جمع بيانات دقيقة عن احتياجات الأفراد، ثم تصميم نماذج ثلاثية الأبعاد تناسب هذه المتطلبات. يتم بعد ذلك طباعة هذه النماذج باستخدام مواد تتناسب مع الاستخدام المقصود، مما يعزز الملاءمة والراحة. في المجال الطبي، يمكن للطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد توفير أطراف صناعية وأجهزة طبية متكيفة تماماً مع معايير المريض، مما يرفع من جودة حياتهم. يتطلب هذا تطوير برامج تصميم متقدمة، استثمارات في تكنولوجيا الطباعة، وتعزيز التعاون بين المتخصصين في التصميم والصحة.
Inspiration: What inspired me to address this problem was the personal experiences of individuals who face difficulties in finding customized products that meet their specific needs, whether in daily life or in medical contexts. I realized that modern technology, such as 3D printing, can offer an effective solution to this challenge. Seeing how this technology can improve people's quality of life by providing solutions tailored to their individual needs motivated me to think about how to apply this technique in innovative and beneficial ways. Original: ألهمتني معالجة هذه المشكلة التجارب الشخصية للأفراد الذين يواجهون صعوبات في العثور على منتجات مخصصة تلبي احتياجاتهم الخاصة، سواء في الحياة اليومية أو في السياقات الطبية. أدركت أن التكنولوجيا الحديثة، مثل الطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد، يمكن أن تقدم حلاً فعّالاً لهذا التحدي. رؤية كيف يمكن لهذه التكنولوجيا تحسين جودة حياة الأشخاص من خلال توفير حلول مصممة خصيصاً لاحتياجاتهم الفردية حفزتني على التفكير في كيفية تطبيق هذه التقنية بطرق مبتكرة ومفيدة.
Keywords: 3d printing, customized products, prosthetic limbs, medical devices, design software

Project: Polypark
Problem: The primary problem faced by students and staff at university campuses is the difficulty in finding available parking spots, especially during peak hours. This often leads to wasted time, increased frustration, and delayed class attendance. The current system lacks real-time visibility into parking availability, causing drivers to circle around parking lots searching for open spots. This issue also contributes to increased traffic congestion and carbon emissions on campus. By not knowing which areas are full or have space available, students may opt to park far from their destination, adding to inefficiencies and inconvenience.
Solution: Our solution is a real-time parking detection system using a Raspberry Pi and camera to monitor parking spots. It provides instant updates on slot availability through a mobile or web app, allowing students and staff to quickly locate open spaces, minimizing search time, reducing traffic, and enhancing campus efficiency.
Inspiration: The inspiration to address this problem came from observing the daily challenges students and staff face when searching for parking, especially during peak hours. My team of two noticed that this often leads to wasted time, increased frustration, and potential accidents as drivers circle the lot. We wanted to create a solution that saves time, reduces the risk of accidents, and provides a headache-free parking experience, making campus parking smoother and more efficient for everyone.
Keywords: parking detection, real-time availability, raspberry pi, campus parking, traffic congestion

Problem: Many travelers struggle with the overwhelming task of planning a trip, which can be both time-consuming and stressful. Coordinating flights, accommodations, activities, and transportation often results in a long, excruciating process filled with potential errors and conflicting schedules. Traditional travel agencies offer expensive and non-personalized packages, leaving travelers dissatisfied. As a result, many spend excessive time researching destinations and options, only to face frustration and indecision. The need for a simplified, customizable, and affordable solution is critical to help travelers avoid unnecessary stress and enjoy a seamless, well-planned experience.
Solution: Our solution is a personalized travel platform that curates tailor-made packages based on individual preferences, offering a seamless booking experience. It consolidates flights, accommodations, activities, and itineraries into one streamlined interface, allowing users to book everything with a single click. By removing the need to browse multiple websites and eliminating the stress of manual planning, our platform saves time and reduces errors. Each travel package is customized to fit personal tastes and budgets, ensuring a more enjoyable, hassle-free travel experience while delivering convenience and personalized experiences.
Inspiration: The inspiration to address this problem came from recognizing the frustration many travelers experience when planning their trips. Project: ASSEMBLE
Problem: Due to the involvement of multiple parties, construction projects often face delays and cost increases induced by variations. A 2017 Arizona State University study found that 72% of projects are delayed, with a 38% increase in project duration. These setbacks negatively affect stakeholders, particularly end users and contractors. Contractors face additional labor and material costs, which can lead to financial instability. These issues will threaten a country’s social and economic state by reducing project benefits and social unrest. However, effective selection and tracking systems, including the use of BIM models and project management consultancies, can mitigate these problems effortlessly and improve project outcomes.
Solution: ASSEMBLE is a digital platform designed to address challenges in pre-contractual practices and project tracking within construction. It enables clients to seamlessly compare and select contractors, fostering effective communication and collaboration through the use of modern tools like BIM for visualizing the final product. During construction, ASSEMBLE provides detailed, real-time tracking of project stages, notifying users of any issues. In addition to the time management system, it also offers consultancies in areas like quantity surveying and cost estimation. Additionally, it features a simple works form to connect users with freelancers like electricians and plumbers which comes with the same versatile tracking system. ASSEMBLE will also boost the exposure of contractors and freelancers to end-users, leading to increased opportunities. This, in turn, will improve the economic conditions of both Bahraini contractors and freelancers by promoting growth in construction practices.
Inspiration: Coming from having both, a passion in construction and a background in the construction industry by actively studying Quantity Surveying, I have experienced delays in personal projects and other entities projects. I came to realize this is because of both lack of solid communication and lack of a versatile, flexible communication platform. Moreover, the exposure of people outside the construction industry to construction’s legal and technical practices is minute and usually results in entering a contract with a vague idea of the process done to complete it. Because I am a human before any other title, I have aspired to make my friends, family and society aware of the practices done by providing consultations protecting their finances and rights.
Keywords: construction, bim, contractor selection, project tracking, consultancy

Project: نور من منارتي
Problem: **Problem-Solving Statement:** Many individuals struggle to navigate the complexities of relationships, often facing challenges related to communication, and emotional well-being. There is a need for a (Noor) which is a tool that help people build and maintain safe, healthy, and fulfilling relationships. Solution: **Problem-Solving Statement for a Card Game Based on the 5 Needs Choice Theory:** Many relationships suffer due to a lack of understanding of each partner’s core needs, leading to miscommunication, unmet expectations, and conflict. The game will prompt meaningful conversations and activities that allow players to better understand their own and their partner’s needs, improving communication and fostering healthier, more fulfilling relationships. By blending fun with introspection, this game can provide a safe space for deeper connection and long-term relationship satisfaction.
Inspiration: Addressing the problem of unhealthy relationships is inspired by the common struggles people face in understanding and fulfilling each other's needs. Relationships are at the core of human well-being, yet many people lack the tools to navigate them effectively. The 5 Needs Choice Theory provides a clear framework for understanding the fundamental drivers of human behavior, making it an ideal foundation for a practical, engaging solution. A card game can create an environment that is both fun and transformative, giving individuals and couples a structured yet playful way to deepen their connection and address key areas like communication, emotional well-being, and mutual respect. By promoting healthy relationship habits, the game has the potential to prevent common issues from escalating and help people thrive together.
Keywords: relationship card game, 5 needs choice theory, communication improvement, conflict resolution, couple therapy

Problem: Consumer confidence: It increases consumer confidence in products, especially with growing awareness of the importance of healthy nutrition. Original: ثقة المستهلك: يزيد من ثقة المستهلك بالمنتجات، خاصة مع تزايد الوعي بأهمية التغذية الصحية. الشفافية: يساهم في خلق بيئة غذائية أكثر شفافية، حيث يعرف المستهلكون بالضبط ما يتناولونه. الحماية الصحية: يحمي المستهلكين من المنتجات التي تحتوي على مواد ضارة قد تؤثر على صحتهم. التوافق مع اللوائح: يساعد الشركات على الامتثال للوائح والقوانين المتعلقة بسلامة الأغذية.
Solution: Proposed solution: We will develop an integrated digital platform that collects samples of food products and conducts in-depth analyses in our specialized laboratories. After that, we will compare the results we obtain with the nutritional information stated on the package, and we will identify any differences or deviations. Work mechanism: • Sample collection: Samples of products will be collected from markets and factories randomly and regularly. • Analysis: The samples will undergo precise chemical, physical, and microbiological analyses to determine their nutritional composition and quality. • Comparison and verification: We will compare the results we obtain with the information stated on the package, and verify its validity and accuracy. • Issuing certificates: We will issue quality certificates for products that meet specified standards, and publish detailed reports on the results of the analysis. • Digital platform: The platform will allow consumers and companies to access analysis results and quality certificates, enabling them to make informed purchasing decisions. Advantages of this solution: • Full transparency: Providing full transparency to consumers about the quality of the products they purchase. • High trust: Building high trust among consumers in the brands that obtain quality certificates. Project: Riwaa
Problem: The target segment faces the problem of heavy reliance on plastic water bottles, which contribute to environmental pollution and increased plastic waste. Plastic takes hundreds of years to decompose, affecting marine life and the environment. Additionally, water loses its natural taste and may absorb chemicals from plastic. "Riwaa" products made of clay offer a natural alternative that preserves the freshness and coolness of water, and enables healthy and sustainable consumption. Original: تواجه الشريحة المستهدفة مشكلة الاعتماد الكبير على القناني البلاستيكية للماء، والتي تسهم في التلوث البيئي وزيادة النفايات البلاستيكية. البلاستيك يستغرق مئات السنين ليتحلل، مما يؤثر على الحياة البحرية والبيئة. إضافة إلى ذلك، يخسر الماء نكهته الطبيعية وقد يمتص مواد كيميائية من البلاستيك. منتجات "رِواء" المصنوعة من الفخار تقدم بديلاً طبيعياً يحافظ على نضارة وبرودة الماء، ويتيح استهلاكاً صحياً ومستداماً.
Solution: The solution offered by "Riwaa" is to provide water bottles made of clay, relying on natural materials and providing a healthy and environmentally friendly alternative. Clay naturally preserves the coolness and purity of water, reducing the need for plastic bottles and contributing to reducing plastic pollution. By designing durable and attractive products, "Riwaa" aims to change daily habits to encourage sustainability, and offers a unique experience that brings people back to the authenticity of using clay, giving them a sense of nature's quality. Additionally, "Riwaa" aims to reduce production chains by supporting national clay factories, which strengthens the local economy and reduces the carbon footprint associated with transportation and import. Original: الحل الذي تقدمه “رِواء” هو توفير قناني ماء مصنوعة من الفخار، تعتمد على المواد الطبيعية وتوفر بديلاً صحياً وصديقاً للبيئة. الفخار يحافظ على برودة الماء ونقائه بشكل طبيعي، ما يقلل الحاجة لاستخدام القناني البلاستيكية ويسهم في الحد من التلوث البلاستيكي. عبر تصميم منتجات متينة وجذابة، تستهدف “رِواء” تغيير العادات اليومية لتشجيع الاستدامة، وتقدم تجربة فريدة تعيد الناس إلى أصالة استخدام الفخار، وتمنحهم إحساساً بجودة الطبيعة. إضافة إلى ذلك، يهدف “رِواء” إلى تقليل سلاسل الإنتاج عبر دعم مصانع الفخار الوطنية، مما يعزز من الاقتصاد المحلي ويقلل من بصمة الكربون المرتبطة بالنقل والاستيراد.
Inspiration: What inspired me to address this problem is the noticeable increase in plastic pollution and its negative impact on the environment and marine life, along with the desire to return to the roots of Bahraini heritage and benefit from the natural solutions used by ancestors, such as clay. Through my personal experience, I noticed that clay still retains its unique properties in preserving and cooling water, making it an ideal and environmentally friendly alternative. Also, enhancing local handicrafts and supporting the national economy by reviving the traditional clay industry and presenting it in a modern way that attracts the new generation and serves environmental sustainability at the same time inspired me. Original: ما ألهمني لمعالجة هذه المشكلة هو التزايد الملحوظ في التلوث البلاستيكي وتأثيره السلبي على البيئة والحياة البحرية، إلى جانب الرغبة في العودة إلى جذور التراث البحريني والاستفادة من الحلول الطبيعية التي استخدمها الأجداد، مثل الفخار. لاحظت من خلال تجربتي الشخصية أن الفخار لا يزال يحتفظ بخصائصه الفريدة في حفظ الماء وتبريده، مما يجعله بديلاً مثالياً وصديقاً للبيئة. كذلك، ألهمني تعزيز الحرف اليدوية المحلية ودعم الاقتصاد الوطني من خلال إحياء صناعة الفخار التقليدية وتقديمها بحلة عصرية تجذب الجيل الجديد وتخدم الاستدامة البيئية في الوقت نفسه.

Project: Co-Kitchen
Problem: Many aspiring food entrepreneurs in Bahrain face significant barriers when starting or expanding their food-related businesses. High startup costs, limited access to professional kitchen spaces, and navigating health and safety regulations are major challenges. Home-based food businesses often lack the space and infrastructure to scale up, while emerging food entrepreneurs struggle to test and develop their concepts without committing to large investments. Additionally, food trucks, caterers, and local startups need affordable, flexible kitchen access to meet demand and grow their operations. Co-Kitchen aims to solve these challenges by providing a shared, fully-equipped kitchen space that offers affordable, flexible rental options, enabling food entrepreneurs to focus on building their businesses without the financial and logistical hurdles of setting up their own kitchens.
Solution: Co-Kitchen addresses the key challenges faced by food entrepreneurs: -Lower Costs: Entrepreneurs can rent professional kitchen space at a fraction of the cost of setting up their own. -Risk Reduction: Flexible rentals and access to a shared facility allow entrepreneurs to test their ideas before making a full investment. -Regulatory Compliance: Co-Kitchen ensures that all spaces meet health and safety standards, making it easier for businesses to comply with regulations. -Scalability: The space allows businesses to scale operations as demand increases without the need for expensive upgrades or relocations. -Support System: A built-in community of like-minded entrepreneurs fosters collaboration and growth. By offering an accessible, affordable, and compliant solution, Co-Kitchen empowers food entrepreneurs to focus on their passion and business growth without the burden of high startup costs and logistical challenges.
Inspiration: The inspiration to address this problem came from observing the challenges faced by aspiring food entrepreneurs in Bahrain, including myself. I noticed that many talented individuals, particularly home-based cooks and small-scale food businesses, struggled to expand due to the high costs of setting up a commercial kitchen, navigating complex regulations, and finding affordable spaces to work in. Additionally, many potential food entrepreneurs lacked access to the right tools and resources to test their ideas before making significant financial commitments. As someone who is passionate about both entrepreneurship and the culinary world, I saw an opportunity to create a solution that not only reduces the financial burden on these entrepreneurs but also fosters a sense of community and collaboration. By providing a shared kitchen space with flexible rental options, Co-Kitchen helps break down barriers to entry, enabling aspiring food entrepreneurs to focus on their creativity and business growth without the overwhelming risks and costs. I was further inspired by seeing similar successful shared kitchen models in other regions and the rise of collaborative workspaces in various industries. It became clear that the food business needed such a solution in Bahrain, one that could support the growth of local talent while addressing the practical challenges of starting a food business. Co-Kitchen is a response to that need, designed to empower food entrepreneurs to thrive in a supportive, affordable, and professional environment.
Keywords: shared kitchen, food entrepreneurs, rental kitchen space, regulatory compliance, business scalability

Project: Notedo
Problem: Notudo is an innovative solution to many problems: 1- The problem of many students failing because they do not have connections that convey their personal experience and mistakes in each academic subject, and the guardian is lost in important information about their child's academic stage. 2- The problem of a university student wasting a lot of time translating academic content, and the length of online educational lectures. 3- The problem of not being able to control the density of educational content and not having a study buddy who encourages the student and studies with them to complete the required amount quickly. 4- The problem of forgetting exam times and dates and academic requirements. 5- Students suffer at the beginning of each semester from wasting time planning and scheduling required dates, and forgetting some of them due to randomly writing them on various papers. 6- The problem of wasting a lot of paper just to repeat writing a sentence to memorize it. 7- The problem of wasting time in stationery stores at the beginning of each semester to search for required notebooks. Original: نوتدو عباره عن حلول مبتكره للعديد من المشاكل : ١- مشكلة رسوب الكثير من الطلبة بسبب عدم امتلاكهم علاقات تنقل لهم تجربتهم الشخصيه و اخطائهم في كل مادة دراسية ، و ضياع ولي الأمر في معلومات مهمة عن مرحلة ابنه الدراسية ٢- مشكلة ضياع الكثير من وقت الطالب الجامعي في ترجمة المحتوى الدراسي ، و طول المحاضرات التعليميه الاونلاين ٣- مشكله عدم السيطرة على كثافة المحتوى التعليمي و عدم امتلاك صديق دراسة يشجع الطالب و يدرسه معه ، لإكمال الكمية المطلوبه بسرعة ٤- مشكلة نسيان اوقات و تواريخ الامتحانات و المتطلبات الدراسية ٥- معاناة الطلبه بداية كل فصل في ضياع وقت التخطيط و جدولة التواريخ المطلوب ، و نسيان بعضها بسبب عشوائية كتابتها في مختلف الاوراق مشكله تخسير الكثير من الاوراق فقط لتكرار كتابه الجمله لحفظها ٧- مشكله تخسير وقت في القرطاسيات بداية كل فصل دراسي للبحث عن الدفاتر المطلوبه
Solution: We built the innovative Notudo system to address the problems students face, so we created an integrated system: Solutions to the problems: 1- A platform where university students and guardians following their children meet, sharing their previous experiences for each subject and how to pass the subject with the best possible experience. 2- Addressing the time wasted on translation with fully translated summaries next to each sentence, and explaining each topic in 5-10 minutes, which speeds up productivity and completes the content in a short time. 3- Building a system that encourages speeding up the process of finishing studying the required content. 4- Planners and agendas with the educational institution's dates. 5- In Notudo's innovative products, all stationery includes a whiteboard to facilitate memorization and ready-made schedules to organize information. 6- Preparing the student's notebook on the platform with an innovative process. Original: تم بناء نظام نوتدو المبتكر لمعالجة المشاكل التي يواجهها الطالب ف عملنا نظام متكامل : حلول المشاكل : ١- منصة يجتمع فيها الطلبه الجامعيين و اولياء الامور المتابعين لأبناءهم ، يتشاركون تجاربهم السابقه لكل مادة و كيفية تعدية المادة بأفضل تجربة ممكنه ٢- معالجة الوقت الضائع في الترجمة بملخصات مترجمه بالكامل بجانب كل جملة و شرح كل موضوع في ٥-١٠ دقائق مما يؤدي الى تسريع الانتاجية و اكمال المحتوى في وقت قصير ٣- بناء نظام يشجع على تسريع عمليه الانتهاء من دراسة المحتوى المطلوب ٤- مخططات و اجنده بتواريخ الجهة التعليميه ٥- في منتجات نوتدو المبتكره جميع القرطاسيه تحتوي على سبوره من اجل تسهيل الحفظ و جداول جاهزه لترتيب المعلومات ٦- تجهيز الدفتر الخاص بالطالب في المنصة بعمليه مبتكره
Inspiration: I am a student. I transferred from 3 university majors. In each major, I faced obstacles due to not having connections that would convey their experience to me to avoid some mistakes. So I pay the price with grade losses and my academic years being delayed compared to the required study plan. And I see many students who are expelled from the university just because they are ignorant of the rules and the game by which the journey of getting grades and passing courses is managed. And I am the type who cannot study alone, so I need a study partner with me to accomplish the required amount. So I built the Notudo system, which addresses many of the problems I personally faced and many of my colleagues as well. The huge amount of study in biology and medicine majors, and translating every sentence was an exhausting matter for me and for many students. Why should every student every year have to suffer this ordeal just because they do not have the friend who shares their translated papers or summaries? And why do I have to listen to an online lecture that lasts a full hour full of interruptions and 'uhhhhh' and moments of silence, while the information that matters to me can be condensed into half an hour or less? And the lack of good Arabic explanation on YouTube that is in the form of short clips. And why does every student struggle to discover information on their own every year? And some bear the cost of their ignorance of some things just because they do not have a friend to share with. So Notudo is the friend who shares with you, advises you, and helps you avoid mistakes that may happen, and also makes you accomplish in a faster and less boring way, studies with you, and gives you his ready-made and translated summaries. And it gives you the templates that every student struggles to design every semester and academic year. All of this is on a platform where students from any university around the world meet to share their experiences, and it will be a reference for every student to take from the experiences of others, which will make a difference in their academic level. And Notudo is an experience and a system that every student lives. Self-Expression • Reason: Being unique allows individuals to express their personal identity, values, and preferences. People want to differentiate themselves and communicate who they are through their choices, whether in fashion, hobbies, or lifestyle. Uniqueness is a way of showcasing individuality and authenticity. 2. Confidence and Self-Esteem • Reason: Standing out in a unique way often boosts confidence. When people feel they are not just blending into the crowd, they tend to feel more empowered and self-assured. Being distinct can also validate a person’s sense of self-worth, as it allows them to embrace what makes them special. 3. Social Recognition and Influence • Reason: In many social situations, being unique can attract attention and positive recognition. People often admire or respect those who are able to carve their own path or stand out from the norm. This recognition can lead to stronger social influence, allowing the unique individual to set trends, lead groups, or inspire others. 4. Avoiding Conformity • Reason: Some people seek uniqueness as a way to resist conformity. Conforming to societal or peer expectations can feel limiting or inauthentic for some individuals. By being unique, they assert their independence and freedom from societal pressures. 5. Creativity and Innovation • Reason: Uniqueness often fosters creativity. Those who embrace their differences are more likely to think outside the box and come up with innovative ideas. Being unique can encourage a person to explore new ways of doing things, which can lead to personal and professional growth. 6. Emotional Fulfillment • Reason: There is often a sense of emotional satisfaction that comes from being unique. Embracing individuality allows people to pursue what makes them truly happy and fulfilled, rather than following trends or norms that may not resonate with them. Cultural or Group Identity • Reason: Some people emphasize uniqueness to assert their cultural or group identity. In this context, uniqueness is tied to belonging and preserving important aspects of one’s culture or background. 9. Evolutionary Advantage • Reason: From an evolutionary perspective, uniqueness can provide advantages. Unique traits, behaviors, or ideas may signal strength, creativity, or adaptability, all of which can be beneficial for survival and social positioning. 10. Leaving a Legacy • Reason: Some people strive to be unique to leave a lasting legacy or impact. They want to be remembered for their individuality, contributions, or the changes they initiated. Whether through art, innovation, or leadership, being unique can help individuals make a mark on the world that endures beyond their lifetime. Summary: People seek uniqueness for a variety of reasons, including self-expression, confidence, social recognition, and creativity. Project: OpusWealth
Problem: In today’s fast-paced world, managing personal finances has become increasingly challenging. We spend money across multiple locations and through various payment methods, making it difficult to track daily expenses. As a result, many individuals find themselves unsure of why their spending has increased over time. The complexity of modern life leaves us mentally unequipped to monitor our spending habits consistently. This lack of financial awareness makes it harder to control or reduce expenses. Even when individuals manage to save, they often face uncertainty about how to make the most of their surplus due to limited financial literacy. Many are unaware of how to properly save, invest, or grow their wealth. This widespread issue affects people globally, underscoring the challenge of acquiring financial knowledge in the 21st century. By empowering individuals with financial literacy, we can help them make better decisions and improve their economic well-being.
Solution: Introducing Wealthorium, an intuitive app designed to help you gain full control over your finances. Wealthorium seamlessly tracks your transactions across all bank accounts and credit cards, logging your expenses, income, and even assets, to give you a complete picture of your financial health Powered by Generative AI, the app simplifies complex financial data into easy-to-understand insights, offering personalized recommendations to help you cut unnecessary expenses and make smarter investments. Once you've saved money, Wealthorium provides a curated list of investment options tailored to your financial literacy, ensuring you are never overwhelmed by choices. The app’s gamified experience makes financial growth engaging and fun. As you learn more and improve your financial literacy, you unlock new levels, tips, and opportunities to explore advanced financial strategies. Wealthorium not only helps you manage your money but also empowers you to build long-term wealth with confidence
Inspiration: - Growing up, I lacked financial knowledge, largely due to a poor school and college curriculum. - I began building an accounting system to track my expenses (and financial assets, liabilities, etc.) on a desktop app, but quickly discovered it was challenging to manually input each transaction from a paper receipt. - I researched ways to integrate with local banks, but soon realized my options were limited as an individual without fintech registration. Tarabut Gateway deserves a special mention here for providing me with valuable insights at the time. - I also explored the Benefit Pay app, which offered better tracking, but I wanted to download the information in a suitable format to plug into my desktop accounting software. Since it didn’t meet that need, I had to disregard it. - So, I decided to scrap my initial approach and build an application that could read SMS transactions directly from popular banks and credit card companies. It was semi-automated, as I still had to categorize each SMS/expense into the correct account on the app. However, at the end of the month, I could export this data and have it ready on my desktop app for further analysis. While there are similar apps available, they were closed-source and lacked the necessary export functionality and usability. - Later, after saving some money, I didn’t know what to do next. Where could I invest? What options were available? What knowledge was I missing to understand these investment choices? Everything seemed like gibberish to me. - And that’s how Wealthorium was born.
Keywords: personal finance, expense tracking, financial literacy, investment advice, generative ai

Project: Bioserv
Problem: Healthcare facilities face difficulty in finding the qualified biomedical engineers, at a reasonable rate, for the preventive and service maintenance of medical devices installed in their facilities. The health authority mandates that Medical Device distributors hire service engineers fulltime but distributors also face difficulty hiring the engineer with experience in their particular medical device scope (ex: dental, X-Ray, surgical etc.) plus the associated full time labor cost burden. Improper service of the devices leads to malfunction and breakdown, and in worst case scenario may lead to patient safety issues (Adverse events). The problem affects medical centers, distributors and may extend to compliance issues with health authorities.
Solution: Bioserv utilizes its inventory management software to track the serial/model numbers of the medical devices installed in a medical center/hospital, and sources/trains Bahraini NHRA licensed biomedical engineers on contract basis to service the devices. Bioserv contracted engineers are trained and certified by device manufacturers through partnership. Medical Devices serviced by Bioserv engineers are marked with the Bioserv stamp, to indicate that the device undergoes high quality maintenance. Medical centers can additionally benefit from the Inventory Management software to track maintenance schedules, service logs and engineer logs. Bioserv involves partnerships with NHRA, manufacturers and Healthcare facilities, aiming to increase local recruitment, decrease healthcare medical device cost burden (by lowering maintenance cost and extending device lifetime), increase medical facilities compliance to NHRA regulations.
Inspiration: At the beginning, it was majorly an issue with the proper service of the medical devices. With time, the issue extended to increased service expenses and number of decommissioned devices. Now, it has reached the point of alarming the health authorities into issuing legislations to ensure public safety and proper compliance of importers to tracking and maintaining the devices in their post-market phase. Seeing the impact, we felt the need to create Bioserv, a solution that would bring all parties involved in the matter together, towards one streamlined solution.
Keywords: medical device maintenance, biomedical engineers, inventory management software, NHRA compliance, healthcare

Inspiration: I used to notice that my mother used to wake up at dawn every day to prepare food for my younger siblings, and she faced difficulty in choosing healthy and delicious meals. So, the idea came to me to establish the 'Micro Lunch Box' project that contributes to solving this problem. Solution: To address the challenges faced by customers in finding personalized summer bead jewelry, AKOYA could implement a comprehensive strategy focused on enhancing customization options and broadening product offerings. By developing an interactive online platform that allows customers to design their own jewelry—selecting from a variety of beads, colors, and styles—AKOYA would empower individuals to create pieces that reflect their unique identities. Additionally, incorporating timeless designs that seamlessly transition between summer and winter wear will appeal to consumers seeking versatility. By utilizing durable materials such as stainless steel, AKOYA can ensure the longevity of its products, thereby meeting the demand for trendy yet enduring jewelry. This approach not only fosters customer satisfaction but also positions AKOYA as a leader in the personalized jewelry market.
Inspiration: The inspiration to address the issue of personalized summer bead jewelry is rooted in my own experiences as a consumer who faced significant challenges in finding pieces that truly reflected my individuality. As I navigated the jewelry market, I encountered a frustrating lack of customizable options that catered to my distinctive tastes and preferences. This personal struggle illuminated a broader market gap, revealing that many others likely share similar sentiments. Recognizing that jewelry is not merely an accessory but a vital expression of one’s identity fueled my commitment to creating a solution that empowers individuals to design and curate their own unique pieces. By addressing this need, I aim to foster a deeper connection between consumers and their jewelry, ultimately enhancing both satisfaction and loyalty within the marketplace.
Keywords: personalized jewelry, bead jewelry, customizable options, stainless steel, online platform

Project: EduSpace
Problem: The target audience, primarily tutors and educators, faces several challenges in finding suitable teaching spaces. Many existing facilities are either too costly, inconveniently located, or lack essential amenities like Wi-Fi, printing services, and flexible rental options. This limits their ability to conduct effective lessons and meet diverse student needs. EduSpace addresses these issues by providing affordable, well-equipped, and easily accessible teaching spaces, enabling tutors to focus on delivering quality education without the burden of high overhead costs.
Solution: EduSpace offers a comprehensive solution to the challenges faced by tutors in finding suitable teaching spaces. By providing affordable hourly rentals and flexible subscription packages, we eliminate the financial burden of long-term leases, making it easier for educators to access quality spaces without high overhead costs. Each room is fully equipped with essential tools such as whiteboards, desks, comfortable seating, free Wi-Fi, printing services, and projectors, ensuring that tutors have everything they need for effective lessons. Overall, EduSpace empowers educators to deliver high-quality education while growing their tutoring businesses.
Inspiration: As a tutor myself, I experienced firsthand the challenges of finding a suitable teaching space that met all my needs. I often struggled with high costs, inconvenient locations, and the lack of essential features like reliable Wi-Fi, adequate seating, and necessary teaching tools. This frustration inspired me to create EduSpace, a solution that caters specifically to the needs of educators. I recognized that many tutors face similar obstacles, and I wanted to build a supportive environment where they could easily access well-equipped, affordable spaces that foster effective teaching. By addressing these issues, I aim to empower fellow educators to focus on what truly matters—delivering high-quality education to their students.
Keywords: teaching spaces, tutor services, hourly rental, educational facilities, EduSpace

Project: Eventual
Problem: Recently, and after conducting many extensive analyses and studies, and as a student majoring in entrepreneurship at the University of Bahrain, I found that there is an urgent need in Bahraini society for an application that facilitates the process of planning events and provides all the required sections for organizing them. The application I aspire to develop, named 'Eventual', aims to provide integrated solutions for users, including choosing the appropriate invitation card for any occasion, whether it is a celebration, graduation, business success, or even welcoming newborns. In addition, the application provides the ability to determine the event theme, choose photographers, hospitality services, decorations, cake, sweets, flowers, as well as the appropriate place and date for holding the event. I obtained second place in the Best Entrepreneurial Project competition at the University of Bahrain, which was under the supervision of the evaluator Mrs. Asma from 'Tamkeen'. I look forward to creating this successful application, which aims to facilitate event planning operations and enhance cooperation with local companies that wish to display their services through the platform, giving users wider and more diverse options. Original: في الآونة الأخيرة، وبعد إجراء العديد من التحليلات والدراسات المكثفة، وبصفتي طالبة في تخصص ريادة الأعمال بجامعة البحرين، وجدت أن هناك حاجة ملحّة في المجتمع البحريني لتطبيق يسهل عملية التخطيط للمناسبات ويوفر جميع الأقسام المطلوبة لتنظيمها. يهدف التطبيق الذي أسعى لتطويره، والذي يحمل اسم “Eventual”، إلى تقديم حلول متكاملة للمستخدمين تشمل اختيار بطاقة الدعوة المناسبة لأي مناسبة، سواء كانت احتفالاً، تخرجاً، نجاحاً في الأعمال، أو حتى استقبال مواليد. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يوفر التطبيق إمكانية تحديد ثيم الحدث، واختيار المصورين، خدمات الضيافة، الزينة، الكيك، الحلويات، الورود، وكذلك المكان والتاريخ المناسبين لإقامة الحدث. حصلت على المركز الثاني في مسابقة أفضل مشروع ريادي بجامعة البحرين، والتي كانت تحت إشراف المقيمة السيدة أسماء من “تمكين”. إنني أتطلع لإنشاء هذا التطبيق الناجح، الذي يهدف إلى تسهيل عمليات التخطيط للمناسبات وتعزيز التعاون مع الشركات المحلية التي ترغب في عرض خدماتها عبر المنصة، مما يتيح للمستخدمين خيارات أوسع وأكثر تنوعًا.
Inspiration: The inspiration for this problem came from the noticeable need in Bahraini society for a comprehensive tool that facilitates the process of planning events. Many individuals and companies face challenges in organizing events due to the complexity of multiple and overlapping details such as choosing invitations, photographers, hospitality services, decorations, and others. Additionally, there is a lack of tools that bring all these services together in one place. Through market analysis, I noticed that many existing applications do not provide integrated solutions or are specifically designed for the needs of the local community. This gap prompted me to develop the 'Eventual' application, which brings all these elements into one platform, making the planning process easier and more efficient. Original: الإلهام لهذه المشكلة جاء من الحاجة الملحوظة في المجتمع البحريني لوجود أداة شاملة تسهّل عملية التخطيط للمناسبات. الكثير من الأفراد والشركات يواجهون تحديات في تنظيم المناسبات بسبب تعقيد التفاصيل المتعددة والمتداخلة مثل اختيار الدعوات، المصورين، خدمات الضيافة، الزينة، وغيرها. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، هناك نقص في الأدوات التي تجمع جميع هذه الخدمات في مكان واحد. من خلال تحليل السوق، لاحظت أن العديد من التطبيقات الموجودة لا تقدم حلولًا متكاملة أو مصممة خصيصًا لاحتياجات المجتمع المحلي. هذا الفجوة دفعتني لتطوير تطبيق “Eventual” الذي يجمع جميع هذه العناصر في منصة واحدة، مما يجعل عملية التخطيط أكثر سهولة وكفاءة.
Keywords: event planning, event management app, invitation cards, service booking, Bahrain

Project: تطبيق (حُر)
Problem: Bahraini youth possess many creative talents that, once they have the opportunity to master them, they turn into services they provide to clients for a suitable financial fee, especially those who did not have the opportunity to get a job after graduation, so they invested their time and energy in adapting their talents and services and turning them into independent freelance work, becoming what is called 'freelancers'. But despite that, they may not reach the intended audience, and potential clients cannot reach them due to weak marketing ability and other reasons that may hide many suitable clients from them. At the same time, who among us today has not contacted a photographer for photography for graduation parties, weddings, or other occasions? And who among us has not searched for a designer to design invitation cards, a logo for a project, or Instagram content design, and so on? Project: Recomposed
Problem: In Bahrain, businesses are not required to pay for their waste disposal, which results in large quantities of food waste ending up in landfills. This contributes to environmental degradation, producing harmful methane emissions and taking up valuable space.

Inspiration: Making my own compost from food waste in both London and Bahrain. I did not use a machine for this instead I did it the natural way by combining different natural materials over time to form compost.
Keywords: food waste recycling, compost, financial incentives, landfill reduction, sustainability

Project: Sparrow
Problem: Global trade relies heavily on shipping - yet every year accidents and operational issues cost billions of dollars. Maritime operational issues for personal, vessels & cargo disrupts global supply chains - causing delayed routes, avoidable accidents and increased CO2 emissions. Together, they improve decision-making, reduce downtime, and boost profitability while optimizing crew performance and safety. Project: FixMyRide
Problem: The auto industry, particularly in the MENA region, faces a significant gap in digitalization, leaving companies like garages, car rentals, and spare parts suppliers struggling to efficiently reach and serve their customers. Customers, on the other hand, are left frustrated by the traditional, often not transparent process of finding trusted car services, rentals, and spare parts. Whether it’s the inability to locate a reliable garage, long wait times for rescue cranes, or the inconvenience of physically searching auto parts. these pain points create inefficiency, reduce customer satisfaction, and limit business growth. FixMyRide bridges this gap by offering a centralized platform where businesses can showcase their services, and customers can access everything they need—car rentals, repair shops, and parts—with just a few clicks. This not only simplifies the customer experience but also empowers businesses to grow through digital transformation.
Solution: Introducing FixMyRide, we are revolutionizing the auto industry by bridging the gap between businesses and customers through a streamlined digital platform. - For Businesses: We offer a centralized digital platform that enables businesses to manage and promote their services efficiently, expand their customer base, and streamline their operations (inventory, bookings, payments). This reduces reliance on manual processes, lowers operational costs, and helps businesses adapt to the digital age. - For Customers: We provide a one-stop solution for car rentals, spare parts, and repair services, making it easier for customers to find, compare, and book what they need with transparency and convenience. Our platform also introduces trust-building features like ratings, reviews, and upfront pricing, along with multiple payment options, including financing, to ease financial burdens.
Inspiration: The inspiration for FixMyRide came from my personal connection to the auto industry, having worked with my father, who’s been in the business for over 40 years. I witnessed firsthand how outdated and disconnected the industry is from digital solutions, with businesses struggling to efficiently reach customers, and customers facing a hard process to find services or parts. The inspiration for this business came to me when I personally experienced the frustration of being overcharged for a simple car repair because I was in a rush. On top of that, I had to visit five different places in the summer heat just to find fair pricing. This highlighted the lack of transparency in the industry, where there’s no easy way to compare prices or book services online. With FixMyRide, We aim to bring digital transformation to the auto sector, making it more convenient, transparent, and profitable for both businesses and customers.
Keywords: auto industry, digital platform, car rentals, spare parts, repair services

As in result, large companies that rely on diesel powered machinery will be able switch to an eco-friendly alternative (biodiesel) whilst reducing oil waste generated by resturants.
Solution: Current technology used to recycle waste cooking oils are complex and expensive. Therefore, to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and other forms of pollution an automated biodiesel production system will be developed. In addition, a supply chain that provides recyclable waste oil and the necessary equipment will be established to encourage large companies to transition from conventional fuel with eco-friendly biodiesel.
Inspiration: A few years ago, I stumbled upon such system through research and found it interesting. With that, I decided to expand my knowledge in the topic by taking it as a challenge for my senior project (Thesis) and discovered that it has high potential in limiting climate change when optimized. Keywords: biodiesel production, waste cooking oil, automated system, eco-friendly diesel, supply chain

Project: Spot Me
Problem: The target group for this project is all people who carry a phone. The problem: Through my observation of the daily activities we do, I concluded that we are unable to communicate except with people we know or who are registered in our contact list, but we may need to communicate with people we don't know once to perform a certain service at a specific time. For example, let's assume Mohammed is looking for a parking spot for his car in a crowded place, and he might pass by a full parking spot, and five seconds after Mohammed passes, this person leaves the spot. In this case, Mohammed lost time because he couldn't communicate with the second person. Another example: Let's assume a university student had a severe health issue, but among the people around him in the class, not one knows how to do first aid, but there is a person in the university who has the ability to save this student, but because of our inability to communicate with this person we don't know, the student's condition deteriorated very badly. Third example: Let's assume a person is looking for a rare item in a commercial store. In the normal situation, this person would call from store to store or search store to store to find this item. But what if the owner of the item could attract the customer with the push of a button? Original: الفئة المستهدفة لهذا المشروع هم جميع الاشخاص الذين يحملون الهاتف. المشكلة: من خلال ملاحظتي للانشطة اليومية التي نقوم بها استنتجت اننا غير قادرين على التواصل الا مع الاشخاص الي نعرفهم او مسجلين عندنا في قائمة الاتصال و لكن قد نحتاج الى التواصل مع اشخاص ما نعرفهم لمرة واحدة للقيام بخدمة معينة في وقت معين ، فمثلاً لنفترض محمد ادور موقف لسيارته في محل مزدحم و قد يمر على موقف ممتلأ و بعد خمس من ثواني من مرور محمد هذا الشخص يطلع من الموقف ، ففي هل الحالة محمد خسر وقت بسبب ان هو ما كان قادر يتواصل مع الشخص الثاني. مثال آخر: لنفترض ان طالب في جامعة صادته وعكة صحية حادة و لكن من بين الاشخاص الي حوالينه في الصف ما في ولا واحد يعرف اسوي اسعافات اولية و لكن هناك شخص ما موجود في الجامعة عنده امكانية انقاذ هذا الطالب و لكن بسبب عدم قدرتنا على التواصل مع هذا الشخص الي ما نعرفه تدهورت حالة الطالب بشكل سيئ جداً، مثال ثالث: لنفترض ان شخص يبحث عن بضاعة نادرة في محل تجاري، في الوضع الطبيعي هذا الشخص بيتصل لمحل محل او بدور على محل محل عشان احصل هذي البضاعة، بس ماذا لو صاحب البضاعة يقدر يجذب العميل بضغطة زر
Solution: The solution is an application through which you can send a message within a specific range so that it reaches all the people in that range. For example, in the first example above, Mohammed can specify the range of people he wants to send the message to on the map and write in the message that he is looking for a parking spot. So, for example, if we assume Mohammed is going to Manama Souq, he will specify the area within a range of 10 meters from Manama Souq, so that the message reaches all the people in that specific area. Okay, now we might ask, what would attract the parking spot owner to respond to Mohammed? Simply, Mohammed can send a material gift to the person who responds to him or helps him. In the second example, one of the people in the class can send a message saying we need someone who knows first aid within the university range, and this news will reach everyone in the university, and through that we can get someone to help the student as quickly as possible. In the third example, the person looking for the item can send a message within a specific range to accounts classified as commercial stores, and in this way, the commercial store that has the item can notify that the item is available, and in this way the application matches people who have the service with people who need it. Original: الحل هو عبارة تطبيق يمكنك من خلاله ارسال مسج ضمن نطاق محدد بحيث يوصل لكل الاشخاص الموجودين في هذا النطاق، فمثلاً في المثال الاول الي فوق يستطيع محمد تحديد نطاق الاشخاص الي يبي يوصل ليهم المسج على الخريطة و يكتب في المسج ان هو يدور موقف لسيارته فمثلاً لو افترضنا ان محمد رايح سوق المنامة فبحدد المنطقة ضمن نطاق ١٠ امتار من سوق المنامة، بحيث يوصل المسج لكل الاشخاص الموجودين في هذي المنطقة المعينة، اوك احين يمكن نتسائل وش الي بيجذب صاحب البارك ان يرد على محمد؟ بكل بساطة محمد يقدر اطرش هدية مادية للشخص الي برد عليه او بحارسه. في المثال الثاني يستطيع احد من الاشخاص الي في الصف ارسال مسج بإن نحتاج احد يعرف اسعافات اولية ضمن نطاق الجامعة، فبيوصل لكل شخص في الجامعة هذا الخبر و من خلال ذلك بنقدر نحصل واحد اساعد الطالب بأسرع وقت. في المثال الثالث يستطيع الشخص الي يبحث عن البضاعة ان يطرش مسج ضمن نطاق معين للحسابات الي مصنفة كمحلات تجارية و بهذي الطريقة المحل التجاري الي عنده البضاعة يقدر يعطي خبر ان البضاعة متوفرة عنده و بهذي الطريقة بوفق التطبيق بين الاشخاص الي عندهم الخدمة و الاشخاص الي يحتاجونها

Project: EINK
Problem: Our business aims to address the significant environmental impact of traditional display technologies and the inefficiencies associated with high-energy consumption. Conventional screens, such as LCDs and LEDs, consume substantial amounts of power, contribute to electronic waste due to their short lifespan, and often require frequent replacements. This results in increased energy use, higher operational costs, and greater environmental degradation from electronic waste. Additionally, the production and disposal processes of these displays can be harmful to the environment. By focusing on e-ink technology, we provide a more sustainable alternative that significantly reduces energy consumption, extends product lifespan, and minimizes waste, contributing to a greener, more eco-friendly technological ecosystem.
Solution: Our solution leverages e-ink display technology to address the environmental and efficiency issues posed by traditional displays. E-ink displays consume minimal power by only using energy when changing the content, resulting in significantly lower energy use compared to LCDs and LEDs. Their reflective nature reduces light pollution and eliminates the need for backlighting, further decreasing energy consumption. Additionally, e-ink displays have a longer lifespan and are made from sustainable materials, which reduces electronic waste and minimizes the environmental impact of production and disposal. By offering a more durable, energy-efficient, and eco-friendly display solution, we tackle the problems of high energy use and electronic waste, promoting a more sustainable future.
Inspiration: Our inspiration to address this problem stems from a growing awareness of the environmental impact of technology and the need for more sustainable solutions. Observing the substantial energy consumption and rapid obsolescence of traditional display technologies, combined with their contribution to electronic waste, highlighted a significant area for improvement. Additionally, personal experiences with eye strain and the limitations of conventional screens in bright environments underscored the need for a better alternative. E-ink technology, with its low power consumption, superior readability in sunlight, and minimal environmental footprint, emerged as a compelling solution. This drove our commitment to developing and promoting technologies that not only meet the demands of modern applications but also contribute to a more sustainable and eco-friendly future.
Keywords: e-ink displays, energy efficiency, electronic waste reduction, sustainable technology, low power consumption

project_name: Carpooling App for University Students in Bahrain
text:
Project: Carpooling App for University Students in Bahrain
Problem: My business addresses the transportation challenges faced by students after universities halted bus services. With rising car ownership costs, expensive taxis, and Uber fares, many struggle to attend classes. Additionally, increased personal vehicle usage leads to traffic jams and longer commutes, further hindering academic success and student well-being.
Solution: My carpooling solution reduces the number of cars on the road, alleviating traffic and commute times. Car owners can earn money by providing affordable rides to those without transportation, fostering connections among students. This initiative not only enhances accessibility to university but also strengthens the campus community, benefiting everyone.
Inspiration: As a university student, I've witnessed my peers struggle with transportation after bus services were halted. Experiencing these challenges inspired me to create a solution. My participation in the Mastercard Challenge, where I reached the top 5, boosted my confidence that this idea can truly make a difference.
Keywords: carpooling, student transportation, commute costs, traffic reduction, university access

Project: Convolute Technologies
Problem: Enterprises across various industries face significant challenges when deploying and scaling large language models (LLMs). These challenges include managing high compute costs, ensuring low-latency model inference, and fine-tuning models for specific use cases. The process of setting up and maintaining the necessary technical infrastructure is complex and resource-intensive, often diverting focus from core business objectives. Additionally, in sectors such as finance, security and compliance are critically important. Enterprises must deploy on custom, secure infrastructures, including private clouds, to protect sensitive data and adhere to strict cybersecurity standards, further increasing operational complexity.
Solution: Our platform solution, Servable, offers scalable, secure infrastructure for deploying and managing large language models (LLMs), along with an integrated LLM API for seamless access. We tackle key challenges like compute resource management, low-latency inference, and model fine-tuning—all at a lower cost than industry alternatives. Enterprises can deploy LLMs on custom infrastructures, including private clouds, ensuring full control over security and compliance. By combining robust infrastructure with an easy-to-use API, our solution enables businesses and enterprise development teams to focus on innovation while we manage the technical complexities of LLM deployment and serving.
Inspiration: What inspired me to tackle this problem was my own experience trying to self-serve a fine-tuned LLM—it was way more complicated and expensive than I expected. During my internship at a large financial institution, I also saw firsthand how much enterprises needed a smoother way to deploy and manage LLMs for their internal use. That’s when I realized there was a huge gap in the market, and I wanted to build something that would make this process easier and more affordable.
Keywords: llm deployment, infrastructure, private cloud, model inference, fintech

Project: Makerz
Problem: The problem Makerz solves is that traditional children’s furniture is often static, quickly outgrown, and lacks interactive engagement. Parents struggle to find long-lasting, adaptable furniture that supports their child’s growth while also fostering creativity and independence. Many families want meaningful ways to bond with their children but often face time constraints and limited options for interactive, hands-on experiences. Makerz addresses these issues by offering modular, puzzle-like furniture that grows with the child and provides a fun, collaborative building experience that parents and children can enjoy together.
Solution: Makerz offers modular, puzzle-like furniture that evolves as a child grows, solving the problem of outgrown, static furniture. The furniture is customizable, allowing parents and children to assemble it together, creating a hands-on, bonding experience. As children grow, families can add new pieces, ensuring the furniture adapts to their changing needs. This promotes creativity, independence, and problem-solving skills in children while providing parents with an engaging way to connect with them. By offering a long-lasting and flexible solution, Makerz eliminates the need for frequent furniture replacements and creates lasting memories for families.
Inspiration: Mohammed was inspired to address this problem after seeing firsthand the challenges parents, like his brother Ali and their family, face when it comes to finding long-lasting, adaptable furniture for children. Traditional furniture is often quickly outgrown, and the constant need to upgrade can be frustrating and costly. As a father, Ali's experience highlighted how important it is to have products that grow with the child and provide bonding opportunities through shared activities. This personal connection to the issue, combined with a passion for creating family-focused solutions, motivated Mohammed to turn this idea into a reality with Makerz.
Keywords: modular furniture, children's furniture, puzzle-like, parent-child bonding, adaptable design

Project: Rent It
Problem: Rent It: A Marketplace for Efficient Resource Allocation ‘Rent It’ is a distinctive app that aims to address the problem of inefficient resource allocation emphasized by underutilized assets. In other words, Rent It targets companies that are not able to reach a wider range of consumers. Furthermore, individuals have items of value that are not used regularly. These unused assets can lead to clutter, storage costs, and missed opportunities for generating income.
Solution: ‘Rent It’ provides a simple way of creating a hub where businesses and consumers can rent out items, effectively monetizing their unused resources. This enables companies to expand their customer base and increase revenue. By providing a user-friendly platform, ‘Rent It’ connects individuals and businesses with the resources they require. App users can easily find items for rent, while lenders can monetize their unused assets. This helps to declutter living spaces and reduce storage costs as well as promote a more sustainable and efficient economy. ‘Rent It’ is not only entailed to empowering businesses in reaching a wider range of customers and expanding their operations, but also individuals by generating alternative sources of income leading to improved living standards.
Inspiration: As founders of Rent It, we are constantly driven by a vision of a more active and opportunistic economy. We strongly believe that our platform can withhold reducing waste, promoting resource sharing, and empowering individuals and businesses. As founders, we aim to accomplish the satisfaction of contributing to a positive change that would persist. Lastly, this company is also built on an existing base of firm efforts in achieving sustainable development goals (SDGs), and triggering healthier living standards through economic and social visions (e.g. Vision 2030).
Keywords: rental marketplace, resource sharing, asset monetization, sustainable economy, underutilized assets

Project: Valor
Problem: Men’s casual clothing often appears neat and generic. These garments frequently feel mass-produced and devoid of character, lacking the unique qualities that make clothing special. The value of these clothes has been detached from the essential elements of fabric quality and tailoring cuts. As a result, customers miss out on the rich texture of premium fabrics and the precise fit.
Solution: VALOR provides men’s casual clothing made from natural fabrics with rich, visible textures. The designs are inspired by old warriors’ attire, ensuring a practical and well-fitted look. The clothing features unique but not odd designs, incorporating embroidered patterns that blend old fashion elements with modern styles. These pieces are compatible with contemporary outfits, offering a distinctive character while maintaining comfort and timeless appeal.
Inspiration: Recognizing the limited options for men's casual clothing and driven by personal desire to see this unique and practical style available on shelves.
Keywords: men's casual clothing, natural fabrics, embroidery, tailoring, warrior-inspired

Project: Academity
Problem: Sports enthusiasts are unaware of the variety of sports offered in Bahrain, including those for different genders, ages, classes, and so on. Even if they are aware of the existence of these sports, the poor SEO in this area makes it difficult for them to search for and enroll in the suitable sports academy for them, which regrettably deters many of them from participating in any sports. However, those already enrolled also experience frustrations due to the lack of efficient systems for communication, such as updates on class schedules or subscription renewals. This issue has a ripple effect, causing dissatisfaction among players and academies alike. Moreover, the absence of a supportive community network further isolates participants, decreasing motivation.
Solution: Currently, Academity, a sports application, offers a sports academy system that makes the process easier for these academies. We will be using our application to help address the other problems including the SEOs and being a communication hub for both players and academies. However, Academity aims to further research this area, which is crucial to enhance accessibility, streamline communication, and foster a sense of community among sports players. By addressing these gaps, we aim to discover ways to optimize academy systems and build stronger sports communities, ultimately improving user experiences and participation in sports activities across Bahrain.
Inspiration: Both my co-founder and I faced these problems first hand. As I was a football academy owner and my co-founder was a player and coach. Since we're both passionate about sports and have diverse backgrounds we began to research and take matters into our own hands by solving this problem for people just like us.
Keywords: sports app, academy management, seo, communication hub, community building

Project: the way studio
Problem: Bahrain is witnessing growth in small projects. However, it faces significant challenges represented in the lack of a supportive environment for marketing them. Many project owners face difficulty in finding a suitable place that provides photography and models with the necessary experience to highlight their products. The absence of support and a suitable environment discourages youth creativity and delays the growth of their projects. Losing important opportunities for economic development. The "The Way Studio" project aims to bridge this gap and provide practical solutions to these challenges by providing a creative space, allowing project owners the opportunity to showcase their creativity professionally. It connects project owners with a group of photographers and models. The project contributes to enhancing creativity and innovation among Bahraini youth and encouraging them to develop their projects. It also contributes to creating new job opportunities and stimulating the economy. The "The Way" project is an important step towards building a supportive environment for creativity and innovation in Bahrain, and it contributes significantly to empowering small and medium project owners to achieve their goals and develop their businesses. Project: Skillful
Problem: Children today are struggling to acquire the essential skills they need to grow and thrive, which is increasingly concerning for parents. With both parents often working full-time, finding the time or energy to teach their kids or take them to educational centers can be a real challenge. At the same time, children are spending more time online, leading to shorter attention spans and making traditional teaching methods less effective. Moreover, there's a significant lack of high-quality Arabic educational content that benefits chikdren and grap their attention. As a result, kids are falling behind in developing crucial skills for their future success.
Solution: Our solution is “Skillful,” an online platform that offers high-quality, engaging animated educational content aimed at helping children develop essential skills. By addressing the gap in Arabic content, Skillful provides a range of animated lessons in areas like language development, programming, handcrafts, and storytelling. Our platform makes learning fun and accessible anytime, anywhere. With Skillful, children can learn independently, empowering them to grow and succeed in a world where learning should be both enjoyable and effective.
Inspiration: The inspiration for "Skillful" came from my experience teaching children through animation and storytelling. I witnessed how this method not only captivates kids but also engages adults, proving its effectiveness in making learning both fun and interesting. Recognizing the significant lack of engaging, high-quality content for Arabic-speaking children, I felt driven to create something better. My vision is to build a world where every child can thrive, and families can trust that their kids are growing into what they need to be: kids full of skills.
Keywords: animated educational content, arabic content, children's skills, e-learning, skill development

Project: I need you bracelet
Problem: My target audience are parents/individuals who are a part of the deaf and mute community, and the problem that I’m solving is how those people communicate and deal with different hard situations such as raising newborns, toddlers or kids since they have a difficulty in hearing and talking. Example; at night while both the parents are a sleep the baby could cry and they would hear, so I’m designing a monitor that would solve this problem.
Solution: My solution is to create a 2 bracelet, one for the parent and one for the baby, whenever the baby is crying and the parent is a sleep it would vibrate and light up to alert the parent. And a gps tracker feature when the kid is all grown for the parent to have complete knowledge about the kid’s whereabouts in crowded and dangerous situations.
