Project: TaskLink
Problem: Many individuals face the challenge of finding reliable, local assistance for everyday tasks such as cleaning, moving, or home repairs. With busy schedules and limited resources, managing these responsibilities can become overwhelming and stressful. The difficulty in locating trustworthy help often results in frustration and unmet needs, leaving people feeling burdened by their obligations. This struggle highlights the need for a straightforward solution to connect users with dependable service providers in their communities.
Solution: TaskLink offers a user-friendly platform that connects individuals with vetted local Taskers for a wide range of tasks, including cleaning, moving, and home repairs. By simplifying the hiring process, it allows users to quickly find reliable help tailored to their specific needs. This service not only saves time but also alleviates stress, empowering individuals to manage their responsibilities more effectively. TaskLink ensures peace of mind by providing access to trustworthy service providers in their communities.
Inspiration: We, as Generation Z, rely heavily on social media and mobile apps for almost everything in our daily lives, from ordering food to booking a taxi, or even just chatting with friends. Our phones have become an essential part of how we function. So, when we think about moving into our own homes one day, it can be overwhelming. We worry about how we’ll keep the house clean, how we’ll handle issues like a broken A/C, or even a leaking pipe—things we might not know how to fix. I remember being on a family trip when our A/C at home started leaking badly. My grandfather was home alone, and it was really hard for him to deal with the situation. This made me realize how challenging it can be when things go wrong, especially for someone who may not know how to handle repairs or maintenance. This experience inspired us to create TaskLink—an app that brings the solution to these everyday problems straight to our phones. Whether it’s fixing something around the house or managing small tasks, TaskLink is designed to help people live worry-free, knowing they can handle any issue with just a few taps on their phone. It’s about making life easier for our generation, so we can focus on the things that really matter.
Keywords: task marketplace, home repair, cleaning, service booking, local assistance

Project: Undecided
Problem: Women in the area face the challenge of finding a suitable fitness center within their price range. They also face a challenge of finding post-workout nutrition at the same place.

Project: Nasij
Problem: . University students and women attending events often struggle to find abayas that suit their personal style and needs. Additionally, women face challenges when ordering abayas through platforms like Instagram, where communication with designers can be difficult, leading to issues in tracking their orders. The journey of searching for the right abaya takes a significant amount of time and effort, and options are often limited.
Solution: The online abaya incubator app will provide a comprehensive platform that connects customers with Bahraini designers, significantly simplifying the shopping experience. The platform will allow users to browse a wide range of abayas, customize them according to their needs, and order directly from designers, saving time and effort in the search process. Additionally, features for order tracking and streamlined communication with designers will enhance user experience and ensure customer satisfaction. This platform will also increase the visibility of local designers’ brands, providing them with greater opportunities for growth and expansion in the market.

I recognized a gap in the market, where many Bahraini designers need a platform to enhance their visibility and help customers easily access their designs. Additionally, the shift towards online shopping and social media reflects the potential to create an innovative solution that simplifies this experience , I also aspire to support local designers and increase awareness of their brands, thereby enriching the creative culture in Bahrain.
Keywords: abaya shopping, online marketplace, bahraini designers, customization, order tracking

Project: Parts & Fix
Problem: Car owners often encounter significant difficulties in finding reliable car parts and trusted repair services due to a fragmented market. This leads to confusion, wasted time, and inconsistent service quality. Additionally, price discrepancies and limited access to trustworthy vendors make it harder for customers to make informed, confident decisions about their car maintenance.
Solution: Parts & Fix provides a streamlined solution for car owners by offering a centralized platform for spare parts and repair services. Users receive competitive pricing for genuine and aftermarket car parts from multiple vendors without needing to compare prices themselves. Additionally, the app features a convenient fixing function, allowing customers to book trusted repair services directly. This integration ensures a hassle-free experience for car maintenance, saving users time and reducing the uncertainty typically associated with sourcing parts and finding reliable mechanics.
Inspiration: The inspiration to address this problem came from my personal experiences with the frustrations of finding reliable car parts and trustworthy repair services. I often found myself wasting time and facing uncertainty in sourcing what I needed. This motivated me to create a streamlined platform that simplifies car maintenance, saving others from similar challenges.

Project: Eventify
Problem: In Bahrain, planning events is often a chaotic and time-consuming process due to the absence of a centralized platform for booking venues and coordinating essential services. Event organizers must physically visit multiple halls to check availability and negotiate terms, which is both inefficient and exhausting. Additionally, sourcing reliable vendors for photography, catering, decoration, and entertainment involves extensive research and word-of-mouth recommendations, leading to inconsistencies and potential quality issues. This fragmented approach not only increases the risk of miscommunication and oversight but also adds unnecessary stress to the already demanding task of event planning. As a result, many events suffer from logistical challenges, budget overruns, and unmet expectations, leaving organizers feeling overwhelmed and dissatisfied.
Solution: **Eventify** is a streamlined event management app for Bahrain that simplifies planning. ### Key Features: 1. **Venue Booking**: Easily browse and book venues. 2. **Vendor Marketplace**: Access vetted vendors for photography, catering, and entertainment. 3. **Planning Tools**: Manage guest lists, invitations, and RSVPs in one place. 4. **Budget Tracking**: Set budgets and monitor expenses. 5. **Local Compliance**: Get guidance on regulations and permits. 6. **Collaboration**: Invite team members to plan together. 7. **Customer Support**: Real-time assistance for planning challenges. ### Conclusion **Eventify** transforms event planning by centralizing all essential tools, making it easier to create memorable events in Bahrain.
Inspiration: The inspiration to address the problem of event management in Bahrain stemmed from personal experiences while planning an event. I found the process of coordinating with multiple vendors and managing all the necessary services to be time-consuming and cumbersome. This led to the realization that there is a need for a centralized platform that can streamline the event planning process by providing access to all required services in one place. Recognizing the lack of such a comprehensive solution in the Bahrain market further fueled my motivation to create a centralized event management app that would simplify and enhance the event planning experience for users in the region.
Keywords: event planning, venue booking, vendor marketplace, budget tracking, event management app

Project: RihlaPool
Problem: University students face transportation challenges that impact their daily lives and academic success. Car owners incur high costs from fuel and maintenance, while those without cars often rely on unreliable public transportation. Additionally, traffic jams lead to difficulties in reaching classes on time, adding stress and affecting overall performance.
Solution: Our app connects university students for ride-sharing, allowing those with cars to offer affordable rides while earning money. It features a rewards program to incentivize participation. By promoting carpooling, we reduce traffic congestion and the number of cars on the road, addressing both transportation costs and commute times effectively.
Inspiration: As a university student, I have personally witnessed my peers struggle with transportation issues, often unable to afford daily taxi or Uber rides. The frustrating traffic jams further delay their arrival to classes, impacting their academic performance. Conducting a survey revealed that 80% of students face similar challenges, motivating me to find a solution.
Keywords: ride-sharing, university students, carpooling, rewards program, transportation

Project: carecollect
Problem: Individuals face barriers to healthcare access for blood sample collection, including long wait times, inconvenient travel, and anxiety about medical procedures. Busy schedules and confusion about necessary tests further complicate the situation, leading to missed appointments and delayed diagnoses, ultimately hindering effective health management and compromising overall well-being.
Solution: CareCollect addresses healthcare access barriers by providing convenient at-home blood sample collection, eliminating long wait times and travel challenges. Our professional technicians ensure a comfortable experience, while timely sample delivery to your preferred location simplifies the process. This approach promotes proactive health management and enhances overall patient well-being.
Inspiration: Having worked in a collection center unit, I witnessed firsthand the challenges patients face, including long wait times, anxiety, and the inconvenience of traveling to labs in not all tests are done in one lab. Keywords: english learning, robot tutor, language education, interactive learning, educational robot

Project: هوية رقمية ذكية للكتب الإلكترونية
Problem: The publishing industry faces a major challenge represented in the spread of piracy and illegal copying of e-books, which negatively affects the rights of authors and publishers. This causes loss of financial revenues and reduces the economic value of books. In the absence of an effective system to track unauthorized copies, it is difficult to hold violators accountable, leading to lack of protection of intellectual property. Original: تواجه صناعة النشر تحديًا كبيرًا يتمثل في انتشار القرصنة ونسخ الكتب الإلكترونية بشكل غير قانوني، مما يؤثر سلبًا على حقوق المؤلفين ودور النشر. يتسبب هذا في فقدان الإيرادات المالية ويقلل من القيمة الاقتصادية للكتب. في ظل غياب نظام فعّال لتتبع النسخ غير المصرح بها، يصعب محاسبة المخالفين، مما يؤدي إلى عدم حماية الملكية الفكرية.
Solution: I will develop a "smart digital ID card" for each e-book, linked to each copy and user. The card will contain unique identification information including the buyer's identity and a digital signature. By integrating artificial intelligence technologies, this card will be able to quickly track stolen copies and analyze illegal distribution patterns, helping to protect intellectual property rights and increase individual responsibility for circulating copies. Original: سأقوم بتطوير "بطاقة تعريف رقمية ذكية" لكل كتاب إلكتروني، ترتبط بكل نسخة ومستخدم. ستحتوي البطاقة على معلومات تعريفية فريدة تتضمن هوية المشتري وتوقيعًا رقميًا. من خلال دمج تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي، ستتمكن هذه البطاقة من تتبع النسخ المسروقة بسرعة، وتحليل أنماط التوزيع غير القانونية، مما يساعد في حماية حقوق الملكية الفكرية وزيادة المسؤولية الفردية عن النسخ المتداولة
Inspiration: I want to author a book, but I am afraid that my book will be published illegally. Original: اريد ان أألف كتابا و لكنني متخوفة من ان ينشر كتابي بطرق غير قانونية
Keywords: ebook piracy, digital id card, intellectual property, anti-piracy, tracking system

Project: Brew&Sip
Problem: Although tea is an integral part of our local culture and is widely consumed, the market has seen little innovation. Specialty teas and high-quality loose-leaf blends have yet to gain the same traction as seen in the coffee sector.
Solution: Brew&Sip provides a diverse selection of premium loose-leaf teas that combine traditional flavors with modern innovation. We are also the first to introduce cold brew tea in Bahrain, offering a unique and innovative experience to the region. Brew&Sip aims to modernize the local perspective on tea blends from traditional basic tea into a more interactive, colorful and diverse product in the form of unique loose leaf tea blends.
Inspiration: I have a deep love for tea and want to share its diverse flavors, aromas and health benefits with others. Tea is an inherent part of our culture and tradition and we want to celebrate and preserve that while brining our unique touch of innovation through our blends.
Keywords: loose-leaf tea, specialty tea, cold brew tea, tea blends, tea innovation

Project: Muff

Project: clickin
Problem: The problem faced by the target segment (small and medium project owners, photographers, photography studios, and fashion models) is the difficulty of finding suitable entities for professional photography at reasonable prices and at the right time. They also face challenges in organizing bookings and finding unknown photographers and studios that provide high quality. My platform will solve this problem by bringing these parties together on one platform that facilitates the search, booking, and collaboration process between them, while offering services at fixed prices and a points system to incentivize customers. Original: المشكلة التي تواجهها الشريحة المستهدفة (أصحاب المشاريع الصغيرة والمتوسطة، المصورين، استوديوهات التصوير، وعارضي الأزياء) هي صعوبة العثور على جهات مناسبة للتصوير الاحترافي بأسعار معقولة وفي الوقت المناسب. كما يواجهون تحديات في تنظيم الحجوزات وإيجاد مصورين واستوديوهات غير معروفة توفر جودة عالية. منصتي ستحل هذه المشكلة من خلال تجميع هذه الأطراف في منصة واحدة تسهل عملية البحث، الحجز، والتعاون بينهم، مع تقديم خدمات بأسعار ثابتة ونظام نقاط لتحفيز العملاء.
Solution: Creating a digital platform that brings together photography studios, photographers, and fashion models in one place, so that project owners can book photography services easily and effectively. The platform will allow users to: 1. Quick Search: The ability to browse photographers and photography studios based on location, price, and skills. 2. Unified Booking System: Facilitating the booking process through one platform, saving time and reducing logistical complexities. 3. Rating and Review System: To allow customers to rate services, increasing trust between parties. 4. Loyalty Points Program: Each booking allows collecting points that can be exchanged for free services or future discounts. 5. Fixed Prices: Providing unified packages to provide clear options for the customer. This solution will reduce the effort spent on searching and communicating and help find competitive options at reasonable prices. Original: إنشاء منصة رقمية تجمع بين استوديوهات التصوير، المصورين، وعارضي الأزياء في مكان واحد، بحيث يمكن لأصحاب المشاريع حجز خدمات التصوير بسهولة وفعالية. المنصة ستتيح للمستخدمين: 1. البحث السريع: إمكانية تصفح المصورين واستوديوهات التصوير بناءً على الموقع، السعر، والمهارات. 2. نظام الحجوزات الموحد: تسهيل عملية الحجز عبر منصة واحدة، مما يوفر الوقت ويقلل من التعقيدات اللوجستية. 3. نظام تقييمات ومراجعات: للسماح للعملاء بتقييم الخدمات مما يزيد من الثقة بين الأطراف. 4. برنامج نقاط ولاء: كل حجز يتيح جمع نقاط يمكن استبدالها بخدمات مجانية أو تخفيضات مستقبلية. 5. أسعار ثابتة: تقديم بكجات موحدة لتوفير خيارات واضحة للعميل. هذا الحل سيقلل من الجهد المبذول في البحث والتواصل ويساعد في إيجاد خيارات تنافسية بأسعار معقولة.
Inspiration: I was one of the models who suffered in finding a time suitable for all parties - the photographer and the studio - and I also suffered from not finding new places or service providers who haven't appeared yet. The platform encourages them to showcase their talents faster and find a source of income from their talent, and to make the places that allow photography available to them more widely. Original: كنت من العارضين الذي يعانون في ايجاد وقت يناسب جميع الاطراف المصور والاستودو ولي ايضآ غير ان توجد اماكن جديده او اصحاب الخدمات لم يظهرو بعد المنصة تشجعهم على اظهار مواهبهم بشكل اسرع و ايجاد مصدر دخل من موهبتهم و ظهور الاماكن التي تسمح بالتصوير لديهم بشكل اوسع
Keywords: photography platform, photographer booking, studio booking, fashion models, loyalty points

Project: Lati's Bakery
Problem: many people struggle to find affordable, high-quality baked goods that cater to specific dietary restrictions, such as gluten-free, vegan, or allergy-friendly options. Store-bought products are often mass-produced, lacking freshness, customization, and flavor variety. Additionally, those with food allergies or intolerances struggle to find options that suit their needs without being overpriced or compromising on taste. The demand for personalized, locally-made, fresh baked goods is growing, but access to these tailored options remains limited, creating a gap for people seeking satisfying and safe treats.
Solution: A bakery that specializes in creating personalized, fresh, and affordable baked goods tailored to various dietary needs, including gluten-free, vegan, and allergy-friendly options. By offering customizable recipes and using local, high-quality ingredients, the bakery ensures that customers with dietary restrictions can enjoy delicious, safe, and freshly made treats without sacrificing taste or paying premium prices. This approach provides a convenient, local alternative to mass-produced goods, ensuring that everyone can find satisfying baked items that meet their specific dietary preferences.
Inspiration: The inspiration came from seeing how hard it is for people with dietary restrictions to find tasty, affordable baked goods. Friends and family with gluten intolerance, vegan diets, or food allergies often struggle to enjoy treats without compromising on taste or health. This sparked the idea of a home bakery that provides fresh, customizable, and safe options for everyone.
Keywords: gluten-free, vegan, customized baked goods, allergy-friendly, home bakery

Project: Ea.line
Problem: The target segment in the fashion industry faces the problem of the lack of high-end, customized clothing options at reasonable prices. Many customers suffer from difficulty in finding unique designs that reflect their personal style, leading to frustration and loss of confidence in market options. In addition, searching for hair styling and photography places may take a long time, up to several hours or even days, increasing the preparation pressure for special occasions. This lack of good options and time consumption may force them to buy ordinary clothes that do not meet their expectations, causing them a feeling of routine and lack of distinction. Original: تواجه الشريحة المستهدفة في صناعة الأزياء مشكلة عدم توفر خيارات ملابس راقية ومخصصة بأسعار معقولة. يعاني الكثير من العملاء من صعوبة في العثور على تصاميم فريدة تعكس أسلوبهم الشخصي، مما يؤدي إلى الإحباط وفقدان الثقة في خيارات السوق. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، قد يستغرق البحث عن أماكن تصفيف الشعر والتصوير وقتًا طويلاً، يصل إلى عدة ساعات أو حتى أيام، مما يزيد من ضغط التحضير لمناسبات خاصة. هذا النقص في الخيارات الجيدة وتكبد الوقت قد يجبرهم على شراء ملابس عادية لا تلبي توقعاتهم، مما يسبب لهم شعورًا بالروتين وعدم التميز.
Solution: The solution we propose is to create an incubator for high-end clothing projects, where we provide professional tailors to design custom clothing, in addition to a mini studio for the photography experience. We will also provide a dedicated space for hair styling and makeup, allowing clients to get integrated services in one place. This will reduce the time and effort required to achieve a distinctive look and enhance the experience of customers looking for excellence and innovation in their style. Thanks to this incubator, emerging designers will be able to access valuable resources and a support network that helps them succeed in the market. Original: الحل الذي نقترحه هو إنشاء حاضنة للمشاريع الخاصة بالملابس الراقية، حيث نوفر خياطين محترفين لتصميم الأزياء المخصصة، بالإضافة إلى استوديو مصغر لتجربة التصوير. سنوفر أيضًا مساحة مخصصة لتصفيف الشعر والمكياج، مما يتيح للعملاء الحصول على خدمات متكاملة في مكان واحد. هذا سيقلل من الوقت والجهد المطلوبين لتحقيق مظهر مميز، ويعزز من تجربة العملاء الباحثين عن التميز والابتكار في أسلوبهم. بفضل هذه الحاضنة، سيتمكن المصممون الناشئون من الوصول إلى موارد قيمة وشبكة دعم تساعدهم على النجاح في السوق.
Inspiration: Through my observation of the increasing needs of people for distinction and privacy in their clothes. In a world full of repeated options and ready-made clothes, it has become difficult for individuals to find designs that reflect their personal style. Also, my personal experience in preparing for special occasions, where I faced challenges in coordinating between various services, influenced my decision. I wanted to create a solution that provides an integrated and seamless experience, helping clients express themselves better and saving time and effort in the preparation process. Original: من خلال ملاحظتي للاحتياجات المتزايدة لدى الناس للتميز والخصوصية في ملابسهم. في عالم مليء بالخيارات المتكررة والملابس الجاهزة، أصبح من الصعب على الأفراد العثور على تصاميم تعكس أسلوبهم الشخصي. كما أن تجربتي الشخصية في التحضير لمناسبات خاصة، حيث كنت أواجه تحديات في التنسيق بين مختلف الخدمات، أثرت في قراري. أردت إنشاء حل يوفر تجربة متكاملة وسلسة، مما يساعد العملاء على التعبير عن أنفسهم بشكل أفضل وتوفير الوقت والجهد في عملية التحضير.
Keywords: custom clothing, incubator, tailoring, photography studio, styling services

Project: Cryptico
Problem: The target audience faces challenges in accessing global financial services, high costs for cross-border transactions, and slow processing times. Additionally, there's a lack of fintech innovation and concerns about privacy in traditional banking. Our company will solve this problem by offering cryptocurrency solutions and leveraging blockchain technology to enhance efficiency and security.
Solution: My solution is to create a cryptocurrency platform that makes global financial services more accessible. By leveraging blockchain technology, I will provide faster, more secure, and cost-efficient cross-border transactions. The platform ensures lower fees, enhances data privacy, and drives fintech innovation, solving issues of high costs, slow processes, and privacy concerns, giving users a seamless and secure financial experience.

Seeing the potential of blockchain to create secure, accessible, and efficient financial solutions motivated me to develop a platform that empowers users with better financial access and security.

Project: RoomView Studios
Problem: Clients struggle to explain what they want to interior designers properly because they don't know how to express what they want properly. Similarly, upon doing the projects, interior designers are unable to ask client for proper feedback for changes because the clients cannot see the designs in real time.
Solution: RoomView Studios is a software solution that allows clients to view their design in real time and make changes to textures, colors, and furniture using VR technology. The software will be sold to interior designers and companies. They can upload their 3D models in the software, and the clients can easily navigate it in 3D, change what they want in terms of design, and the designer can see what the clients want from their side without hassle. The potential market opportunity is big, with a large number of interior design companies operating in the region.
Inspiration: One of our founders (Sana's) sister is an interior designer and she noticed how she struggled to get accurate information about clients needs and desires in the design project because clients don't understand design technical plans and even renders are two dimensional and don't cover entire area of design. This led her to research about potential softwares that can gamify this problem but she did not find it, so we thought we can make this software to help both interior designers and clients.
Keywords: vr technology, interior design, real-time design, 3d models, client feedback

Project: Blue Dragon
Problem: The target audience for Blue Dragon Esports faces several challenges in the gaming industry. Many gamers in Bahrain struggle with high costs for gaming equipment and access to quality gaming venues. Additionally, there is a lack of educational resources about game development and hardware knowledge. Many aspiring gamers and streamers lack platforms to showcase their skills or participate in competitive events. By providing discounts, educational sessions, opportunities for esports participation, and hosting events, Blue Dragon Esports aims to create a more accessible and vibrant gaming ecosystem in Bahrain, addressing these critical gaps in the community.
Solution: Blue Dragon Esports offers a comprehensive solution to enhance Bahrain's gaming landscape. By introducing a discount card for gamers, we alleviate the financial burden of acquiring gaming equipment and accessing cafes. Our educational sector provides workshops on game development and hardware, empowering individuals with essential skills. Additionally, we create opportunities for gamers to engage in esports events, both locally and internationally, while providing platforms for streamers to grow their audience. Hosting tournaments and events fosters community engagement, bringing gamers together and promoting a thriving gaming culture. Together, these initiatives address the key challenges faced by our audience, transforming their gaming experience.
Inspiration: The inspiration to address the challenges in Bahrain's gaming industry stems from a deep passion for gaming and a desire to foster a vibrant community. Observing the struggles faced by local gamers—such as limited access to resources, high costs, and a lack of educational opportunities—highlighted the need for change.
Keywords: gaming ecosystem, esports events, discount card, game development workshops, gamer community

Project: I hear You (أسمعك)
Problem: Today the society of deaf and mute are depended on their family members or friends to help them in their lives from ordering food to asking for basic questions. As most of the people do not understand the sign language, In addition people don't even know their are multiple sign languages. This huge issue is not only causing separation between the communities but it is providing limited opportunities to these people and making them more dependent.
Solution: Introducing I hear you, an AI based web application that would be able to translate sign language to voice and vice versa. In addition to real time translation, people would be able to translate sign language to other languages. Using these features the cooperates would be able would be able to address more people. These features would be able to translate conferences, workshops and even TV shows.
Inspiration: In January this year I was organizing an event in Exhibition world Bahrain, where I meet a group of friends, all of the friends use sign language to communicate. when they asked me for help in finding the food court I was not able to understand them and even looking at them struggling to order food. This made me realize how blessed we are and I took this task to help them
Keywords: sign language translation, ai web application, deaf and mute, real-time translation, accessibility

Project: Double You
Problem: 1. Lack of opportunities for skill exchange: Individuals lack platforms that allow them to exchange and develop their skills effectively. 2. High cost of training courses: Many are unable to learn new skills due to the high costs of traditional training. 3. Lack of professional guidance: Many people need appropriate guidance to apply their skills professionally. 4. Project: Birch Energy
Problem: Massive amounts of greenhouse gas emissions from aluminium smelting processes and carbon dependency in the manufacturing, oil and gas industry. The aluminium waste produced during these processes are not being utilized effectively to create renewable energy sources. Prominent industries aim for net zero emission targets in the near future, however at our current pace, we will not be able to reach those net zero goals in time.
Solution: Birch Energy solves this by integrating carbon-free smelting technology with renewable energy sources to produce low-carbon aluminium. Through innovative inert anode technology, the smelting process is the second in the world to eliminate greenhouse gas emissions and generates oxygen as a byproduct product instead. Birch Energy also turns aluminum waste into clean hydrogen, providing an on-demand energy solution without the need for complex storage. With a circular economy model, aluminum waste is recycled into high-quality products, and energy storage systems ensure operational efficiency. Birch Energy not only reduces the carbon footprint of aluminum production but also positions itself as a sustainable partner for its relevant industries.
Inspiration: Having been a part of ALBA’s internship, I got to witness first-hand how the current manufacturing process and raw material waste gravely affects ALBA’s progress in sustainable practices, and in turn Bahrain’s progress as well. Ever since my internship, I have been researching ways to evolve and improve these manufacturing processes effectively and efficiently, whilst simultaneously adhering to the ESG/SDG/NetZero goals.
Keywords: aluminium smelting, carbon-free, inert anode, hydrogen production, circular economy

It guides organizations through the entire process, ensuring they can confidently meet all necessary sustainability reporting regulations without the immediate need to hire scarce and expensive specialized personnel.
Impact: Sustainability is a core pillar in Bahrain development , including having a Minister of Sustainable Development
Inspiration: the lack of ESG and sustainability expertise in Bahrain and the region.
Keywords: esg reporting, sustainability expertise, compliance, regulatory, digital expert

Project: Pearls of Bahrain
Problem: The pearl diving industry still relies on outdated, manual methods that haven’t changed for over a century. This leads to unpredictable yields, high labor costs, and inconsistent quality—problems that directly impact pearl traders. They struggle with limited supply, fluctuating quality, and inefficient sourcing. Our solution uses sea drones with AI-driven analysis and automated oyster pickup to identify and harvest pearl-bearing oysters more accurately and efficiently. This gives traders a more reliable, scalable, and cost-effective source of natural pearls, modernizing the supply chain without losing the value of tradition.
Solution: Our solution uses underwater drones equipped with AI and robotic arms to locate and collect oysters from known pearl-rich zones. This removes the need for manual diving, reduces operational risks, and significantly increases the speed and scale of harvesting. By automating collection, we give pearl traders access to more consistent and efficient sourcing of natural oysters, improving yield potential while cutting costs and human effort.
Impact: Our idea supports Bahrain’s development goals by modernizing a traditional industry with advanced technology, aligning with national strategies focused on innovation, economic diversification, and sustainability. By applying AI and robotics to pearl diving, we not only preserve a key part of Bahrain’s cultural heritage but also create opportunities for high-tech jobs, research, and exports. This positions Bahrain as a leader in combining heritage with forward-thinking solutions, in line with Vision 2030 and the broader economic transformation agenda.
Inspiration: Bahrain has a deep-rooted history in pearl diving, but the industry has barely evolved with modern technology. Seeing how such a culturally significant trade still relies on outdated, physically demanding methods inspired me to think of ways it could be modernized without losing its heritage. The idea of using drones and AI came from a desire to bridge tradition with innovation and help pearl traders access better tools and more sustainable practices.
Keywords: pearl diving, underwater drones, ai analysis, automated harvesting, oyster collection

Project: My Bridge
Problem: Many students/graduates have difficulties in searching and looking for work-experiences to kick-start their careers through internships and entry level jobs. but since these experiences are available in scattered platforms from linkedin, instagram and indeed which are all of them consist of unclear processes and lack of transparency from the application process, students and graduates became lost while taking hours to find a suitable opportunity to just apply to. Not only that, but 8/10 companies that we have interviewed in Bahrain are facing difficulties sourcing out candidates for these type of roles/position due to the lack of a clear system to recruit and hire, an example of that would be that HR representatives goes through each CV manually to analyse each candidate before requesting them for an interview instead of having an automated CV tracking system which analyse candidates CVs and breaks them down into columns based on relevant information for the recruiter.
Solution: In order to solve this, My Bridge will consist of two main systems catering to 2 target audiences, first is an application for students and graduates which will feature a marketplace for internships/entry level jobs, allowing users to easily search for these opportunities through filtering and categorizing with a simple application process which they attach to the application and goes directly to the CV tracking database for the companies (will be mentioned later). Not only that, but it will also feature live updates directly from the recruiters to showcase transparency and keeping the user updated once their application or cv is being reviewed, rejected or accepted. The second system, it will be an admin portal (a website) for companies, which will be mainly used to post and advertise these opportunities which will be directly shown to the talent pool that are actively looking within the application. It will also feature a CV tracking for the recruiters to easily source through CVs.
Impact: It supports the growth of the youth and younger generation, in addition to the economical benefit and localizing the market with work-ready bahrainis that are looking to build their careers
Inspiration: It started because I personally faced this issue during my studies in universities and through chatting to multiple colleagues through the last year, it has shown that it is a common issue for the students/graduates. and the bigger picture of it is that solving this will allow many individuals to gain work-experiences and qualify them to be placed into job roles that they are looking for.
Keywords: internship marketplace, job hunting, cv tracking, graduate, recruitment

Project: Project Neptune (H2Oasis)
Problem: In countries where bottled water jugs are the dominant source of drinking water like Bahrain, there is widespread skepticism toward tap water and filtered water solutions. This distrust, driven by concerns over water safety and quality, has led to a lack of adoption of more sustainable and cost-effective alternatives like fitted water dispensers.
Solution: The challenge lies not in the availability of filtration technology, but in consumer confidence. Many potential users doubt the effectiveness and cleanliness of built-in filtration systems, especially over time. To address this, our filtered water dispenser is designed with a transparent solution: it features easily replaceable water filters and built-in UV sterilization. and would be tested for safe drinking.
Impact: The idea supports Bahrain’s national development goals by promoting sustainability, public health, and infrastructure efficiency. It reduces reliance on single-use plastic bottles, lowering plastic waste and minimizing long-term health risks associated with plastic exposure. By eliminating the need for water delivery trucks and jugs, it also eases congestion on Bahrain’s heavily burdened road network. Moreover, it leverages and strengthens the existing water infrastructure, offering an innovative, eco-friendly alternative in a sector that has seen limited transformation.
Inspiration: Recently having to send in my water coolers for repair as they broke down made me think about alternative hydration solutions.
Keywords: water dispenser, uv sterilization, filter, tap water, bottled water

Impact: boosting local food production, supporting local farmers, Promoting Healthier Lifestyles (Aligning with National Health Goals), Eco-Friendly & Waste-Reduction Practices, As a homegrown bakery, I contribute to job creation, local entrepreneurship, and a vibrant F&B sector.

Project: farah
Problem: In light of the many occasions we have every year, such as weddings, graduations, birthdays, marriage contracts, or even a simple family gathering, questions increase among family and friends about the best services provided by various projects in the field of organizing events of different types. Sometimes the question expands to inquire about a specific service like photography or DJ on social media, leading to many random answers. Most of the time, recommendations do not match the occasion holder's vision in terms of services, the allocated budget, or even for discounts. text:
Project: Kat Koot (Digital Toy Platform Designed to Offer Sustainable Play for Kids)
Problem: Toys for kids are nowadays costly for most of the parents considering growing demand of the child for new toys as he/she grows in age. Furthermore, the use of the toys is limited as kids like to change toys after sometimes causing issues around storing the old toys. Almost 80% to 90% of the toys are made of plastic and around 1 million tons of plastic are used annually for toy production globally.
Solution: Kat Koot ... One-stop platform for economical, environment-friendly toy renting solution with no need to store toys at home anymore. The platform has multiple toy subscription plans to ensure availability and accessibility for all members. The platform provides diverse toys for children's evolving interests and stages with hassle-free solution for parents. This solution will reduce plastic consumption/waste and protect the environment. Kat Koot aims to redefine toy consumption via sustainable, accessible and enriching play experiences for families.
Impact: Kat Koot align with Bahrain's development plans in the following ways: 1. Promoting environmentally-friendly practices by reducing plastic waste and encouraging the reuse of toys and supporting the national goals for sustainability. 2. Contributing to diversifying the economy by promoting a new business model that creates job opportunities for youth in the logistics sectors. 3. Supporting the development of families by providing access to diverse educational toys and enhancing children's play experiences
Inspiration: I was inspired to create a toy rental platform after noticing the increasing demand for economic and sustainable toys solution in the region, helping families access to diverse toys at a reasonable price.
Keywords: toy rental, subscription, sustainability, plastic waste, children

Project: Thryv
Problem: Athletes and fitness enthusiasts struggle with inconsistent fitness and nutrition routines due to lack of personalization, motivation, and convenience. Many lack tailored meal plans, face time constraints for workout planning, while Coaches find it challenging to manage clients effectively across diverse needs, hindering progress and engagement.
Solution: Thryv AI Health App offers AI-driven, personalized meal plans with subscription-based delivery, dynamic workouts, and health tracking, solving convenience and consistency issues. Its features boost motivation, while the Coach module enables tailored client management, fostering engagement and progress for both Athletes and Coaches under Thryv’s unified platform.
Impact: Thryv aligns with Bahrain’s Vision 2030 by promoting a healthy lifestyle, a key economic pillar. It fosters innovation through AI technology, creates job opportunities in health tech, and supports local entrepreneurship, contributing to a knowledge-based economy and enhancing community well-being.

Personal experiences with inconsistent results and the potential of AI to transform health management motivated the creation of a unified, motivating platform like Thryv.

project_name: care in out of Bahrain cancer patients and other
text:
Project: care in out of Bahrain cancer patients and other
Problem: A carefully designed salon that cares about a woman's beauty and self-confidence. Our impact extends beyond mere external beauty, as we provide psychological support and special treatments for cancer patients, especially during the period of hair loss or after treatment, to help them regain their self-confidence and their sense of beauty and comfort. We believe that beauty is therapy, and caring for oneself is part of recovery. Therefore, we provide a warm, safe, and humane environment that combines the art of makeup and psychological care, with special experience in hair and skin care for women at different stages of their health journey. Original: صالون مصمم بعناية، يهتم بجمال المرأة وثقتها بنفسها. ويمتد أثرنا لأبعد من مجرد الجمال الخارجي، حيث نقدم دعماً نفسياً وعلاجات خاصة لمرضى السرطان، خصوصاً في فترة تساقط الشعر أو بعد العلاج، لنساعدهم على استعادة ثقتهم بأنفسهم وشعورهم بالجمال والراحة. نحن نؤمن أن الجمال علاج، والاهتمام بالنفس جزء من التعافي. ولذلك نوفر بيئة دافئة، آمنة، وإنسانية تجمع بين فن التجميل والرعاية النفسية، مع خبرة خاصة في العناية بالشعر والبشرة للنساء في مراحل مختلفة من حياتهن الصحية
Solution: Staff training: • Train salon workers to deal with them kindly and with understanding, without uncomfortable looks or questions. --- ✅ Secondly: Dedicated services for them 1. Treatments for damaged or falling hair: • Natural oils, restorative masks, plant protein. • Hairstyles suitable for bald spots or fine hair. 2. Hair alternatives (wig - elegant turban): • Provide high-quality wigs in modern styles. • A 'Try a New Style' session to help them accept the change. 3. Care for sensitive skin: • Use medical or natural fragrance-free products. • Hydration sessions, gentle lightening, and soothing masks. --- ✅ Thirdly: Implicit psychological support 1. A special free or symbolic-priced session every month: • For example, called 'Your Day, You' – includes pampering, light makeup, simple photography, and sweet hospitality. 2. A corner in the salon dedicated to stories of hope: • Displaying photos or words from recovering clients with encouraging messages. 3. Offering makeup sessions that boost morale: • Teach them how to highlight their features, especially if eyebrows or eyelashes were affected. Original: ريب الموظفات: • علّمي العاملات في الصالون كيف يتعاملون بلطف وتفهم، بدون نظرات أو أسئلة محرجة. ⸻ ✅ ثانياً: خدمات مخصصة لهم 1. علاجات للشعر المتضرر أو المتساقط: • زيوت طبيعية، ماسكات مرمّمة، بروتين نباتي. • قصات شعر مناسبة للفراغات أو الشعر الخفيف. 2. بدائل الشعر (باروكة - تربون أنيق): • وفري باروكات بجودة عالية بأشكال عصرية. • جلسة “تجربة ستايل جديد” تساعدهم يتقبلون التغيير. 3. عناية بالبشرة الحساسة: • استخدمي منتجات طبية أو طبيعية بدون عطور. • جلسات ترطيب، تفتيح بلطف، وماسكات مهدئة. ⸻ ✅ ثالثاً: دعم نفسي ضمني 1. جلسة خاصة كل شهر مجانية أو بسعر رمزي: • اسمها مثلاً “يومك أنتِ” – تتضمن دلال، مكياج خفيف، تصوير بسيط، ضيافة حلوة. 2. زاوية في الصالون مخصصة لقصص الأمل: • عرض صور أو كلمات من عميلات تعافين، برسائل تشجيعية. 3. تقديم جلسات مكياج ترفع المعنويات: • تعلميهم كيف يبرزون ملامحهم، خاصة لو تأثرت الحواجب أو الرموش.
Impact: My plan supports development in Bahrain because it helps a needy group of people psychologically and physically, provides humanitarian and innovative services, and opens job opportunities in the field of therapeutic beauty. Original: خطتي تدعم التنمية في البحرين لأنها تساعد فئة محتاجة من الناس نفسيًا وجسديًا، وتوفر خدمات إنسانية ومبتكرة، وتفتح فرص عمل في مجال التجميل العلاجي.
Inspiration: --- “What inspired me to start this service is my passion for beauty and my desire to help cancer patients regain their self-confidence. I saw how exhaustion changes their features, and I felt that beauty is not just a look, it is psychological support. From here, I decided to be part of their healing in my own way. Original: ⸻ “اللي ألهمني أبدأ هالخدمة، هو شغفي بالتجميل ورغبتي أساعد مرضى السرطان يسترجعون ثقتهم بنفسهم. شفت كيف التعب يغيّر ملامحهم، وحسيت إن الجمال مو بس شكل، هو دعم نفسي. ومن هنا، قررت أكون جزء من شفاءهم بطريقتي.
Keywords: salon, cancer patients, psychological support, hair care, beauty therapy

Project: AlWASEET
Problem: Of course, here is a more realistic and comprehensive formulation of the problem, while maintaining brevity and persuasiveness: --- Vehicle owners suffer daily from difficulty in finding suitable spare parts due to the fragmentation of the market among scattered, unconnected traditional stores, and the lack of accurate information about the compatibility of parts with the car's type and model. This leads to wasted time, purchasing inappropriate or non-original parts, as well as significant price variation and lack of transparency. Suppliers also suffer from difficulty in effectively reaching target customers. In the absence of a comprehensive technical solution, this suffering persists, despite the market being large and ripe for radical digital transformation. Original: بالطبع، إليك صياغة أكثر واقعية ومتكاملة للمشكلة، مع الحفاظ على الإيجاز والإقناع: --- يعاني أصحاب المركبات يوميًا من صعوبة في العثور على قطع الغيار المناسبة بسبب تشتت السوق بين متاجر تقليدية متباعدة غير مترابطة، وعدم توفر معلومات دقيقة عن مدى توافق القطع مع نوع وموديل السيارة. هذا يؤدي إلى هدر الوقت، وشراء قطع غير مناسبة أو غير أصلية، إضافة إلى تفاوت كبير في الأسعار، وغياب الشفافية. كما يعاني الموردون من صعوبة في الوصول إلى العملاء المستهدفين بفعالية. في ظل غياب حل تقني شامل، تظل هذه المعاناة قائمة، رغم أن السوق كبير ومهيأ للتحول الرقمي بشكل جذري.
Solution: Of course, here is the text after removing the second paragraph, while maintaining a logical sequence of solutions: --- The solution lies in creating a smart technical platform that connects vehicle owners with spare parts suppliers directly, accurately, and quickly. The platform starts by providing an advanced search system based on the VIN number or vehicle data to automatically identify compatible parts, reducing errors and ensuring a high compatibility rate. Then, the platform offers multiple payment and delivery options, including fast delivery services and installation options from certified workshops, making the experience comprehensive and convenient for the user. The platform also uses artificial intelligence to analyze user behavior and suggest parts they may need based on maintenance and purchase records, enhancing value and increasing customer satisfaction. On the other hand, the platform provides suppliers with digital tools to manage inventory, improve their visibility to target customers, and increase their sales in an organized and thoughtful manner. This solves the challenge from both sides and reorganizes a huge market suffering from chaos and randomness. Original: بالطبع، إليك النص بعد إزالة الفقرة الثانية، مع الحفاظ على تسلسل منطقي للحلول: --- الحل يكمن في إنشاء منصة تقنية ذكية تربط أصحاب المركبات بموردي قطع الغيار بشكل مباشر، دقيق، وسريع. تبدأ المنصة بتوفير نظام بحث متقدم يعتمد على رقم الهيكل (VIN) أو بيانات السيارة لتحديد القطع المتوافقة تلقائيًا، مما يقلل الأخطاء ويضمن توافق القطعة بنسبة عالية. ثم تتيح المنصة خيارات متعددة للدفع والتوصيل، تشمل خدمات التوصيل السريع وخيارات التثبيت من ورش معتمدة، مما يجعل التجربة متكاملة ومريحة للمستخدم. كما تستفيد المنصة من الذكاء الاصطناعي لتحليل سلوك المستخدم واقتراح قطع قد يحتاجها بناءً على سجل الصيانة والمشتريات، مما يعزز القيمة ويزيد من رضا العميل. على الجانب الآخر، توفر المنصة للموردين أدوات رقمية لإدارة المخزون، وتحسين ظهورهم للعملاء المستهدفين، وزيادة مبيعاتهم بشكل منظم ومدروس. هكذا يُحل التحدي من الطرفين، ويُعاد تنظيم سوق ضخم يعاني من الفوضى والعشوائية.

Project: TapAid
Problem: Many patients struggle with fragmented medical care due to disconnected hospital systems. When someone visits a different hospital or clinic, their medical history including diagnoses, medications, allergies, or chronic conditions is often inaccessible. This can delay treatment, cause dangerous errors, or lead to repeated tests. This bracelet addresses both problems: it provides instant access to the patient’s medical history and serves as an emergency contact tool, making critical information accessible with a simple NFC tap even if the person is unconscious or alone.

By simply tapping the bracelet with a smartphone, healthcare providers or bystanders can instantly access the patient’s diagnosis, medications, and emergency details. The bracelet bridges the gap between medical institutions and emergency scenarios, offering a portable, always-available health record that saves lives and provides peace of mind.

Project: Co-Find
Problem: Many startup journeys never begin not because the idea isn’t good, but because the founder can’t find the right person to build it with. Once connected, they can schedule a meeting directly through the platform. But we don’t stop at matching. Impact: CoFind aligns closely with Bahrain’s Economic Vision 2030 by fostering entrepreneurship, innovation, and private sector growth—key pillars of the Kingdom’s strategy to diversify its economy and reduce reliance on oil revenues. By enabling aspiring entrepreneurs to find compatible co-founders and access essential startup resources through a single digital platform, CoFind contributes to building a productive, globally competitive economy driven by a pioneering private sector. This approach supports Bahrain’s goal of raising a broad middle class of Bahrainis who enjoy good living standards through increased productivity and high-wage jobs. CoFind also empowers youth and first-time founders—groups central to Bahrain’s future workforce—by providing them with the tools and connections needed to launch and grow businesses. This initiative aligns with Vision 2030’s guiding principles of sustainability, fairness, and competitiveness, ensuring that every Bahraini has the means to live a secure and fulfilling life and reach their full potential. In essence, CoFind contributes to Bahrain’s transformation into a diversified, innovation-led economy by lowering barriers to entrepreneurship and supporting the development of a vibrant private sector. We also align with key SDGs such as: • SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth): By accelerating the formation of startups, we support job creation and economic diversification in Bahrain. • SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure): CoFind fuels innovation by enabling idea-stage founders to build tech and non-tech solutions through strategic partnerships and support systems.
Inspiration: The idea started from a personal pain point. As someone with a lot of business ideas, I constantly found myself stuck at the very beginning either lacking the skills to build the idea alone or simply needing someone to share the journey with. But with a limited circle, and people around me who weren’t as interested in business, finding a co-founder felt awkward, slow, and nearly impossible. When I spoke to other founders, I realized this wasn’t just my struggle it was theirs too. Many validated how difficult and discouraging the co-founder search can be, especially when you’re just getting started. As I explored the ecosystem further, another gap became clear: most aspiring founders in Bahrain aren’t aware of the programs, accelerators, or funding opportunities that exist. This lack of visibility stops a lot of great ideas from ever getting off the ground. CoFind was born to solve both problems by simplifying co-founder discovery and providing easy access to the tools, people, and support founders need from day one.

Consumers face expired snacks, slow checkouts, and limited fresh options, while businesses lose money to food waste and inefficient inventory management. Manual expiry tracking is error-prone, and 30-40% of perishables get discarded unsold. The result? Frustration for customers, lost revenue for vendors, and unnecessary waste.
Solution: grab-and-go retail with AI-powered smart fridges that let you simply take what you want and walk out—no scanning, no checkout lines, just instant payment via card, phone, or face recognition. Our system automatically tracks expiry dates using AI vision (no manual checks or RFID tags), applies smart discounts to nearly expired items, and locks out anything past its prime, ensuring every snack is fresh while cutting food waste by 85%. With real-time inventory updates, demand-based restocking alerts, and optional auto-donation of unsold food, SwiftSaver delivers seamless convenience for consumers and effortless efficiency for vendors—perfect for offices, gyms, and transit hubs.
Impact: My AI smart vending machines directly support Bahrain's Vision 2030 by tackling food waste through tech innovation, aligning with the kingdom's sustainability goals. They modernize retail with cashless, contactless solutions that enhance food security and support local suppliers, while creating smarter, more efficient shopping experiences across Bahrain's growing smart cities and tourism sector
Inspiration: Wasted food and frustrating purchases annoyed me. I saw a smarter way—AI that ensures freshness, eliminates checkout lines, and cuts waste. No more expired snacks or lost profits. Just seamless, sustainable vending. That’s why I built this.
Keywords: smart vending, ai-powered fridges, food waste reduction, cashless checkout, real-time inventory

Project: Pearls bay
Problem: The natural pearl industry faces major challenges: traditional diving is dangerous, slow, and requires rare expertise, while cultured pearls have flooded the market, leaving natural pearls scarce and difficult to source. Locating them manually is costly, inefficient, and unsustainable. Our business solves this by deploying AI-powered sea drones that scan and identify wild oyster beds, making the process more economical, efficient, and effective. This approach reduces human risk, preserves marine ecosystems, and revives Bahrain’s pearl heritage with cutting-edge precision.
Solution: Our solution uses advanced underwater drones equipped with AI and computer vision to locate, assess, and harvest natural pearl oysters in the sea. The drones operate with precision, reducing the need for manual diving and minimizing environmental disruption. This makes the pearl collection process significantly more economical, efficient, and effective. By automating search and extraction, we lower operational costs, improve yield accuracy, and revive the natural pearl trade in a sustainable, tech-driven way.
Impact: Our idea advances Bahrain’s legacy as the historic center of the world’s natural pearl trade. By integrating AI and underwater drone technology into pearl harvesting, we’re not just modernizing an outdated industry — we’re preserving and elevating one of Bahrain’s most iconic cultural identities. This directly aligns with Bahrain’s development goals by blending innovation with heritage, creating a sustainable economic opportunity rooted in national pride. It supports tourism, diversifies the economy beyond oil, and positions Bahrain as a global leader in heritage-based innovation.
Inspiration: What inspired us to address this problem is the clear gap between the high value of natural pearls and the outdated, untouched methods still used to find them. Despite being one of the Gulf’s oldest and most prized industries, natural pearl diving never evolved — it’s stuck in the 1960s, with no serious integration of modern technology. We saw massive potential: an opportunity to bring innovation to a forgotten sector, preserve cultural heritage, and create a more sustainable and profitable way to revive a luxury product that the world still wants.
Keywords: ai drones, pearl harvesting, underwater drones, computer vision, natural pearls

Project: SmartTaqyeem
Problem: In Bahrain and across the GCC, building and infrastructure inspections are still largely conducted through manual, paper based processes. This leads to several issues: 1- Delays in reporting due to manual data entry and formatting. 2- Human error and inconsistency in evaluations. 3- Lack of standardized criteria for inspection and scoring. 4- Difficulty in accessing historical inspection data. 5- No real time monitoring or analytics. These inefficiencies affect government agencies, real estate developers, construction companies, and facility management teams alike leading to risks, delays, and higher costs.
Solution: SmartTaqyeem is an AI-powered inspection and evaluation platform designed for real estate, infrastructure, and industrial facilities. It solves these issues by offering: 1- AI-based image analysis to detect visual defects instantly. 2- Smart checklists tailored to local standards and regulations. 3- Automated report generation in multiple formats (PDF, API, cloud). 4- Mobile app for on-site inspection with offline capability. 5- Cloud dashboard to monitor KPIs and track inspection history. 6- Multilingual support for Arabic and English. Our platform not only reduces human error and reporting time, but also ensures standardization and provides decision makers with real time insights.
Impact: SmartTaqyeem directly supports Bahrain’s Vision 2030 by driving digital transformation in the real estate and construction sectors. It aligns with national goals of improving government efficiency, enabling smart city infrastructure, and encouraging innovation through advanced technologies like AI. By automating inspections and standardizing property evaluations, our solution helps municipalities and developers save time, reduce costs, and ensure higher quality compliance. It also supports sustainable urban development by providing real-time data for smarter planning and decision making, making it a strong fit for both public and private sector initiatives.
Inspiration: The inspiration came from direct observation of inefficiencies in the building inspection process. As a property owner, I noticed that inspections were often manual, inconsistent, and heavily reliant on subjective human judgment leading to delays, errors, and miscommunication between stakeholders. With the region pushing toward digital transformation and smart cities, I saw a clear opportunity to bring AI and automation into this space. SmartTaqyeem was born from a desire to modernize this outdated process, improve transparency, and support both private companies and government bodies in making faster, data driven decisions.
Keywords: ai inspection, building evaluation, real estate, infrastructure, automated reporting

With the tool one can add things like http-connectivity, complex simulations, database connectivity to the real-time control logic. Apart from real-time applications, the tool also allows to easily model existing PLC programs for computer simulations, modify the program and apply changes to the PLC program easily.

Additionally, people with disabilities face double difficulty in finding dedicated parking spots that are vacant when they arrive, as they are often reserved or occupied by unauthorized people. Original: الشريحة المستهدفة تواجه مشكلة كبيرة في إيجاد مواقف سيارات بسهولة وخاصة في الأماكن المزدحمة مثل المستشفيات، المولات، الفعاليات، والمهرجانات، حيث يضيع المستخدمون وقتًا طويلًا في البحث عن موقف شاغر، مما يسبب توتر وتأخير عن المواعيد، إضافة إلى أن الأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة يواجهون صعوبة مضاعفة في إيجاد مواقف مخصصة تكون شاغرة عند وصولهم، وغالبًا ما تكون محجوزة أو مشغولة من قبل أشخاص غير مخولين. تطبيق “محجوز” يحل هذه المشكلة من خلال توفير نظام حجز ذكي يتيح للمستخدمين حجز المواقف مسبقًا عبر التطبيق، مع نظام أمني يمنع المركبات غير المصرح لها من استخدام الموقف، مما يوفر الوقت، يقلل الازدحام، ويضمن أولوية ذوي الإعاقة في الحصول على مواقفهم الخاصة بكل سهولة وأمان.
Solution: The solution provided by the 'Mahjooz' application is a smart system for reserving parking spots in advance through an easy-to-use mobile application, where the user can select the location, view available spots, and reserve the spot directly from the app. When the user arrives at the place, they open the spot through the app itself with the push of a button, via a direct connection to the smart device installed at the spot, which prevents any unauthorized car from using it. Original: الحل الذي يقدمه تطبيق “محجوز” هو نظام ذكي لحجز مواقف السيارات مسبقًا عبر تطبيق موبايل سهل الاستخدام، حيث يمكن للمستخدم اختيار الموقع، عرض المواقف المتوفرة، وحجز الموقف مباشرة من التطبيق. عند وصول المستخدم للمكان، يقوم بفتح الموقف من خلال التطبيق نفسه بضغطة زر، وذلك عبر اتصال مباشر بالجهاز الذكي المثبّت على الموقف، والذي يمنع أي سيارة غير مصرح لها من استخدام الموقف.
Impact: The 'Mahjooz' idea directly contributes to supporting the development plans in the Kingdom of Bahrain, as it aligns with Bahrain's Economic Vision 2030, which focuses on transitioning to a knowledge- and technology-based economy and improving the quality of life for citizens and residents. The application enhances digital transformation in the transportation and public services sector by providing a smart solution for parking management, which raises the efficiency of infrastructure and reduces traffic congestion. It also supports the principles of sustainability and social justice by empowering people with special needs and ensuring their easy and fair access to services. Additionally, the project opens opportunities for expansion in innovation and technical entrepreneurship fields, contributing to the creation of new jobs and motivating Bahraini youth to develop technical solutions that serve the community directly. Original: تُسهم فكرة “محجوز” بشكل مباشر في دعم خطط التنمية في مملكة البحرين، حيث تتماشى مع رؤية البحرين الاقتصادية 2030 التي تركز على التحول نحو الاقتصاد القائم على المعرفة والتكنولوجيا، وتحسين جودة الحياة للمواطنين والمقيمين. يعزز التطبيق من التحول الرقمي في قطاع المواصلات والخدمات العامة من خلال تقديم حل ذكي لإدارة المواقف، مما يرفع من كفاءة البنية التحتية ويُقلل الازدحام المروري. كما يدعم مبادئ الاستدامة والعدالة الاجتماعية من خلال تمكين ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة وضمان وصولهم السهل والعادل إلى الخدمات. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يفتح المشروع فرصًا للتوسع في مجالات الابتكار وريادة الأعمال التقنية، مما يساهم في خلق وظائف جديدة وتحفيز الشباب البحريني على تطوير حلول تقنية تُخدم المجتمع بشكل مباشر.
Inspiration: The daily challenges faced by people with special needs in finding designated parking spots, especially in crowded places like hospitals and shopping centers. Often, these spots are occupied by unauthorized people, forcing them to wait or park in distant places that exhaust them and make them feel undervalued. This reality prompted us to think of a smart solution that ensures their priority of use and preserves their rights. This is how the idea of 'Mahjooz' came about: an application that enables advance reservation for parking spots and connects to a smart device that prevents unauthorized vehicles from entering. Our goal for this project is to empower people with special needs to access their parking spots with ease and dignity, and improve their daily mobility experience. Original: التحديات اليومية التي يواجهها ذوو الاحتياجات الخاصة في العثور على مواقف مخصصة لهم، لا سيّما في الأماكن المزدحمة كالمستشفيات والمراكز التجارية. كثيرًا ما تكون تلك المواقف مشغولة من قِبل أشخاص غير مخوّلين، مما يضطرهم للانتظار أو الوقوف في أماكن بعيدة تُرهقهم وتُشعرهم بعدم التقدير. هذا الواقع دفعنا للتفكير في حل ذكي يضمن لهم أولوية الاستخدام ويحفظ حقوقهم، فكانت فكرة “محجوز”؛ تطبيق يتيح الحجز المسبق للمواقف ويرتبط بجهاز ذكي يمنع المركبات غير المصرّح لها من الدخول. هدفنا من هذا المشروع هو تمكين ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة من الوصول إلى مواقفهم بكل سهولة وكرامة، وتحسين تجربتهم اليومية في التنقل.
Keywords: parking reservation, smart parking, disabilities, mobile app, bahrain

project_name: Azyai An e-commerce platform for fashion
text:
Project: Azyai An e-commerce platform for fashion
Problem: My target audience struggles to find diverse abayas and dresses from local stores in Bahrain. They face high delivery fees, long waits, lack personal shopping experience, distrust social media due to scams, unreliable international shipping, and no single platform that connects customers directly with sellers in one place.
Solution: Azyai provides an easy-to-use online platform that connects customers with local boutiques in Bahrain, offering a wide selection of abayas and dresses. To make shopping more personal, we have a mobile fashion caravan that brings curated products directly to customers. This allows them to see and feel the garments in real life, making the buying process more trustworthy and convenient
Impact: My idea supports Bahrain’s development plans by promoting local businesses and boosting the digital economy. By connecting customers directly to local boutiques through an online platform and mobile caravan, Azyai encourages entrepreneurship, creates job opportunities, and supports small businesses. With plans to expand across the Gulf, we help boutiques reach customers outside Bahrain, supporting regional trade and economic growth. This aligns with Bahrain’s vision to diversify its economy and foster innovation in retail and e-commerce sectors.
Inspiration: I grew up in a family that owns a fashion business, so I understand well the challenges sellers face. As a customer myself, I also experienced many problems when shopping. That’s why I came up with these solutions to help both sellers and customers have a better, easier experience.
Keywords: abayas, dresses, local boutiques, online platform, fashion

Project: THIQA/ثقة
Problem: A problem that our business solves is the distrust and unsafe environment for women when entering a public transportation service, we solve safety and comfort issues and reduce the risk of assault and harassment towards women and make them feel as safe as possible by only having female drivers operating the vehicles and only picking up women and young kids.
Solution: Our solution for the problem is to create an app that will connect female drivers to female clients by a click of a button, instead of using normal taxis which is driven by a man, women can use our app and will always get female drivers to pick them up because that’s all we’re going to give them!
Impact: Our idea can improve tourism by giving a safe alternative for transportation and that can give Bahrain a better reputation for its safety
Inspiration: I realized that I’m scared for my sisters and mothers to order an uber and sit with a man, other than that it’s not culturally acceptable in the GCC to get into a random car with a random man. I also saw many harassment videos of men abusing their power towards women in their own car
Keywords: female drivers, women safety, transportation, app, bahrain

Project: تعمير
Problem: Citizens planning to build their homes suffer from the absence of a clear and integrated path that makes it easy for them to make informed decisions. Traditionally, the process is fragmented and complex, as the client needs to deal with multiple parties (designers, contractors, engineering firms, financing entities) without a unified platform connecting these services or explaining the options to them in a simplified and transparent manner. This deficiency leads to misjudgment of costs, selection of designs unsuitable for the land area or budget, and signing construction contracts without fully understanding the details, causing delays or halt of projects, and significant financial and psychological waste. The Ta'mir platform addresses this problem by providing an integrated digital solution that gives the client a clear construction plan, including an automated cost estimate, examples of designs for similar areas, direct connection with contractors, and facilitating communication with relevant authorities. Thus, construction transforms from a complex journey into a simple, transparent, and confidently executable experience. Solution: The Ta'mir platform provides an integrated digital solution that facilitates citizens' journey of building their homes by unifying and aggregating all essential services under one platform. The platform includes smart tools such as: Construction cost calculator based on area and budget. Ready-made design models for different areas with estimated cost display. Solution Mechanism: 1. The user starts by specifying the land area or choosing a design from the model gallery. 2. The platform automatically calculates the estimated construction cost based on actual market data. 3. A set of compatible options is displayed in terms of design, budget, and available contractors. 4. The user can communicate directly with the relevant authorities or request an engineering or financial consultation. 5. The platform tracks project progress, with the ability to send notifications and alerts at each stage. With this model, Ta'mir radically solves the problem of fragmentation, misunderstanding, and price discrepancies, and transforms the construction experience into a clear, executable, and reliable journey. project_name: Oceya Wellness – Natural Sea Moss-Based Health & Wellness Products
text:
Project: Oceya Wellness – Natural Sea Moss-Based Health & Wellness Products
Problem: Many individuals in Bahrain and the region suffer from a shortage of natural local food options that combine delicious taste and health benefits, especially products that support immunity and overall body health. Through my experience as a therapeutic nutrition specialist, I have noticed increasing interest in natural supplements like Sea Moss, but the products currently available are either non-existent in the local market or not available with high quality and appropriate health specifications. Consumers are also forced to order them from abroad at high costs and with short expiry dates due to shipping conditions. There is a clear need for a natural, safe, and easy-to-consume local product that meets this growing desire for effective nutritional solutions that support a healthy lifestyle in a practical and sustainable way. Original: يعاني الكثير من الأفراد في البحرين والمنطقة من نقص في الخيارات الغذائية الطبيعية المحلية التي تجمع بين الطعم اللذيذ والفائدة الصحية، خصوصًا المنتجات التي تدعم المناعة وصحة الجسم بشكل عام. ومن خلال خبرتي كأخصائية تغذية علاجية، لاحظت ازدياد الاهتمام بالمكملات الطبيعية مثل السي موس، لكن المنتجات المتوفرة حاليًا إما غير موجودة في السوق المحلي أو لا تتوفر بجودة عالية ومواصفات صحية مناسبة. كما يضطر المستهلكون لطلبها من الخارج بتكاليف مرتفعة وصلاحية قصيرة بسبب ظروف الشحن. هناك حاجة واضحة لمنتج محلي طبيعي، آمن، وسهل الاستهلاك يلبي هذه الرغبة المتنامية في حلول غذائية فعالة تدعم نمط الحياة الصحي بشكل عملي ومستدام.
Solution: My project 'Oceya Wellness' provides a practical and innovative solution by producing natural Sea Moss gel with healthy fruit flavors, free of sugar and artificial substances, using studied natural preservatives such as food-grade Vitamin C to increase shelf life without affecting quality or taste. Through my research of the local market, I did not find any Bahraini project offering ready-to-eat Sea Moss products, despite the increasing awareness of its health benefits. This reveals a real gap in the market, as health-conscious consumers are forced to order these products from abroad at high costs and with delivery delays. In manufacturing, I rely on pure raw materials from reliable sources, and I ensure the product is packaged in airtight containers using heat sealing technology to guarantee safety and preserve nutritional properties. The product is easy to incorporate into the daily routine, whether taken directly or added to juices and meals. Through my experience as a therapeutic nutrition specialist, I plan to expand the product line to include specialized therapeutic formulations that support health conditions such as bone health, skin, and immunity, making the product a comprehensive and effective choice for those seeking a healthy and natural lifestyle. Original: يقدّم مشروعي "Oceya Wellness" حلًا عمليًا ومبتكرًا يتمثل في إنتاج جل السي موس الطبيعي بنكهات فواكه صحية، خالية من السكر والمواد الصناعية، مع استخدام مواد حافظة طبيعية مدروسة مثل فيتامين C الغذائي لزيادة مدة الصلاحية دون التأثير على الجودة أو الطعم. من خلال بحثي في السوق المحلي، لم أجد أي مشروع بحريني يقدم منتج السي موس الجاهز للاستهلاك، رغم زيادة الوعي بفوائده الصحية. هذا يكشف عن فجوة حقيقية في السوق، حيث يضطر المستهلكون المهتمون بالصحة إلى طلب هذه المنتجات من الخارج بتكاليف مرتفعة وتأخير في التوصيل. أعتمد في التصنيع على مواد خام نقية من مصادر موثوقة، وأحرص على تعبئة المنتج في عبوات محكمة الإغلاق باستخدام تقنية الختم الحراري لضمان الأمان والاحتفاظ بالخصائص الغذائية. يتميز المنتج بسهولة دمجه في الروتين اليومي، سواء بتناوله مباشرة أو إضافته للعصائر والوجبات. ومن خلال خبرتي كأخصائية تغذية علاجية، أخطط لتوسيع خط الإنتاج ليشمل تركيبات علاجية مخصصة تدعم حالات صحية مثل صحة العظام، البشرة، والمناعة، مما يجعل المنتج خيارًا متكاملاً وفعّالًا للفئات الساعية لنمط حياة صحي وطبيعي.
Impact: The idea of 'Oceya Wellness' aligns with the national development plans in Bahrain by supporting the health and food sector and enhancing local entrepreneurship. The project focuses on providing natural products that enhance prevention and general health, which is consistent with Bahrain's directions to improve the quality of life of citizens through healthy and sustainable lifestyles. The project also contributes to reducing dependence on imported products by providing a high-quality local option, thereby supporting national food security. Additionally, the project enhances women's empowerment through my leadership as a Bahraini citizen specialized in nutrition, and contributes to creating sustainable economic opportunities in the healthy food sector, in line with the goals of Bahrain Vision 2030 in diversifying the economy and supporting small and medium enterprises. Original: تتماشى فكرة "Oceya Wellness" مع خطط التنمية الوطنية في البحرين من خلال دعم القطاع الصحي والغذائي وتعزيز ريادة الأعمال المحلية. المشروع يركز على تقديم منتجات طبيعية تعزز الوقاية والصحة العامة، وهو ما ينسجم مع توجهات البحرين لرفع جودة حياة المواطنين من خلال أنماط حياة صحية ومستدامة. كما أن المشروع يساهم في تقليل الاعتماد على المنتجات المستوردة، من خلال توفير خيار محلي عالي الجودة، مما يدعم الأمن الغذائي الوطني. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يعزز المشروع تمكين المرأة من خلال قيادتي له كمواطنة بحرينية متخصصة في التغذية، ويساهم في خلق فرص اقتصادية مستدامة في قطاع الأغذية الصحية، بما يتماشى مع أهداف رؤية البحرين 2030 في تنويع الاقتصاد ودعم المشاريع الصغيرة والمتوسطة.
Inspiration: As a therapeutic nutrition specialist, I have always looked for natural products that I could confidently recommend to people and also to myself, as I am personally interested in supplements and preventive nutrition. Through this research, I was able to reach a high-quality type that meets these standards, and it will be used in the manufacture of 'Oceya Wellness' products to ensure providing an effective and safe natural supplement that keeps pace with the growing health trend in society. The absence of a product with these specifications in the local market, along with my specialization in therapeutic nutrition and my keenness to provide effective and reliable solutions, was the main motivation for launching this project. Original: كمختصة في التغذية العلاجية، كنت دائماً أبحث عن منتجات طبيعية يمكن أن أوصي بها بثقة للناس ولنفسي أيضاً، لأنني مهتمة بمجال المكملات والتغذية الوقائية على المستوى الشخصي. تعرّفت على السي موس كعنصر طبيعي غني بالمغذيات والمعادن، خاصة اليود، الحديد، والمغنيسيوم، ويعرف بدوره في دعم المناعة، تحسين الهضم، وتعزيز صحة البشرة والغدة الدرقية. خلال بحثي، وجدت أن جل السي موس يباع في الأسواق الخارجية، لكن معظم المنتجات التي اطلعت عليها إما تحتوي على مواد حافظة صناعية، أو مصنوعة من نوعية منخفضة الجودة تؤثر على الطعم والفعالية. في المقابل، السي موس الجيد يجب أن يكون من النوع Irish، يجفف طبيعياً تحت أشعة الشمس، وخالٍ من الأملاح الزائدة والمواد الكيميائية. ومن خلال هذا البحث، تمكنت من الوصول إلى نوع عالي الجودة يحقق هذه المعايير، وسيتم اعتماده في تصنيع منتجات "Oceya Wellness" لضمان تقديم مكمل طبيعي فعّال وآمن يواكب التوجه الصحي المتنامي في المجتمع. غياب منتج بهذه المواصفات في السوق المحلي، إلى جانب تخصصي في التغذية العلاجية وحرصي على تقديم حلول فعالة وموثوقة، كانا الدافع الأساسي لإطلاق هذا المشروع.
