Project: Maharat
Problem: Based on the principle "Give a man a fish, and you feed him for a day; teach him how to fish, and you feed him for a lifetime," we realize that genuine learning goes beyond simply acquiring information, especially since not everyone has the skill or passion for studying. It is also not the only path to success. Life is full of diverse opportunities to achieve your goals. Therefore, our project focuses on training those interested in crafts and manual industries, because we believe that these skills are not only a source of income but also a means to achieve independence and personal success. The solution is to learn how to turn your passion into a successful business opportunity and build your future with confidence.
Solution: Maharat Institute aims to attract Bahraini youth who lack a passion for traditional studying and provides them with practical training in one of the essential skills needed in Bahraini society in daily life, such as barbering, carpentry, design, sewing, and production. The training program lasts for two years, during which trainees not only learn the skill but also receive guidance on how to turn it into a sustainable source of income for themselves and their families.
Impact: The idea of the institute, which is based on developing practical and vocational skills, significantly contributes to Bahrain's development plans and aligns with them in several ways. It also aligns with Bahrain’s vision to develop an economy based on innovation and creativity by offering training programs focused on entrepreneurial skills. Additionally, it helps promote sustainable development and achieve the goals of Bahrain Vision 2030. Furthermore, it contributes to diversifying sources of income, encouraging entrepreneurship, and developing skills that create opportunities for small and medium projects, thereby supporting economic diversification. It meets the needs of the local labor market by developing diverse skills that provide a skilled workforce capable of serving the needs of industrial and commercial sectors, which enhances the competitiveness of the national economy. Consequently, it helps reduce unemployment rates, as training youth in practical skills that are applicable contributes to lowering unemployment, especially among graduates who may not be inclined toward traditional academic study. In summary, the idea of the institute effectively supports the implementation of national development plans by preparing a skilled and flexible workforce that promotes economic growth and social development, aligning with the country’s vision for a more sustainable and prosperous future.
Inspiration: I have worked as a teacher for many years in secondary schools and at the Bahrain Training Institute. I have found that a significant number of students lack a passion for studying. However, these students possess remarkable skills that could generate substantial income if properly nurtured and developed. Unfortunately, many parents in Bahrain believe that academic study is the only path to a decent life. I do not deny the importance of knowledge and education, but they are skills that not everyone possesses. There are many other skills that meet needs and offer good earning opportunities, which can serve as successful alternatives to traditional education.

Project: Wellvance

Project: Home clinic
Problem: - High unemployment rates in the health sector: With the increasing number of graduates in medical and health specialties, many of them face difficulty in finding suitable job opportunities due to limited available positions, leading to a waste of energies and competencies that could contribute to improving the level of healthcare. - Mismatch of skills with market needs: Often, the skills individuals acquire during their academic studies do not align with the actual requirements of the labor market, creating a gap between academic qualification and practical needs, thus limiting employment opportunities for qualified personnel. -Weak work environment and its impact on personal life: Some doctors work without a salary to maintain their expertise, which hinders their financial stability and affects their ability to start a family and live a normal life, increasing burnout and work-life imbalance. -Health entrepreneurship barriers: The unemployed face difficulties in establishing medical projects due to high investment costs, lack of managerial experience, and fear of risk-taking, limiting innovation and expansion in health services. Original: - ارتفاع معدلات البطالة في القطاع الصحي: مع تزايد عدد الخريجين في التخصصات الطبية والصحية، يعاني العديد منهم من صعوبة الحصول على فرص عمل مناسبة بسبب محدودية الوظائف المتاحة، مما يؤدي إلى هدر الطاقات والكفاءات التي يمكن أن تساهم في تحسين مستوى الرعاية الصحية. - عدم توافق المهارات مع احتياجات السوق: في كثير من الأحيان، لا تتماشى المهارات التي يكتسبها الأفراد خلال دراستهم الأكاديمية مع المتطلبات الفعلية لسوق العمل، ما يؤدي إلى فجوة بين التأهيل الأكاديمي والاحتياجات العملية، وبالتالي يحد من فرص توظيف الكوادر المؤهلة. -ضعف بيئة العمل وأثره على الحياة الشخصية: يعمل بعض الأطباء دون راتب للحفاظ على خبراتهم، مما يعيق استقرارهم المالي ويؤثر على قدرتهم في تكوين أسرة وممارسة حياتهم الطبيعية، ويزيد من الإرهاق وعدم التوازن بين العمل والحياة. -عوائق ريادة الأعمال الصحية: يواجه العاطلون صعوبات في تأسيس مشاريع طبية بسبب ارتفاع تكاليف الاستثمار، نقص الخبرة الإدارية، والتخوف من المخاطرة، مما يحد من الابتكار والتوسع في الخدمات الصحية.
Solution: My company will provide job opportunities for the largest possible number of licensed unemployed professionals in the health sector by creating an integrated technological system supported by artificial intelligence: -Connects licensed health sector professionals with patients to provide primary home healthcare. -Connects licensed health sector professionals, for example, between doctors and nurses. - Connects new licensed health sector professionals with experienced ones from the same sector to provide consultation when needed. -My company will provide all necessary needs such as devices and equipment required to provide primary healthcare and reach diagnosis and treatment. -The system will operate on a commission basis for each service whose price is determined. -All professional and ethical aspects stipulated will be observed by preserving information and privacy. Original: شركتي سوف تقدم فرص عمل لأكبر عدد ممكن من العاطلين المرخصين لمزاولة المهنة من القطاع الصحي عبر خلق نظام تكنولوجي متكامل مدعوم بالذكاء الاصطناعي: -يربط بين المرخصين من القطاع الصحي والمرضى لتقديم الرعاية الصحية الأولية المنزلية. -يربط بين المرخصين من القطاع الصحي كمثال بين الأطباء والممرضين. - يربط بين المرخصين من القطاع الصحي الجدد وذوي الخبرة من نفس القطاع لتقديم الاستشارة عند الحاجة. -سوف تقدم شركتي جميع الاحتياجات الازمة كأجهزة ومعدات لازمة لتقديم الرعاية الصحية الأولية و الوصول الى التشخيص والعلاج. -سوف يعمل النظام بنظام العمولة لكل خدمة يتم تحديد سعرها. -سوف يتم مراعاة جميع الجوانب المهنية الأخلاقية المنصوص بها عبر حفظ المعلومات والخصوصية.
Impact: 1- Achieving sustainable development goals: - Employing unemployed individuals in the health field aligns with Bahrain's Vision 2030, which focuses on developing human capital and enhancing the knowledge-based economy. - Supporting the health sector leads to achieving one of the main goals of sustainable development, which is providing high-quality health services to all segments of society. 2- Strengthening the national economy: - Absorbing unemployed competencies into health jobs contributes to reducing unemployment rates, leading to increased consumer spending and driving economic growth. 3- Improving the quality of health services: - Filling the shortage of medical and technical staff enhances the efficiency of hospitals and health centers and reduces waiting times, improving the quality of care provided to citizens and residents. 4. Enhancing innovation in the health sector: - Integrating national competencies opens the door to innovation in health services, especially with the introduction of new technologies such as telemedicine and artificial intelligence in diagnosis and treatment. - This can also contribute to pushing Bahrain towards becoming a regional center for advanced health services. Original: ١- تحقيق أهداف التنمية المستدامة: - توظيف العاطلين في المجال الصحي يتماشى مع رؤية البحرين 2030، التي تركز على تطوير رأس المال البشري وتعزيز الاقتصاد القائم على المعرفة. - دعم قطاع الصحة يؤدي إلى تحقيق أحد الأهداف الرئيسية في التنمية المستدامة، وهو توفير خدمات صحية ذات جودة عالية لجميع فئات المجتمع ٢- تعزيز الاقتصاد الوطني: - استيعاب الكفاءات العاطلة في وظائف صحية يسهم في خفض معدلات البطالة، مما يؤدي إلى زيادة الإنفاق الاستهلاكي ودفع عجلة النمو الاقتصادي. ٣-تحسين جودة الخدمات الصحية: - سد النقص في الكوادر الطبية والفنية يعزز من كفاءة المستشفيات والمراكز الصحية ويقلل من فترات الانتظار، مما يحسن جودة الرعاية المقدمة للمواطنين والمقيمين. 4. تعزيز الابتكار في القطاع الصحي: - إدماج الكفاءات الوطنية يفتح المجال أمام الابتكار في الخدمات الصحية، خاصة مع دخول تقنيات جديدة مثل الطب عن بُعد والذكاء الاصطناعي في التشخيص والعلاج. - يمكن أن يسهم ذلك أيضًا في دفع البحرين نحو أن تصبح مركزًا إقليميًا للخدمات الصحية المتطورة.
Inspiration: I am an unemployed doctor and I face this problem even today, and after research and analysis, I reached this idea. Original: انا طبيب عاطل وتواجهني هذه المشكلة حتى اليوم ومن بعد البحث والتحليل وصلت الى هذه الفكرة
Keywords: healthcare job matching, home healthcare, artificial intelligence, health professionals, commission platform

Project: hubkar

The application is a unified platform that makes it easy for car owners to communicate with garage owners or spare parts shops or tow truck owners. The application features direct communication between the two parties with one click from the car owner, and his request is sent to all garages at once through direct chat between the two parties within the application. Here, the customer chooses the best garage, the best price, and the best quality from their place without the need to move from one garage to another. It allows car owners to browse nearby garages and communicate with them directly. They can easily book appointments for maintenance services or tow trucks. It provides a special section for displaying and selling cars and spare parts. It supports communication via chat and sending pictures and requests. It allows garage owners to display their services and track requests. By this, we save time and effort for both parties and create a trusted and organized market that serves their daily needs. Impact: The Hubkar app contributes to achieving development goals in Bahrain by digitizing the car maintenance and services sector, which enhances the efficiency of the local market and supports the knowledge-based economy. The app encourages entrepreneurship by enabling garage owners to expand digitally and makes it easier for users to access services with higher quality and speed, in line with the government's direction towards digital transformation and improving services for citizens and residents. Original: تطبيق Hubkar يساهم في تحقيق أهداف التنمية في البحرين من خلال رقمنة قطاع صيانة وخدمات السيارات مما يعزز من كفاءة السوق المحلي ويدعم الاقتصاد القائم على المعرفة التطبيق يشجع على ريادة الأعمال من خلال تمكين أصحاب الكراجات من التوسع رقمياً ويُسهل على المستخدمين الوصول إلى الخدمات بجودة وسرعة أعلى ما يواكب توجه الحكومة نحو التحول الرقمي وتحسين الخدمات للمواطنين والمقيمين

project_name: Smart Surveillance System For School Buses Based On Machine Learning
text:
Project: Smart Surveillance System For School Buses Based On Machine Learning
Problem: Ensuring the safety of students during school transportation remains a significant challenge for educational institutions and parents. Traditional systems rely heavily on manual attendance, lack real-time monitoring, and cannot prevent critical incidents such as students being left behind on the bus or unauthorized individuals gaining access. These limitations highlight the urgent need for a more intelligent, automated, and responsive surveillance system tailored for school bus environments.
Solution: This project offers a smart surveillance system for school buses using AI and IoT technologies. It combines facial recognition, GPS tracking, and real-time headcount monitoring to ensure student safety. The system alerts staff and parents through a web app and includes an alarm to prevent leaving students behind. By automating attendance and tracking, it improves security, accountability, and communication during student transport.
Impact: Our project supports Bahrain’s Vision 2030 by promoting the use of advanced technologies such as AI and IoT to enhance public services. By improving student safety through smart surveillance and real-time monitoring, the system aligns with national goals for digital transformation, innovation in education, and improved quality of life. It also encourages local talent development in engineering and smart systems, contributing to a knowledge-based economy.
Inspiration: In 2022 there an event , a young child in Dubai tragically died after being forgotten in a school bus due to human error . This preventable loss inspired our project.
Keywords: school bus safety, facial recognition, iot surveillance, real-time monitoring, student tracking

Project: RocReborn
Problem: Consumers aged 18 to 35 in Bahrain face challenges finding local clothing that is both affordable and high quality, as international brands dominate the market. To address this, we can adopt competitive pricing and offer discounts. Many young consumers are unaware of local brands due to limited marketing resources; investing in digital marketing and influencer collaborations can increase visibility. Additionally, the demand for sustainability can be met by using eco-friendly materials. Focusing on quality control and hosting pop-up events can enhance engagement. Finally, improving e-commerce platforms and customer service can boost online shopping satisfaction.
Solution: We will adopt competitive pricing strategies by efficiently sourcing materials and implementing cost-effective production methods, making high-quality clothing more accessible. We will invest in digital marketing campaigns and collaborate with influencers to enhance brand visibility among young shoppers. Incorporating eco-friendly materials and promoting ethical practices will resonate with sustainability-conscious consumers. Additionally, we will focus on quality control and gather consumer feedback to ensure our offerings meet expectations. Hosting pop-up events will create immersive experiences, fostering community engagement, while improving our e-commerce platform and customer service will enhance online shopping satisfaction.
Impact: My idea aligns with Bahrain's development plans by promoting local entrepreneurship and sustainable practices within the fashion industry. By focusing on affordable, high-quality clothing, we support economic diversification and empower young consumers. Additionally, our commitment to sustainability reflects Bahrain's vision for environmental stewardship. Hosting pop-up events fosters community engagement and cultural exchange, enhancing social cohesion. Furthermore, leveraging digital marketing and e-commerce aligns with Bahrain's push towards a knowledge-based economy, encouraging innovation and technology adoption. Overall, my initiative supports the growth of a vibrant local economy while contributing to Bahrain's broader goals of sustainability and community development.
Inspiration: I was inspired to address this problem by witnessing the challenges young consumers face in finding affordable, high-quality clothing that aligns with their values. The desire for sustainable and locally-produced fashion, combined with the lack of visibility for local brands, motivated me to create solutions that foster community and engagement.
Keywords: local clothing brand, affordable fashion, sustainable materials, digital marketing, e-commerce

project_name: Smart surveillance system for school buses based on machine learning
text:
Project: Smart surveillance system for school buses based on machine learning
Problem: Children forgotten on school buses face deadly consequences, as tragically witnessed in Dubai in 2022. These preventable incidents, caused by human error, demand robust safety systems to protect young lives from heat exposure and ensure no child is left behind.
Solution: Our solution combines AI facial recognition with Raspberry Pi technology to track each student boarding and exiting the bus. The system provides real-time headcounts, student identification, and GPS coordinates through an intuitive web dashboard, eliminating the risk of children being left behind.
Impact: It will create a much safer transportation system reducing accidents and increase the efficiency of school transportation
Inspiration: Preventable bus tragedies claiming children's lives demand immediate action and accountability.
Keywords: school bus safety, facial recognition, raspberry pi, student tracking, gps

Project: Twq
Problem: The problem: The media and creative sector (including photographers, designers, media institutions, newspapers, and production companies) suffers from the absence of a unified central platform that enables smooth and professional linking between service providers and those seeking them. Problem details: 1- For photographers and designers: - Difficulty in finding job opportunities or collaborative contracts due to the absence of a reliable database showing their experiences and previous works, reliance on non-specialized platforms (such as social media), which limits their professionalism and hinders growth opportunities, lack of clear mechanisms to ensure rights, and recurring problems in communication, payment, and delivery of works. 2- For newspapers and media institutions: - The constant need for fast and professional content, with the absence of an effective way to reach creative service providers in a timely manner, difficulty in evaluating the efficiency of a photographer or designer before collaboration. 3- For individual clients and companies: - The market is unorganized and relies heavily on personal relationships and recommendations, difficulty in finding a suitable photographer or designer in terms of style, time, and price, lack of a unified way to compare quality, read reviews, and communicate professionally. And more... Original: المشكلة: يعاني قطاع الإعلام والإبداع (بما يشمل المصورين، المصممين، المؤسسات الإعلامية، الجرائد، وشركات الإنتاج) من غياب منصة مركزية موحدة تتيح الربط السلس والاحترافي بين مقدمي الخدمات والجهات الباحثة عنها. تفاصيل المشكلة: ١- لدى المصورين والمصممين: - صعوبة في إيجاد فرص عمل أو عقود تعاونية بسبب غياب قاعدة بيانات موثوقة تُظهر خبراتهم وأعمالهم السابقة، الاعتماد على منصات غير متخصصة (مثل وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي) مما يحد من احترافيتهم ويعرقل فرص التوسع، عدم وجود آليات واضحة لضمان الحقوق، وتكرار مشكلات في التواصل، الدفع، وتسليم الأعمال. ٢- لدى الجرائد والمؤسسات الإعلامية: - الحاجة المستمرة للمحتوى السريع والمهني، مع غياب وسيلة فعالة للوصول إلى مزوّدي الخدمات الإبداعية في الوقت المناسب، صعوبة في تقييم كفاءة المصور أو المصمم قبل التعاون. ٣- لدى العملاء الأفراد والشركات: - السوق غير منظم ويعتمد بشكل كبير على العلاقات الشخصية والتوصيات، صعوبة في الوصول إلى مصور أو مصمم مناسب من حيث الأسلوب، الوقت، والسعر، عدم وجود وسيلة موحدة لمقارنة الجودة، قراءة التقييمات، والتواصل المهني. ويكمل....
Solution: The solution: My application offers a comprehensive technical solution that brings together photographers, designers, newspapers, and media companies on one specialized platform, facilitating quick access to talents and services, with professional profiles, transparent reviews, and an integrated booking and payment system. The application provides a safe and professional environment for exchanging services, reducing fragmentation, and increasing the efficiency of collaboration among all parties, and contributes to developing the media and creative sector locally in an organized and smart way. The application is distinguished as the first specialized local platform that connects those working in the creative and media field professionally and directly, with a smooth user interface designed specifically for the nature of the market. It includes exclusive features such as: Professional profiles for each user with a work portfolio. Instant booking system and automatic confirmation. Secure and reliable payment options. Accurate classifications and community ratings. Smart tools to facilitate project management and communication. This enables media entities to quickly access the best talents and gives creators real opportunities for growth and work. Original: الحل: يقدم تطبيقي حلاً تقنيًا شاملاً يجمع المصورين، المصممين، الصحف، وشركات الإعلام في منصة واحدة متخصصة، تُسهل الوصول السريع للمواهب والخدمات، مع ملفات احترافية، تقييمات شفافة، ونظام حجوزات ودفع مدمج. يوفّر التطبيق بيئة آمنة واحترافية لتبادل الخدمات، مما يقلل من التشتت، ويرفع من كفاءة التعاون بين جميع الأطراف، ويُسهم في تطوير قطاع الإعلام والإبداع محليًا بشكل منظم وذكي. يتميّز التطبيق بكونه أول منصة متخصصة محليًا تربط بين العاملين في المجال الإبداعي والإعلامي بشكل احترافي ومباشر، مع واجهة استخدام سلسة مصممة خصيصًا لطبيعة السوق. يشمل مزايا حصرية مثل: ملفات احترافية لكل مستخدم مع معرض أعمال. نظام حجوزات فوري وتأكيد تلقائي. خيارات دفع آمنة وموثوقة. تصنيفات دقيقة وتقييمات مجتمعية. أدوات ذكية لتسهيل إدارة المشاريع والتواصل. هذا يُمكّن الجهات الإعلامية من الوصول السريع لأفضل المواهب، ويمنح المبدعين فرصًا واقعية للنمو والعمل.
Impact: This project aligns with Bahrain's Economic Vision 2030, which focuses on innovation, supporting the digital economy, and empowering national competencies. The application contributes to: Supporting the creative economy by creating job opportunities for photographers and designers, promoting digital transformation by providing an integrated technical platform to organize the media and creative services sector, empowering Bahraini youth by providing a professional interface to showcase their skills and connect them with local and regional opportunities, supporting entrepreneurship by encouraging freelance work and independents, and stimulating smart partnerships. The project represents a practical step towards developing the digital media sector in line with national aspirations. Original: يتماشى هذا المشروع مع رؤية البحرين الاقتصادية 2030، التي تركز على الابتكار، دعم الاقتصاد الرقمي، وتمكين الكفاءات الوطنية. حيث يساهم التطبيق في: دعم الاقتصاد الإبداعي من خلال خلق فرص عمل للمصورين والمصممين، تعزيز التحول الرقمي بتوفير منصة تقنية متكاملة لتنظيم قطاع الإعلام والخدمات الإبداعية، تمكين الشباب البحريني عبر توفير واجهة احترافية لعرض مهاراتهم وربطهم بالفرص محلياً وإقليمياً، دعم ريادة الأعمال بتشجيع الأعمال الحرة والمستقلين، وتحفيز الشراكات الذكية، المشروع يمثل خطوة عملية نحو تطوير قطاع الإعلام الرقمي بما يتماشى مع الطموحات الوطنية.
Inspiration: The idea of the project came from a real experience I lived as a creator working in media and production fields, where I noticed the recurring challenges facing my colleagues, photographers, and designers, most notably the difficulty of accessing opportunities and the absence of a platform that brings them together professionally. I also faced media institutions looking for competencies, but they waste time and effort in the communication and coordination process. From here, I became convinced that the sector needs a smart and central solution that organizes the market and provides a fair and professional digital environment for everyone. Original: جاءت فكرة المشروع من تجربة واقعية عشتها كمبدع يعمل في مجالات الإعلام والإنتاج، حيث لاحظت تكرار التحديات التي تواجه زملائي من مصورين ومصممين، أبرزها صعوبة الوصول للفرص، وغياب منصة تجمعهم بشكل احترافي. كما واجهت مؤسسات إعلامية تبحث عن كفاءات، لكنها تضيع وقتاً وجهداً في عملية التواصل والتنسيق. من هنا تولدت لدي قناعةبأن القطاع بحاجة إلى حل ذكي ومركزي، ينظم السوق، ويوفر بيئة رقمية عادلة ومحترفة للجميع.
Keywords: creative industry platform, photographer booking, designer marketplace, media services, digital platform

Project: Harmonia.spaces
Problem: The target segment faces multiple problems related to the difficulty of accessing customized interior design services that meet their actual needs within limited budgets. Many clients suffer from the lack of professional guidance when furnishing their homes, leading to unconsidered decisions, wasted money, and inconsistent choices. It is also difficult for non-specialists to evaluate the quality of furniture or coordinate colors and styles appropriately for the space and function. In addition, relying on images spread on the internet without knowing how to apply them practically leaves clients confused and bewildered. Our company solves this problem. Project: EduPay
Problem: In Bahrain, thousands of families struggle to pay upfront tuition fees for private schools, universities, and training institutes. Traditional education loans from banks are often interest-bearing, rigid, and inaccessible to many. Scholarships and government aid are limited and highly competitive. This financial barrier leads to delayed enrollments, dropouts, or students settling for less preferred institutions. Additionally, adult learners and professionals seeking certifications often postpone their studies due to cost concerns. EduPay addresses this critical gap by offering interest-free, flexible financing that empowers students to pursue education without immediate financial stress.
Solution: EduPay is a digital “Study Now, Pay Later” platform that provides interest-free tuition financing to students across all educational levels in Bahrain. By paying educational institutions upfront and allowing students to repay in easy monthly installments, EduPay removes the burden of large upfront payments. The platform partners with schools, universities, and training centers to offer secure, flexible financing while ensuring institutions receive full payments on time. This approach makes education more accessible, reduces dropout rates, and supports lifelong learning — all without adding financial stress to families or learners.
Impact: EduPay supports Bahrain’s Vision 2030 by promoting equal access to quality education, and enhancing human capital. By removing financial barriers through interest-free tuition financing, EduPay helps build a skilled, competitive workforce and supports lifelong learning which is a key priorities in Bahrain’s national development strategy.
Inspiration: As an Instructor in the Higher Education Sector and product manager in the FinTech sector, I’ve seen firsthand how many talented students are held back simply because they can’t afford upfront tuition payments. I’ve taught students who were forced to delay or drop out due to financial constraints, despite their strong potential. This personal experience, combined with my passion for education and innovation, inspired me to create EduPay, a solution that removes financial barriers and empowers individuals to pursue learning without compromise.
Keywords: tuition financing, interest-free, study now pay later, fintech, education access

Project: Printa
Problem: Many businesses, designers, and individuals face high costs and long delays when trying to access 3D printing services. Existing platforms often require waiting for manual quotes, have limited local options, and serve mostly industrial clients with expensive pricing. This lack of fast, affordable, and easily accessible 3D printing limits innovation, prototyping speed, and small-scale manufacturing. Additionally, many 3D printer owners struggle to find consistent customers, leading to underutilized equipment. Printa solves this by creating a fast, decentralized marketplace where customers can instantly connect with local 3D printer owners for affordable, on-demand printing services — eliminating delays and lowering costs for both sides.
Solution: Printa is a tech-driven, decentralized marketplace that connects customers directly with local 3D printer owners. Through our platform, users can instantly upload or select 3D models and book printing services without waiting for quotes. Printer owners list their capabilities, prices, and availability, enabling real-time booking and fast order fulfillment. This approach reduces costs by fostering local competition and eliminating middlemen. It also empowers 3D printer owners to monetize unused capacity. By streamlining the entire process—from order placement to delivery—Printa makes 3D printing affordable, accessible, and fast, accelerating innovation and small-scale manufacturing for businesses and individuals.
Impact: Printa directly supports Bahrain’s national development plans by promoting innovation, entrepreneurship, and digital transformation. By creating a decentralized 3D printing marketplace, Printa empowers local makers and small businesses to access advanced manufacturing technologies affordably and quickly, accelerating Bahrain’s move towards a knowledge-based economy. The platform encourages technology adoption in manufacturing and supports SMEs, which are a key focus of Bahrain’s economic diversification strategies. Additionally, Printa fosters job creation and income opportunities for individuals owning 3D printers, contributing to Bahrain’s goals for inclusive economic growth and digital economy leadership in the Gulf region.
Inspiration: I was inspired to create Printa because I personally wanted to buy a 3D printer and the necessary equipment, but quickly realized how expensive and complicated it was. This made me think about how many people and small businesses struggle to access affordable 3D printing services. At the same time, I noticed many 3D printer owners had idle machines without enough customers. It felt like a big opportunity was being missed on both sides. That’s why I wanted to build Printa — a platform that connects customers directly with local printer owners, making 3D printing affordable, fast, and accessible for everyone.
Keywords: 3d printing marketplace, on-demand printing, decentralized platform, local makers, manufacturing

Project: Zero Human
Problem: The Problem: Creating high-quality cinematic videos is expensive, time-consuming, and technically demanding. Traditional production requires scripting, storyboarding, talents, filming, editing, and VFX—each step needing specialized skills. For businesses, marketers, and indie creators, this means: - High costs (studios, crews, equipment) - Slow turnaround (weeks to months for polished content) - Creative barriers (ideas get lost in translation between vision and execution)
Solution: The Solution: Zero Human is an AI movie-grade cinematic video creation platform—powered solely by your voice. Imagine this: You describe a scene—"A dystopian cityscape at dusk, neon reflections on wet pavement, a lone hacker sprinting through crowded streets—tense, synthwave soundtrack, 30 seconds"—and BOOM, the AI generates a studio-quality video with your own human models. No crews. No editing software. Just speak it into existence. How It Works (The Magic): Voice-to-Vision NLP: Our AI dissects your spoken words—not just the script, but tone, pacing, and emotion—to infer cinematic intent (e.g., "dreamy flashback" vs. "urgent chase scene"). Dynamic Asset Generation: Pulls from a universe of AI-generated visuals, motion, and music tailored to your specs (style: "Kubrick meets cyberpunk"; mood: "nostalgic yet ominous"). Auto-Editing: Sequences shots for each frame, adjusts transitions, and syncs shots for ads/films—polished in seconds.
Impact: 1. Economic Diversification Zero Human boosts Bahrain’s digital economy by creating an AI-powered media ecosystem, reducing reliance on traditional production. Our SaaS platform generates exportable tech revenue while creating high-skilled jobs in AI and creative fields. This aligns with Bahrain’s ICT and FinTech/MediaTech growth goals. 2. Youth Empowerment We enable Bahraini youth to produce professional videos with just their voice—no expensive equipment or technical skills. Partnering with universities, we’ll launch AI-film incubators and certifications to upskill talent. This supports Tamkeen’s mission to future-proof Bahraini careers. 3. Cultural Preservation Our AI transforms Bahraini heritage (e.g., oral histories) into cinematic content, amplifying local culture globally. Tourism campaigns can leverage hyper-localized AI videos to attract visitors. This aligns with Bahrain’s strategy to digitize and promote its heritage. 4. FDI & Startup Growth Zero Human attracts studios and investors by positioning Bahrain as a hub for AI-driven media innovation. Pilots with Bahrain EDB will showcase the kingdom’s tech-friendly sandbox. This accelerates Vision 2030’s goal to become a MENA startup leader. Why Bahrain? Majorly I am a Bahrain resident and also because of strategic location, agile regulations, and rich culture make it ideal for scaling AI media innovation.
Inspiration: Working with DTC brands, I saw companies burn $50K on mediocre ads while scrappy creators went viral with iPhone footage. The difference? Speed and authenticity. But even those creators hit ceilings when they needed polish. Traditional production couldn’t scale; AI tools couldn’t match their vision. The insight was clear: "The future belongs to tools that merge Hollywood’s craft with TikTok’s agility." I had a deep passion for generative AI based video industry and a few years of research and development in this field lead me to start "Zero Human". That's how Zero Human has evolved from concept to capability.
Keywords: ai video generation, voice-to-video, cinematic video platform, ai media production, automated video editing

Project: Mix & whisk
Problem: I, Chef Khawla Al-Sayeb, noticed through my daily interaction on social media that many people love my recipes but face difficulties such as: lack of time, laziness in buying ingredients, not owning baking tools, or fear of failure in the result. And looking for healthy solutions such as those with gluten and dairy allergies, and some want to bake for their children or guests, but they get tired of searching for recipes, organizing ingredients, and cleaning up after preparation. There may also be waste in ingredients and quantities. From here, I realized that the problem is not in the desire, but in the complexity of the baking steps. So the idea of 'Mix & Whisk' came as a smart and comfortable solution that makes baking easy, fast, and fun for everyone by preparing the recipe. Original: لاحظت أنا الشيف خولة السيب من خلال تفاعلي اليومي على وسائل التواصل أن الكثير من الناس يحبون وصفاتي لكن يواجهون صعوبات مثل: ضيق الوقت، الكسل في شراء المكونات، عدم امتلاك أدوات الخبز، أو الخوف من فشل النتيجة.و البحث عن حلول الصحية مثل الذي لديهم حساسية الغلوتين ومنتجات الألبان و البعض يريد الخَبز لأطفاله أو لضيوفه، لكنه يتعب من البحث عن الوصفات، تنظيم المقادير، والتنظيف بعد التحضير و قد يكون وهناك هدر في المكونات و المقادير من هنا، أدركت أن المشكلة ليست في الرغبة، بل في تعقيد الخطوات الخبز ، فجاءت فكرة “Mix & Whisk” كحل ذكي ومريح يجعل تجربة الخَبز سهلة، سريعة، وممتعة للجميع بتحضير الوصفه
Solution: Mix & Whisk offers ready-made baking packages inside the box. Customers face several challenges that prevent them from enjoying the baking experience at home. Most notably, lack of time and being busy, which makes buying and preparing ingredients exhausting. They also suffer from difficulty in accurately measuring ingredients, especially beginners, which may lead to unsatisfactory results. Some suffer from food allergies and find it difficult to find safe and suitable recipes. There is the problem of ingredient waste, adding flavors that reflect the Bahraini identity and culture from ingredients or the package. All these factors make baking less appealing despite people's love for it, and make them feel frustrated or lack confidence in their ability to succeed. So it is ideal for beginners and encourages home baking. As a pastry chef, I often received questions from friends and followers asking for easy recipes or suffering from failure in execution due to simple mistakes. This prompted me to think of a solution that makes baking accessible, simple, and easy for everyone, regardless of their level or time, and combines fun, learning, and their personal touch with baking. Seeing waste in the jewelry industry and rising demand for conscious luxury, I felt called to create pieces with meaning—reviving neglected elements into wearable art that honors both the Earth and the individual.

Project: Kebinary
Problem: The primary problem our target audience faces is the overwhelming stress and inefficiency associated with daily meal preparation. Busy professionals and families often struggle to consistently plan, shop for, and cook nutritious meals. This leads to significant food waste from unused ingredients purchased in bulk, increased reliance on expensive and often unhealthy takeout, and a general lack of confidence in the kitchen. Many feel uninspired by repetitive meals, find existing recipes too complex or time-consuming, and waste precious time figuring out what to cook and what to buy, ultimately hindering their desire to eat well and sustainably at home.
Solution: Our app, Kebinary, leverages AI to personalize recipes for anyone to cook, eliminating mealtime stress. It connects you to local supermarkets for pre-portioned ingredients, drastically reducing food waste and confusion. Clear, step-by-step guidance builds cooking confidence, making delicious home-cooked meals easy and cost-effective.
Impact: Our culinary app, Kebinary, strongly aligns with and contributes to Bahrain's national development plans, particularly the Economic Vision 2030, by supporting key pillars like digital transformation, economic diversification, food security, SME growth, and public health and well-being. Here's how: * Digital Transformation & Innovation: Bahrain aims to be a regional hub for digital innovation and AI. Our app is AI-powered, driving personalization and efficiency in home cooking, directly supporting the government's push for technology adoption across sectors. The seamless digital experience, from recipe discovery to ingredient ordering, aligns with Bahrain's e-governance and digital economy goals. * Economic Diversification & SME Growth: Vision 2030 emphasizes a private-sector-led economy and supports Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs). Our app integrates with local retailers (SMEs) for precise ingredient delivery, creating a new digital revenue stream for them and boosting local commerce. This empowers smaller businesses by giving them access to a tech-driven customer base. * Food Security & Responsible Consumption: Bahrain is highly focused on bolstering food security and promoting sustainable consumption. By facilitating pre-portioned ingredient sales, our app significantly reduces food waste at the household level, contributing to the "Responsible Consumption and Production" SDG (SDG 12) which Bahrain actively supports. This also aids in optimizing the utilization of food resources, a key aspect of food security. * Health & Well-being: Bahrain prioritizes public health. Our app encourages home cooking by making it easy and accessible, which is generally healthier than frequent takeout. The AI-powered personalized recipes can cater to specific dietary needs, promoting better nutrition and aligning with national health initiatives and SDG 3 ("Good Health and Well-being"). In essence, Kebinary is not just a convenience tool; it's a strategic digital solution that supports Bahrain and the world's long-term vision for a sustainable, competitive, and fair economy that prioritizes the well-being of its citizens and residents.
Inspiration: Our inspiration stemmed from a common observation: home cooking, despite its benefits, is often a source of stress and inefficiency for many. We saw friends and family struggling with meal planning fatigue, the frustration of wasted ingredients from buying full packages when only a small amount was needed, and the easy fallback on expensive, less healthy takeout. We realized there was a significant gap in existing solutions. Most recipe apps are just digital cookbooks, and grocery services don't solve the "what to cook" or "how much to buy" dilemma. This led us to envision Kebinary– an app that deeply understands individual needs through AI, then streamlines the entire process by connecting users with precise, portioned ingredients from local retailers. Our goal is to empower everyone to cook delicious, healthy meals at home with confidence, less waste, and more joy.
Keywords: ai recipe personalization, meal planning app, pre-portioned ingredients, food waste reduction, home cooking

Project: Chores
Problem: "Hirers" lack time for daily tasks and struggle to find reliable help. The elderly and those with mobility issues need assistance. "Chore Doers" face unemployment or underemployment, seeking flexible work. Many also struggle with the high barrier of obtaining commercial licenses to monetize their skills
Solution: "Chores" will be a seamless digital marketplace, accessible via mobile app and web platform, directly connecting "Hirers" with "Chore Doers". This solves time scarcity and difficulty finding reliable help by allowing Hirers to post any task—from cleaning to errands—and be matched with available Chore Doers, reviewing profiles and agreeing on price. For "Chore Doers," the platform addresses unemployment and lack of flexible work by enabling them to create profiles, showcase skills, set availability, browse/accept tasks, and manage earnings on their own terms. Critically, it overcomes the high barrier to entry by allowing individuals to offer services without a full commercial license
Impact: Firstly, my platform directly addresses unemployment and underemployment by providing a low-barrier path for individuals to earn income. By enabling "Chore Doers" to offer services without needing a full commercial license, I empower a vast talent pool to participate in the economy flexibly. This creates much-needed flexible work opportunities for students, stay-at-home parents, and others seeking ad-hoc employment, contributing to a more dynamic and inclusive labor market. Secondly, "Chores" supports the social fabric by assisting busy professionals, families, and the aging population or those with physical limitations. By connecting them with reliable help for daily tasks, it improves their quality of life and allows them to manage time more effectively. This indirectly supports community well-being and productivity, which are common objectives in national development strategies
Inspiration: I was inspired to address this problem by observing the daily struggles of busy individuals and families who constantly felt overwhelmed by their endless to-do lists, often unable to find reliable and trustworthy help for smaller tasks. Simultaneously, I recognized a significant pool of talented individuals in Bahrain, including students seeking part-time jobs, who were either unemployed or seeking flexible income opportunities but were hindered by the complexities and high costs of traditional business registration. This dual observation motivated me to create a platform that could efficiently connect these two groups, solving critical time management and income generation challenges while fostering a more flexible and accessible economy
Keywords: chore marketplace, freelance services, flexible work, gig economy, task matching

Impact: 1. Supporting the digital economy It opens new fields for entrepreneurship and reduces reliance on traditional sectors. 2. Empowering youth and women It provides flexible and equal job opportunities from home through e-commerce. 3. Accelerating digital transformation It encourages the use of modern technology in commerce and services. 5. Developing logistics infrastructure It stimulates improving shipping, delivery, and cross-border trade services. Original: 1. دعم الاقتصاد الرقمي تفتح مجالات جديدة لريادة الأعمال، وتقلل الاعتماد على القطاعات التقليدية. 2. تمكين الشباب والمرأة توفر فرص عمل مرنة ومتساوية من المنزل عبر التجارة الإلكترونية. 3. تعزيز تنافسية المؤسسات البحرينية تتيح الوصول إلى أسواق إقليمية وعالمية بسهولة، وتزيد فرص التصدير. 4. تسريع التحول الرقمي تشجع استخدام التكنولوجيا الحديثة في التجارة والخدمات. 5. تطوير البنية التحتية اللوجستية تحفّز تحسين خدمات الشحن والتوصيل والتجارة العابرة للحدود.
Inspiration: Virtual marketplaces are not just an alternative to traditional commerce, but the future of smart commerce. Project: Gymverse
Problem: In Bahrain’s growing fitness industry, the average person doesn’t know where to start. When people think about getting fit, their goals are vague: “I just want to lose weight.” “I don’t want to get too big.” “I guess I’ll just do cardio." They’re unsure of what actually works for them — or where to go to find it. Gym marketing is overwhelming, coaching styles are inconsistent, and most directories list only basic contact info. There’s no platform that truly guides them based on their goals, lifestyle, and personality. This makes it even harder for parents looking for specific services like martial arts gyms for kids, or for beginners seeking a non-intimidating environment to train in. People end up in the wrong gyms, following the wrong routines, and quitting early. Meanwhile, coaches and personal trainers struggle to stand out. They’re stuck promoting themselves through Instagram and word of mouth, I want to make this LinkedIn for fitness trainers
Solution: Our app helps users discover the right gym and trainer based on their goals, environment preferences, and schedule. It's more than a directory—it's a personalized fitness matchmaker. For coaches, it's a LinkedIn-style platform to showcase skills, gain visibility, connect with clients, and get recruited by gyms across Bahrain and beyond and increased exposure.
Impact: My platform supports Bahrain Vision 2030 by promoting health and wellness, empowering the private sector, driving digital innovation, and enabling youth employment. It enhances public access to personalized fitness, increases the access and awareness of healthy living standards, boosts visibility for local coaches and SME gyms that dont have as much exposure as the mainstream well known gyms, and fosters tech-driven entrepreneurship in the wellness industry. By supporting inclusive access for women and families, it also contributes to the social development pillar of the national vision.
Inspiration: My own struggles finding a gym, a martial arts studio, and a trainer who's training style matched my own. Being in fitness for 6 years, trained people in my life, read over 70 books about fitness.
Keywords: fitness matchmaking, gym trainer directory, personal trainer discovery, fitness platform, wellness app

Project: well design
Problem: Many residents in modern urban areas—particularly in the fast-growing GCC region—live in homes that are functional but emotionally disconnected. These homes often lack personalization, sensory richness, and adaptability to user needs, leading to increased stress and reduced well-being. People want spaces that feel like home, not just places to sleep. Current housing options rarely address psychological comfort, environmental sustainability, or interactive smart features in an integrated way. Designing Life offers a solution to this gap by creating intelligent, emotionally enriching, and sustainable living environments.
Solution: Designing Life offers an innovative design management solution that integrates sensory design, artificial intelligence (AI), and sustainability to transform how people experience their homes. Through adaptive smart systems, emotionally engaging environments, and eco-friendly materials, our solution enhances user well-being, comfort, and connection. It addresses the need for homes that are not only functional but also deeply personal, responsive, and sustainable.
Impact: Designing Life directly aligns with Bahrain’s Vision 2030 by promoting sustainability, innovation, and improved quality of life. The project supports national goals of smart urban development and environmental responsibility by creating homes that are energy-efficient, emotionally supportive, and technologically advanced. It also contributes to the development of the creative and knowledge-based economy by introducing a new design management framework that merges technology, sustainability, and user well-being—areas strongly emphasized in Bahrain’s future development strategies
Inspiration: As an interior designer and design management student, I noticed that many homes—even luxurious ones—feel emotionally empty and disconnected from their users. During my academic and professional journey, I became deeply interested in how spaces affect mood, mental health, and daily behavior. I was inspired by the lack of environments that combine smart technology with human-centered sensory design and sustainability. This gap motivated me to create a new framework that puts people’s well-being at the heart of design.
Keywords: sensory design, ai smart homes, sustainable living, emotionally enriching, smart home design

Project: SIGNify
Problem: In Bahrain, the deaf community faces major obstacles in having smooth two-way conversations with those who do not know sign language. Whether in schools, hospitals, or daily public interactions, communication is often one-sided. Either the signer is not understood, or they cannot understand what is being said to them. This leads to constant dependence on others, delays in services, and feelings of exclusion. Current tools often fail to support real-time bidirectional communication, especially in Arabic sign language, leaving a large gap in accessibility across essential sectors in Bahrain.
Solution: SIGNify is a pair of AI-powered smart glasses that will enable real time two way communication between sign language users and non-signers. The glasses will translate both Arabic and English sign language into spoken words, and convert spoken Arabic and English into sign language visuals, allowing users to engage in natural, independent conversations. Paired with an accessibility focused mobile app, SIGNify will offer user control, settings customization, and learning tools. Designed specifically for Bahrain, it will support inclusive bilingual communication across schools, hospitals, and public service settings, empowering the deaf and hard of hearing community with greater independence.
Impact: SIGNify contributes to Bahrain’s national development by ensuring that individuals with hearing disabilities are not excluded from essential aspects of daily life. Through AI-powered communication, our solution helps bridge the gap in education, healthcare, and employment access. It reflects Bahrain’s commitment to building an inclusive, innovative, and equitable society where technology empowers every individual to participate fully and with dignity.
Inspiration: We were inspired by the growing impact of AI on everyday life. While people without disabilities can fully benefit from these advancements, many with disabilities are left behind. Our goal with SIGNify is to change that by building an AI-powered solution specifically designed to empower the deaf and hard of hearing community through inclusive communication.
Keywords: sign language translation, smart glasses, assistive technology, deaf communication, inclusive communication

Project: Tumooh - طموح
Problem: Education has become repetitive and un-engaging. Our aim is to combine digital and physical learning programs to develop entertaining educational experiences that the youth enjoy and learn from. Our programs focus on the 16-30yr old age group and collaborates with the ministry of education and ministry of labor in running our initiatives. We have been working for over 12 years (on & off) yet face difficulties expanding our operations and services since our model is B2B focused. We have reached over 40,000 Bahrainis with over 90% of participants positively rating us. We need guidance on moving our operations to the next level and expanding to different GCC markets since our learning experiences are all in Arabic. Our aim is to provide globally acknowledged education standards with a local twist.
Solution: Its a digital learning platform where theories are explained in an entertaining way combined with physical workshops where these theories are put in practice. Project: ReNuFuel
Problem: The target audience (municipalities, waste management companies, fuel consumers and petrochemical refineries) is grappling with two interconnected problems: the growing plastic waste crisis and the increasing demand for affordable, sustainable energy. Plastic waste is piling up in landfills and oceans, posing severe environmental hazards due to its non-biodegradable nature. At the same time, dependence on traditional fossil fuels contributes to greenhouse gas emissions and geopolitical vulnerabilities. Recycling rates remain low, and current waste management methods like incineration or landfilling are inefficient and polluting.
Solution: Our solution uses advanced pyrolysis technology to convert non-recyclable plastic waste into high-quality diesel fuel. By heating plastic in the absence of oxygen, we break it down into usable hydrocarbons without releasing harmful emissions. This process diverts plastic from landfills and oceans, reducing environmental pollution, while simultaneously producing a cleaner, alternative fuel source. Our system not only addresses the global plastic waste crisis but also helps reduce reliance on traditional fossil fuels, offering a sustainable and scalable energy solution that supports circular economy principles and lowers carbon footprints.
Impact: Bahrain's Economic Vision 2030 emphasizes sustainability, competitiveness, and fairness. Our business contributes to these pillars by transforming plastic waste into diesel fuel, thereby addressing environmental concerns and promoting economic growth through innovative solutions. Bahrain has implemented policies to reduce plastic waste, including bans on single-use plastic bags and certain plastic products. Our startup addresses this issue by recycling non-recyclable plastics into diesel fuel, reducing environmental pollution and providing an alternative energy source. Alongside that, the Bahraini government encourages private sector involvement in environmental sustainability. By partnering with local industries and stakeholders, our business can contribute to the nation's environmental goals and foster a circular economy.
Inspiration: The idea was born out of conversations between my brother and me, as we both became intrigued by the rapid rise of electric vehicles. We realized that one major reason for their popularity is the growing concern over petroleum - not just its limited availability, but also the environmental harm caused by its extraction and refining. That got us thinking: is there a way to create fuel without relying on natural reserves? During our research, we stumbled upon a little-known but powerful process called pyrolysis, which converts plastic waste into usable diesel. What fascinated us even more was how this diesel is far easier to refine than conventional petroleum and critically important in today’s economy - especially for trucks that transport essential goods like fruits, vegetables, and other daily necessities. It became clear to us that by using pyrolysis, we could address two major global issues at once: reducing plastic pollution and producing a much-needed alternative fuel. That dual-impact potential is what truly inspired us to take action and turn this vision into a startup.
Keywords: plastic waste recycling, pyrolysis, diesel fuel production, alternative fuel, circular economy

Additionally, Croozz aims to leverage advanced data analytics on driver behavior and traffic patterns, providing valuable insights into how drivers operate and how traffic fluctuates throughout the day. This data can help policymakers, businesses, and urban planners make informed decisions to improve road safety, optimize traffic flow, and develop targeted interventions. By enhancing operational efficiency, reducing fuel consumption, and fostering accountability, Croozz supports Bahrain’s vision for environmental sustainability, economic growth, and a safer, more tech-driven future for its citizens and businesses.
Inspiration: The inspiration behind Croozz came from a recurring observation, we often noticed food delivery drivers particularly from companies like Talabat driving recklessly on the roads. Over time, this behavior created a negative association with the brand, even though the company had limited control over individual drivers. This raised a larger concern about how poor driving not only risks lives but also damages a company’s public image. We also became deeply concerned about the rising number of road accidents and fatalities in the Bahraini community due to reckless driving. This led us to develop a solution that promotes responsible driving behavior, protects business reputations, and helps companies reduce operational costs while improving delivery efficiency and safety.
Keywords: fleet management, vehicle tracking, route optimization, predictive maintenance, driver behavior

Project: Benyany
Problem: Homeowners and real estate developers face a stressful and complex journey when building or renovating a property. They must coordinate with dozens of contractors, select hundreds of items, and manage a budget they often exceed. Most lack the experience, tools, or guidance to make informed decisions, leading to costly mistakes, delays, and poor-quality results. This lack of integration between service providers, product selection, and project tracking makes the process overwhelming, especially for first-time builders. Benyany solves this by streamlining the entire journey into one platform—connecting users with experts, tracking budgets, and simplifying material selection.
Solution: Benyany is a digital platform that simplifies the home building and renovation process by bringing everything into one place. It connects homeowners and developers with trusted experts, service providers, and suppliers. Users can track their budgets in real time, select the right materials, and manage every stage of their project with clarity and control. By centralizing communication, budgeting, and purchasing, Benyany reduces mistakes, saves time, and makes the experience smoother and more efficient for everyone involved.
Impact: Benyany supports Bahrain’s development goals by promoting digital transformation in the construction and real estate sectors—key pillars of the Kingdom’s Economic Vision 2030. It empowers homeowners and developers to manage their projects more efficiently through technology, reducing waste, improving transparency, and increasing the quality of real estate outcomes. By supporting local suppliers and service providers through its platform, Benyany also contributes to SME growth and job creation. The app enhances customer experience, encourages smart city practices, and aligns with Bahrain’s commitment to innovation, private sector empowerment, and sustainable urban development.
Inspiration: Our customers
Keywords: home building platform, renovation management, budget tracking, material selection, contractor connection

Project: Valoa
Problem: Despite the diversity of commercial stores in Bahrain, the market clearly lacks local brands that reflect the Bahraini identity and meet consumers' needs in terms of quality and modern design compatible with the local culture. Many shoppers are forced to resort to global brands that do not express the Bahraini character and do not take into account cultural values or local taste. Our company aims to fill this gap by establishing a local Bahraini brand specialized in clothing, offering contemporary designs of high quality, inspired by Bahraini heritage, and suitable for all ages and tastes. We believe in the importance of supporting local production and empowering national identity in the fashion sector. Original: بالرغم من تنوع المحلات التجارية في البحرين، إلا أن السوق يفتقر بشكل واضح إلى وجود علامات تجارية محلية تعكس الهوية البحرينية وتلبي احتياجات المستهلكين من حيث الجودة والتصميم العصري المتوافق مع الثقافة المحلية. الكثير من المتسوقين يضطرون للجوء إلى الماركات العالمية التي لا تعبّر عن الطابع البحريني ولا تراعِي القيم الثقافية أو الذوق المحلي. شركتنا تهدف إلى سد هذه الفجوة من خلال إنشاء علامة بحرينية محلية متخصصة في الملابس، تقدم تصاميم معاصرة ذات جودة عالية، مستوحاة من التراث البحريني وتناسب مختلف الأعمار والأذواق. نحن نؤمن بأهمية دعم الإنتاج المحلي وتمكين الهوية الوطنية في قطاع الأزياء
Solution: The solution we offer is launching a local Bahraini brand specialized in designing and manufacturing clothing that combines modernity and Bahraini cultural identity. We will produce high-quality products with distinctive designs inspired by Bahraini heritage with modern touches, catering to the tastes of youth and families alike. We will use sustainable materials and encourage support of local industries through collaboration with Bahraini designers and tailors. We will also provide a modern shopping experience through an easy-to-use online store, in addition to a physical store that allows customers to experience products directly. The goal is to enhance pride in local products and provide an alternative that competes with global brands with Bahraini quality and value. Original: الحل الذي نقدمه يتمثل في إطلاق علامة تجارية بحرينية محلية متخصصة في تصميم وتصنيع الملابس التي تجمع بين الحداثة والهوية الثقافية البحرينية. سنعمل على إنتاج منتجات ذات جودة عالية وتصاميم مميزة مستوحاة من التراث البحريني مع لمسات عصرية، تلبي أذواق الشباب والعائلات على حد سواء. سنستخدم مواد مستدامة ونشجع على دعم الصناعات المحلية من خلال التعاون مع مصممين وخياطين بحرينيين، كما سنوفر تجربة تسوق حديثة من خلال متجر إلكتروني سهل الاستخدام، إلى جانب متجر فعلي يتيح للعملاء تجربة المنتجات مباشرة. الهدف هو تعزيز الفخر بالمنتج المحلي وتوفير بديل ينافس الماركات العالمية بجودة وقيمة بحرينية.
Impact: My idea directly contributes to Bahrain's development plans, especially regarding supporting entrepreneurship, empowering youth, and enhancing the local economy. By creating a Bahraini fashion brand, we contribute to diversifying sources of income beyond the oil sector, which is one of the goals of Bahrain's Economic Vision 2030. We also support local artisans and designers, creating new job opportunities and contributing to the development of national skills. Additionally, my idea encourages local production and sustainable consumption, aligning with environmental and social development initiatives. We also seek to promote Bahraini culture regionally through our designs, contributing to building a positive image of the Kingdom globally. Original: فكرتي تساهم بشكل مباشر في خطط التنمية في البحرين، خصوصًا في ما يتعلق بدعم ريادة الأعمال، وتمكين الشباب، وتعزيز الاقتصاد المحلي. من خلال إنشاء علامة تجارية بحرينية في مجال الأزياء، فإننا نساهم في تنويع مصادر الدخل خارج قطاع النفط، وهو أحد أهداف رؤية البحرين الاقتصادية 2030. كما ندعم الحرفيين والمصممين المحليين، مما يخلق فرص عمل جديدة ويساهم في تنمية المهارات الوطنية. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، تشجع فكرتنا على الإنتاج المحلي والاستهلاك المستدام، مما ينسجم مع مبادرات التنمية البيئية والاجتماعية. نسعى أيضًا إلى الترويج للثقافة البحرينية إقليميًا من خلال تصاميمنا، مما يساهم في بناء صورة إيجابية للمملكة عالميًا.
Inspiration: What inspired me to address this problem was my personal observation as a shopper in Bahrain, where I found it difficult to find clothes that reflect my local taste and the details of our Bahraini culture, especially given the dominance of global brands. I also noticed that many young people are looking for products that express their national identity in a modern and distinctive way. This gap inspired me to create a Bahraini brand that provides real solutions to this market gap, offering people a local option they can be proud of, reflecting their heritage in a modern way that supports the local economy and elevates the level of the fashion industry in Bahrain. Original: الذي ألهمني لمعالجة هذه المشكلة هو ملاحظتي الشخصية كمتسوق داخل البحرين، حيث شعرت بصعوبة في العثور على ملابس تعكس ذوقي المحلي وتفاصيل ثقافتنا البحرينية، خصوصًا في ظل هيمنة العلامات التجارية العالمية. كما لاحظت أن كثيرًا من الشباب يبحثون عن منتجات تعبّر عن هويتهم الوطنية بطريقة عصرية ومميزة. هذا النقص ألهمني لفكرة إنشاء علامة تجارية بحرينية تقدم حلولًا فعلية لهذه الفجوة في السوق، وتوفر للناس خيارًا محليًا يفخرون به، ويعكس تراثهم بأسلوب حديث يدعم الاقتصاد المحلي ويرتقي بمستوى صناعة الأزياء في البحرين
Keywords: bahraini fashion brand, local clothing, heritage designs, sustainable materials, online store

Project: Kestra
Problem: Musicians all across the globe have one goal in mind, to make music. Musicians also suffer with a huge issue, finding other talented musicians to make music with. The purpose of this application(mainly web based, with a mobile application for bigger outreach) is to provide a collaborative platform for likeminded ‘bedroom’ musicians
Solution: The application will consist of two main components initially as an MVP, a web based application that provides users a platform to collaborate with other users using a DAW-like interface (Digital Audio Workstation) to allow users to create full songs with other musicians across the globe. Each user will be uploading their clips to form a complete song without ever physically meeting other people. The mobile application will be used to reach a wider market with completed compositions
Impact: This platform aims to enhance and develop the creative and art sector of Bahrain, we can have a platform that targets all musicians and young music fans to a platform to collaborate, socialize and find hidden talents within the country. This can further be enhanced by having workshops, events and other music related functions with the Kestra brand
Inspiration: Being a hobbyist musician, I often struggle to find the time, the place, and skilled enough musicians to create music together. This platform aims to target all the hobbyist musicians to collaborate and create full songs together.
Keywords: music collaboration platform, bedroom musicians, daw interface, mobile app, hobbyist musicians

Project: GURLZ
Problem: Many young women in Bahrain, especially in East Riffa, seek a safe, cozy, and comfortable place to gather with friends without unwanted attention or discomfort. Most existing cafés are mixed-gender or lack a welcoming atmosphere specifically designed for girls. This creates a gap where girls don’t feel fully relaxed or free to express themselves. My business, GURLz, solves this problem by offering a girls-only tea shop with a warm, stylish, and private environment where they can enjoy quality beverages, desserts, and meaningful time together. It provides both emotional comfort and a sense of belonging in a space tailored just for them.
Solution: GURLz provides a unique, girls-only tea shop that creates a safe, welcoming, and cozy environment where young women can relax, socialize, and enjoy premium-quality drinks like matcha, milk tea, and red tea, along with fresh pastries. By eliminating the discomfort of mixed spaces, GURLz offers emotional comfort and freedom of expression. The shop’s stylish, feminine design, curated by the owner herself, enhances the experience and fosters a sense of community and belonging. Through this concept, GURLz directly addresses the need for privacy, safety, and connection in a culturally respectful and modern way.
Impact: GURLz supports Bahrain’s development by empowering female entrepreneurship, creating safe social spaces for women, and contributing to SME growth and economic diversification. It aligns with Bahrain Vision 2030 and Tamkeen’s goals by promoting local business, supporting the national workforce, and reflecting cultural values in a modern, inclusive way.
Inspiration: I was inspired to address this problem from my own personal experience and the experiences of girls around me. Many times, my friends and I wanted to go out and enjoy a nice drink or dessert, but we didn’t feel fully comfortable or relaxed in mixed cafés. We always wished for a place made just for us — where we could talk freely, dress how we like, and simply enjoy each other’s company without judgment or discomfort. This made me realize that there’s a real need for a girls-only space that feels both modern and cozy. That’s why I created GURLz — to give girls a place where they truly belong.
Keywords: girls-only tea shop, safe space, female entrepreneurship, matcha, community

Project: Rivana
Problem: Aspiring entrepreneurs and small business owners often face significant challenges when trying to validate a new business idea. Many lack the resources, experience, or time to conduct a thorough feasibility study. They struggle with understanding market demand, evaluating financial risks, assessing competition, and ensuring regulatory compliance. Traditional feasibility studies can be expensive, time-consuming, and difficult to interpret without professional help. As a result, many businesses are launched based on guesswork rather than data, leading to poor investment decisions, early-stage failure, or missed opportunities. This gap in affordable, accessible, and intelligent business evaluation is exactly what Rivana aims to close.
Solution: o solve the problem of inaccessible, costly, and time-consuming feasibility studies, we propose Rivana — an AI-powered feasibility study agent designed specifically for startups and small business owners. By guiding users through a structured, interactive questionnaire and leveraging real-time data (e.g., market size, local competition, startup costs, and legal requirements), Rivana analyzes business ideas across multiple dimensions. It then generates a comprehensive, easy-to-understand report including SWOT analysis, risk factors, financial outlook, and growth potential. This empowers users to make data-driven decisions quickly, reducing guesswork and increasing the chances of launching successful, sustainable businesses.
Impact: Alignment with Bahrain’s Development Plans, Empowering Entrepreneurs, Promoting Digital Transformation, Reducing Barriers to Market Entry, Strengthening the Private Sector.
Inspiration: The inspiration to address this problem came from observing how many talented individuals with great business ideas fail to act — not due to a lack of creativity or motivation, but because they don’t know where to start or how to validate their ideas. Traditional feasibility studies are often expensive, slow, and complex, making them inaccessible to early-stage entrepreneurs, especially in developing markets. Additionally, with AI becoming more accessible, it became clear that we could automate and simplify the feasibility process using smart, conversational tools. Rivana was born out of the desire to democratize business planning — to make strategic validation as easy as asking the right questions.
Keywords: ai feasibility study, startup validation, business evaluation, swot analysis, financial projections

Project: Ahtimam / اهتمام
Problem: Many people suffer from skin or hair problems and buy multiple products without getting results. The reason is not due to a bad product, but because they don't know how to use it correctly or don't realize if it's suitable for their condition in the first place. There is a clear lack of simple, professional diagnostic services that help people understand their skin or scalp condition and guide them toward suitable products. The absence of this kind of support leads to financial waste, frustration, and worsening problems. Most customers rely on random trials or unreliable internet advice. Original: يعاني الكثير من الأشخاص من مشاكل في البشرة أو الشعر، ويشترون منتجات متعددة دون الحصول على نتائج. السبب لا يعود إلى سوء المنتج، بل لأنهم لا يعرفون كيفية استخدامه بشكل صحيح أو لا يدركون ما إذا كان مناسبًا لحالتهم أصلاً. يوجد نقص واضح في خدمات التشخيص الاحترافية والبسيطة التي تساعد الناس على فهم حالة بشرتهم أو فروة رأسهم، وتوجيههم نحو منتجات مناسبة لهم. غياب هذا النوع من الدعم يؤدي إلى هدر مالي، وإحباط، وتفاقم للمشاكل. أغلب الزبائن يعتمدون على تجارب عشوائية أو نصائح غير موثوقة من الإنترنت.
Solution: The 'Ihtimam' project provides a direct consultation service that includes a scalp or skin examination by a trained specialist, using simple diagnostic tools. After the examination, the client receives a personalized care plan with product recommendations suitable for their condition and budget, along with a practical explanation of the correct usage method. Through this solution, we aim to transform personal care from a random trial into a habit based on awareness and knowledge, reducing financial waste, improving results, and enhancing self-confidence. Original: يقدّم مشروع "اهتمام" خدمة استشارية مباشرة تشمل فحص فروة الرأس أو البشرة من قبل أخصائية مدرّبة، باستخدام أدوات تشخيص بسيطة. بعد الفحص، يحصل العميل على خطة عناية مخصصة مع ترشيح منتجات مناسبة لحالته وميزانيته، بالإضافة إلى شرح عملي لطريقة الاستخدام الصحيحة. نهدف من خلال هذا الحل إلى تحويل العناية الشخصية من تجربة عشوائية إلى عادة مبنية على وعي ومعرفة، مما يقلل من الهدر المالي ويحسّن النتائج ويعزز الثقة في النفس.
Impact: The 'Ihtimam' project aligns with Bahrain's development plans by providing a preventive and educational service that raises community awareness in self-care and aesthetic health, contributing to improving individuals' quality of life. The project is based on providing consultations built on real diagnosis, which aligns with the state's direction toward complementary health services based on awareness. 'Ihtimam' also supports local entrepreneurship and contributes to creating future job opportunities in consulting, specialized sales, and light manufacturing of care products later. Since the service is based on knowledge and innovation, it aligns with Bahrain's vision of building a diversified and sustainable economy. Original: يتماشى مشروع "اهتمام" مع خطط التنمية في البحرين من خلال تقديم خدمة وقائية وتثقيفية ترفع من وعي المجتمع في مجال العناية الذاتية والصحة الجمالية، مما يساهم في تحسين جودة الحياة للأفراد. المشروع قائم على تقديم استشارات مبنية على تشخيص حقيقي، وهو ما يتماشى مع توجه الدولة نحو الخدمات الصحية التكميلية والمبنية على التوعية. كما أن "اهتمام" يدعم ريادة الأعمال المحلية، ويُسهم في خلق فرص عمل مستقبلية في مجالات الاستشارة، والمبيعات التخصصية، والتصنيع الخفيف لمنتجات العناية لاحقًا. وبما أن الخدمة قائمة على المعرفة والابتكار، فهي تنسجم مع رؤية البحرين في بناء اقتصاد متنوع ومستدام.
Inspiration: Through my daily interactions with customers in the care shop, I noticed that many people buy products based on a misunderstanding of their role. For example, some buy shampoo for hair smoothing, but the function of shampoo is to clean hair of oils and dirt, and it often causes dryness if not followed by a conditioner. I saw mothers looking for a solution for their daughters' dry hair without even using conditioner. I also saw people suffering from dry dandruff but using products only for oily dandruff because they are popular. What inspired me most was my discovery of the effectiveness of very cheap products like minoxidil and derma rollers in reducing genetic baldness, but due to previous frustration, people have lost confidence in the existence of a solution. This is what drove me to build 'Ihtimam' — a project that accompanies the customer from the first step, guiding them to understand their condition, choose the right product, and use it correctly. Original: من خلال تعاملي اليومي مع الزبائن في محل العناية، لاحظت أن كثير من الناس يشترون منتجات بناءً على فهم خاطئ لدورها. مثلًا: البعض يشتري شامبو لتنعيم الشعر، مع أن وظيفة الشامبو هي تنظيف الشعر من الدهون والأوساخ، وغالبًا ما يسبب جفاف إذا لم يُتبع ببلسم. رأيت أمهات يبحثن عن حل لجفاف شعر بناتهم دون استخدام بلسم أساسًا. رأيت أيضًا أشخاصًا يعانون من قشرة جافة لكن يستخدمون منتجات مخصصة للقشرة الدهنية فقط لأنها مشهورة. وأكثر ما ألهمني هو اكتشافي لفعالية منتجات رخيصة جدًا مثل المينوكسيديل والديرما رولر في تقليل الصلع الوراثي، لكن بسبب الإحباط السابق، الناس فقدوا الثقة في وجود حل. هذا ما دفعني لبناء "اهتمام" — مشروع يرافق العميل من أول خطوة، ويوجهه لفهم حالته، واختيار المنتج المناسب، واستخدامه بالطريقة الصحيحة.
Keywords: skin consultation, scalp examination, personalized care plan, product recommendations, self-care

Project: RootsDX
Problem: Many individuals in Bahrain and the GCC struggle to access essential medications for conditions like hair loss, skin care, sexual health, and more. Visiting a clinic or pharmacy is often inconvenient, embarrassing, or time-consuming. As a result, many go untreated or don’t stick to their medications. There is no seamless, private, culturally sensitive way to get ongoing treatment — especially for men. This creates a clear need for a more convenient, trusted healthcare experience.
Solution: Our platform is an online clinic and pharmacy that helps people get the treatment they need more easily. Users fill out a private online questionnaire to check their eligibility and receive safe, doctor-approved medicine — starting with men’s hair loss and later expanding to skincare, weight loss, diabetes, and more. We plan to build a user-friendly web app that allows individuals to manage their treatments entirely online. We offer discreet delivery through a subscription model, along with easy-to-follow guidance, ongoing support, and attractive pricing. This makes the whole process simple, private, and culturally suitable, helping both men and women stay on track with their treatment and take better care of their health.
Impact: My idea supports Bahrain’s development goals by advancing digital healthcare, improving access to essential medical services, and encouraging entrepreneurship in the health tech sector. It aligns with the Economic Vision 2030 pillars of sustainability, competitiveness, and fairness by offering a scalable, tech-driven solution that reduces pressure on traditional clinics, promotes preventive care, and empowers individuals to manage their health. By localizing telehealth and pharmacy services for Bahrain and the wider GCC, the business also contributes to innovation, private sector growth, and job creation in the digital economy.
Inspiration: I experienced hair loss at 21 and felt embarrassed, confused, and unsupported. I didn’t know what treatments existed or even what a dermatologist did. Visiting a clinic was uncomfortable, costly, and unhelpful in my situation — my concerns were dismissed, and my money felt wasted. After discovering effective treatments that targeted my condition on my own, I realized how many others must be silently going through the same struggle. That experience inspired me to create a simpler, more private, and affordable way for people to get the care they need — not just for hair loss, but for any long-term medical issue that requires consistent treatment. I want people to access the right medicine easily with ongoing support, and have it delivered straight to their homes.
Keywords: online clinic, telehealth, men's hair loss, subscription delivery, culturally sensitive

Project: عندك!
