Project: Mtdrb
Problem: building an all-in-one gym management platform that simplifies operations for gym owners. Our system integrates class scheduling, membership and staff management, and VAT analysis—eliminating the need for multiple tools. It’s designed to streamline daily tasks, improve oversight, and empower gyms to operate more efficiently and profitably from one dashboard.
Solution: Gym owners often struggle with juggling multiple tools for class scheduling, membership tracking, staff coordination, and financial reporting—leading to inefficiencies, errors, and time loss. Our platform solves this by consolidating everything into one intuitive system. It reduces administrative workload, improves data accuracy, streamlines VAT compliance, and gives owners real-time control over operations. This means fewer overheads, better decision-making, and more time to focus on growing their business.
Impact: The gym management system directly supports Bahrain’s Economic Vision 2030 by promoting digital transformation, entrepreneurship, and private sector growth. It contributes to the Kingdom’s goals of building a diversified, innovation-driven economy by offering a scalable tech solution that enhances operational efficiency in the health and fitness sector.
Inspiration: The idea was born from firsthand experience and observation—seeing how gym owners constantly juggle multiple disconnected tools to manage classes, memberships, staff, and finances. The inefficiencies, lost time, and lack of integration were clear. I saw a real need for a smarter, all-in-one solution that simplifies management and empowers gym owners to run their business more efficiently, with better insights and control.
Keywords: gym management platform, class scheduling, membership management, vat analysis

Project: ReAttire
Problem: The world is moving towards slow fashion to reduce clothing waste that affects the environment, but they face several challenges, including the lack of variety in fashion and the high prices of sustainable clothing. On the other hand, fast fashion users are forced to buy more wardrobes to store the huge amount of clothes. Through my project idea, I will solve the problems of both slow and fast fashion, in addition to creating opportunities for some local projects in Bahrain. Original: يتجه العالم الى الموضة البطيئة لتقليل نفايات الملابس التي تؤثر ع البيئة، لكنهم يواجهون عدة تحديات وهي عدم توفر التنوع في الازياء بالاضافة الى الاسعار الباهظة للملابس المستدامة، على الجانب الاخر مستخدمي الموضة السريعة يضطرون الى شراء خزائن اكثر لتخزين الكم الهائل من الملابس. من خلال فكرة مشروعي سوف احل مشكلات الموضة البطيئة والسريعة ع حدء سواء بالاضافة الى خلق فرص لبعض المشاريع المحلية في البحرين
Solution: I will create an online store that allows users to rent all types of clothes through a monthly subscription. In the first phase of the project, there will be two subscription methods: the first is by contributing their current clothes (each piece of clothing that meets the conditions allows them to rent a free piece in return), and the second method is paying a monthly fee and renting clothes according to the package. This way, no one will have to repeat clothes or store or throw away a large number of clothes. At the same time, the clothes will be used by a large number of people, thus achieving sustainability in fashion. In cooperation with local laundries, the clothes will be washed, ironed, and sterilized after each use and delivered through local delivery companies, thereby supporting some local institutions. In the next phase of the project, local fashion stores and designers will be added to the project. Original: سوف اقوم بإنشاء متجر الكتروني يتيح للمستخدمين تأجير كافة انواع الملابس عن طريق الاشتراك الشهري، في المرحلة الاولى من المشروع ستكون هنالك طريقتين للاشتراك، الاولى: عن طريق المساهمة بملابسهم الحالية (كل قطعة ملابس مطابقة للشروط يتيح لهم تأجير قطعة مجانية في المقابل) ، الطريقة الثانية دفع مبلغ شهري وتأجير الملابس حسب الباقة، بهذه الطريقة لن يضطر احد الى تكرار الملابس ولن يضطر الى تخزين عدد كبير من الملابس او رميها، بنفس الوقت الملابس سيتم استخدامها من خلال عدد كبير من الناس وبهذا نحقق الاستدامة في الازيا، بالتعاون مع المغاسل المحلية سيتم غسل الملابس وكيها وتعقيمها بعد كل استخدام وتوصيلها عن طريق شركات التوصيل المحلية وبذلك ندعم بعض المؤسسات المحلية. وفي المرحلة التالية من المشروع سيتم اضافة متاجر الازياء والمصممين المحليين الى المشروع
Impact: It contributes to achieving sustainability and supporting local projects. Original: تساهم في تحقيق الاستدامة ودعم المشاريع المحلية
Inspiration: My wardrobe started to grow over time until it turned into two full rooms of clothes, which also meant a high cost for furniture. Regardless of whether my clothes are high or low quality, I cannot repeat wearing them for social reasons. And because my body and fashion taste change every period, I am forced to throw away a huge amount of clothes that may exceed 100 kilograms at one time and buy new clothes again. Original: خزانتي بدأت تكبر مع الزمن الى ان تحولت الى غرفتين كاملتين من الملابس مع التكلفة الباهظة للأثاث، وبغض النظر عن ملابسي ذات الجودة العالية او المنخفضة الا انني لا استطيع تكرار اللبس لأسباب اجتماعية، ولأن جسمي وذوقي في الازياء يتغير كل فترة ف اضطر الى رمي عدد هائل من الملابس قد يتجاوز ال100 كيلو في المرة الواحدة واعادة شراء ملابس جديدة مرة اخرى
Keywords: clothing rental subscription, sustainable fashion, slow fashion, clothing swap

Project: مزن
Problem: When it comes to buying eco-friendly products such as enzyme cleaners and clothes, etc., customers in Bahrain face significant challenges due to high prices, difficulty accessing Chinese platforms like Taobao and 1688 due to language barriers, and the lack of local platforms that offer an easy shopping experience. This makes the purchasing process costly and complicated, especially with shipping restrictions and lack of transparency in costs. Our website solves this problem by offering a platform in both Arabic and English, powered by artificial intelligence for product recommendations and shipping cost estimation, with collaboration with shipping agents like Dealfy to deliver products at competitive prices. In the future, we will develop our own brand for innovative enzyme cleaners. Original: عندما يتعلق الأمر بشراء منتجات صديقة للبيئة مثل المنظفات الإنزيمية و الملابس و الخ ، يواجه العملاء في البحرين تحديات كبيرة بسبب ارتفاع الأسعار، صعوبة الوصول إلى منصات صينية مثل Taobao و1688 بسبب الحواجز اللغوية، وعدم وجود منصات محلية تقدم تجربة شراء سهلة. هذا يجعل عملية الشراء مكلفة ومعقدة، خاصة مع قيود الشحن وقلة الشفافية في التكاليف. موقعنا الإلكتروني يحل هذه المشكلة من خلال تقديم منصة باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية، مدعومة بذكاء اصطناعي لتوصيات المنتجات وتقدير تكاليف الشحن، مع تعاون مع وكلاء شحن مثل Dealfy لتوصيل المنتجات بأسعار تنافسية. في المستقبل، سنطور علامة تجارية خاصة لمنظفات إنزيمية مبتكرة
Solution: To solve the problem of difficulty accessing affordable eco-friendly products in Bahrain, we offer an online store in both Arabic and English that connects customers with Chinese platforms like Taobao and 1688. It uses an AI-powered chatbot for product recommendations and shipping cost estimation, and collaborates with shipping agents like Dealfy to deliver products efficiently to customers. The solution simplifies the purchasing process, reduces costs, and overcomes language barriers. In the future, we will develop our own innovative brand to enhance sustainability and meet the needs of Bahraini families and businesses. Original: لحل مشكلة صعوبة الوصول إلى منتجات صديقة للبيئة بأسعار معقولة في البحرين، نقدم متجرًا إلكترونيًا باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية يربط العملاء بمنصات صينية مثل Taobao و1688،. يستخدم روبوت دردشة مدعوم بالذكاء الاصطناعي لتوصيات المنتجات وتقدير تكاليف الشحن، ويتعاون مع وكلاء شحن مثل Dealfy لتوصيل المنتجات بكفاءة إلى العملاء. الحل يبسط عملية الشراء، يقلل التكاليف، ويتغلب على الحواجز اللغوية. في المستقبل، سنطور علامة تجارية خاصة مبتكرة لتعزيز الاستدامة وتلبية احتياجات الأسر والشركات البحرينية
Impact: The idea of the online store that connects customers with Taobao and 1688 platforms aligns with Bahrain's Economic Vision 2030 to promote e-commerce and support entrepreneurship. Through an Arabic and English interface powered by artificial intelligence for product recommendations and facilitating shipping through agents like Dealfy, the project contributes to diversifying the economy, creating local job opportunities, and enabling individuals and businesses to access a variety of products at competitive prices. It also enhances digital innovation and supports the development of a private brand later, strengthening the private sector and reducing reliance on traditional imports. Original: فكرة المتجر الإلكتروني الذي يربط العملاء بمنصات Taobao و1688 تتماشى مع رؤية البحرين الاقتصادية 2030 لتعزيز التجارة الإلكترونية ودعم ريادة الأعمال. من خلال واجهة بالعربية والإنجليزية مدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي لتوصيات المنتجات وتسهيل الشحن عبر وكلاء مثل Dealfy، يسهم المشروع في تنويع الاقتصاد، خلق فرص عمل محلية، وتمكين الأفراد والشركات من الوصول إلى منتجات متنوعة بأسعار تنافسية. كما يعزز الابتكار الرقمي ويدعم تطوير علامة تجارية خاصة لاحقًا، مما يعزز القطاع الخاص ويقلل الاعتماد على الاستيراد التقليدي
Inspiration: I was inspired by my passion for entrepreneurship and my observation of the difficulty Bahrainis face in shopping from Chinese platforms like Taobao and 1688 due to language barriers and shipping complexities. Compared to Temu and Shein, which offer easy interfaces and global shipping but with varying quality and higher prices, I wanted to create an online store in both Arabic and English that provides a variety of products from Taobao and 1688 at lower prices. My platform, with the help of AI for product recommendations and collaboration with shipping agents like Dealfy, will ensure reliable quality through supplier vetting, a seamless shopping experience, with a plan to develop a private brand later. Original: ألهمني شغفي بريادة الأعمال وملاحظتي لصعوبة تسوق البحرينيين من منصات صينية مثل Taobao و1688 بسبب الحواجز اللغوية وتعقيدات الشحن. مقارنة بـ Temu وShein، اللتان تقدمان واجهات سهلة وشحنًا عالميًا ولكن بجودة متفاوتة وأسعار أعلى، أردت إنشاء متجر إلكتروني باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية يوفر منتجات متنوعة من Taobao و1688 بأسعار أقل. منصتي، بمساعدة الذكاء الاصطناعي لتوصيات المنتجات وتعاون مع وكلاء شحن مثل Dealfy، ستضمن جودة موثوقة عبر فحص الموردين، وتجربة تسوق سلسة، مع خطة لتطوير علامة تجارية خاصة لاحقًا.
Keywords: chinese products shopping, ai shopping assistant, eco-friendly products, shipping cost estimation, bilingual online store

Project: EZTRAVEL
Problem: I’m actually one of the people struggling with this problem. As an Individual who loves travelling and travels very often, what I dread the most is waiting for my bags to arrive on the luggage belt and delaying my trip home to rest. My business will be able to provide a solution for this by proving luggage porters similar to the service uber provides to pick up and drop the luggage at the suggested location based on the users preference. This will be updated and tracked in real time tracking for safety reasons which will be convered in my detailed business plan.

Impact: According to my research, there is a surge in the market for logistic development and growth and this can help contribute to it. I know that the Bahrain airport has further growth plans and still has many opportunities to become better and become regionally superior to other airports. This is one step in getting Bahrain up there. I have plans to develop this further

Project: Wellbeing essentials
Problem: Many elderly and disabled individuals struggle with basic hygiene due to limited mobility and lack of accessible facilities, this affects their dignity, health and independence and traditional sinks require plumbing and movement which many cant manage to do independently, our solution is to restore comfort and cleanliness without requiring major changes in their environment
Solution: We offer a portable sink that does not require plumbing which makes hygiene accessible in any setting, it allows individuals with mobility challenges to wash easily and safely which also helps in restoring their independence and dignity while reducing health risks caused by limited access to proper hygiene facilities
Impact: Our solution aligns with Bahrain’s Vision 2030 by promoting inclusive healthcare, social equity, and innovation. We support the national focus on improving quality of life for all citizens, especially the elderly and disabled, while ensuring sustainable practices in product design, accessibility, and community wellbeing
Inspiration: We where inspired by listening to the story of one of our classmates about how her grandfather struggled to do basic daily hygiene like ablution and washing his hands, which led to her mother creating this moble sink, and she talked about her story which inspired us to design this product for other elderly and disabled individuals who struggle with the same issue
Keywords: portable sink, hygiene accessibility, mobility aids, elderly care

Project: ClearBooks
Problem: Small companies waste long hours managing their finances manually. They deal with invoices, payments, payroll, and taxes through disconnected systems, leading to errors, cash flow problems, and loss of productivity. Without streamlining, business owners cannot focus on growth and waste significant time on routine tasks. Original: تهدر الشركات الصغيرة ساعات طويلة في إدارة شؤونها المالية يدويا. يتعاملون مع الفواتير والمدفوعات والرواتب والضرائب عبر أنظمة غير مترابطة، مما يؤدي إلى الأخطاء ومشاكل التدفق النقدي وفقدان الإنتاجية. بدون تسهيل الإجراءات، لا يستطيع أصحاب الأعمال التركيز على النمو ويضيعون وقتا كبيرًا في المهام الروتينية
Solution: Our platform allows small companies to connect all their financial systems in one place easily. Through simplified and user-friendly processes, business owners can organize invoices, payments, and reports without any technical expertise. This saves time, reduces costly errors, improves cash flow, and allows teams to focus on business growth. Original: تتيح منصتنا للشركات الصغيرة ربط جميع أنظمتها المالية في مكان واحد بسهولة. من خلال إجراءات مبسطة وسهلة الاستخدام، يمكن لأصحاب الأعمال تنظيم الفواتير والمدفوعات والتقارير بدون أي خبرة تقنية. هذا يوفر الوقت، يقلل الأخطاء المكلفة، يحسن التدفق النقدي، ويسمح للفرق بالتركيز على نمو الأعمال.
Impact: Our platform supports Vision 2030 by empowering small and medium enterprises with digital and cloud-based financial tools. It enhances productivity and supports the financial innovation environment, contributing to the competitiveness of the private sector. With integrations with local banks and scalable workflows, it aligns with national priorities in adopting technology, company growth, and economic diversification. Original: تدعم منصتنا رؤية 2030 من خلال تمكين الشركات الصغيرة والمتوسطة بأدوات مالية رقمية وسحابية. تعزز الإنتاجية وتدعم بيئة الابتكار المالي، وتسهم في تعزيز تنافسية القطاع الخاص. بواجهات مع البنوك المحلية وسير عمل قابل للتوسع، تتماشى مع الأولويات الوطنية في تبني التقنية، ونمو الشركات، وتنويع الاقتصاد
Inspiration: We saw how small business owners struggle daily with financial tasks that consume their time and effort. Many do not have the resources to hire accountants or programmers. We wanted to create a simple tool that enables them to manage their finances with confidence, save time, and focus on developing their businesses. Original: رأينا كيف يعاني أصحاب الشركات الصغيرة يوميًا من المهام المالية التي تستهلك وقتهم وجهدهم. كثيرون لا يملكون الموارد لتوظيف محاسبين أو مبرمجين. أردنا ابتكار أداة بسيطة تمكّنهم من إدارة شؤونهم المالية بثقة، توفير الوقت، والتركيز على تطوير أعمالهم
Keywords: financial management software, invoice automation, small business finance, cloud-based tools, payroll management

Project: خدمات دعم ومسانده
Problem: Women, especially mothers, housewives, and the elderly, face daily difficulties in accomplishing simple tasks such as delivery, housekeeping, going to appointments, or even meeting urgent personal needs. Many of them lack means of transportation, or do not feel comfortable asking for help from strange men, or suffer from physical fatigue or psychological stress. My project solves this problem by: Providing a safe and fast women-only service. Providing practical human support in daily tasks. Giving women peace of mind and confidence that they are getting help. Project: Al Lai
Problem: Today's jewelry customers constantly face a compromise: sacrificing either budget or desired design. Most pieces come with pre-set karat options, limiting personalization and suitability for various occasions. This rigid approach means consumers often settle, leaving a significant gap in the market for adaptable, consumer-centric offerings that truly meet their needs.
Solution: A one of a kind platform that allows customers to choose their desired karat for their jewelry design. This innovative approach eliminates the current compromise between budget and aesthetics. By offering unprecedented flexibility, we empower consumers to get one step closer to high quality pieces, without compromising budget or quality.
Impact: Our initiative directly contributes to Bahrain's development by fostering local talent and diversifying the economy. By actively engaging Bahraini jewelers, designers, and customer service professionals, we're not just creating new job opportunities; we're also enhancing local craftsmanship and demonstrating the high value of "Made in Bahrain" products and concepts, aligning with the nation's vision for a atrong, non-oil private sector.
Inspiration: We were inspired by a pervasive challenge within the jewelry market: the significant disconnect between high-end offerings and lower-quality alternatives. Consumers consistently grapple with balancing budget, desired design, and material quality with every purchase. Specifically in Bahrain, we observed that the finest quality pieces often feature traditional designs that may not align with contemporary occasions. Conversely, more modern or occasion-appropriate designs frequently compromise on quality, leading to quick tarnishing. This common dilemma, experienced by countless women, highlighted a clear opportunity. The solution lies in leveraging the inherent value of lower karat gold; it offers a far superior quality standard compared to non-gold alternatives while remaining significantly more accessible than higher karats, thus filling a crucial void in the market.

Project: RevenueCraft
Problem: Retail companies in Bahrain often face three critical challenges: keeping up with rapidly evolving technology, extracting actionable insights, and overcoming integration complexities. Without advanced systems, retailers struggle to understand customer behavior, optimize sales, or improve in-store experiences. For example, they lack accurate data on foot traffic patterns, customer demographics, and purchasing trends, hindering decision-making. Moreover, disconnected systems, such as point-of-sale and customer tracking tools, create a fragmented view of business performance. These gaps lead to lost revenue opportunities and an inability to compete in an increasingly data-driven retail environment. Original: غالبًا ما تواجه شركات التجزئة في البحرين ثلاثة تحديات حرجة: مواكبة التكنولوجيا سريعة التطور، واستخلاص رؤى عملية، والتغلب على تعقيدات التكامل. فبدون استخدام أنظمة متقدمة، يواجه أصحاب التجزئة صعوبة في فهم سلوك العملاء، وتحسين المبيعات، أو تحسين تجاربهم داخل المتجر. على سبيل المثال، يفتقرون إلى بيانات دقيقة حول أنماط حركة المشاة، والتركيبة السكانية للعملاء، واتجاهات الشراء، مما يعيق عملية اتخاذ القرار. علاوة على ذلك، فإن الأنظمة غير المترابطة، مثل نقاط البيع وأدوات تتبع العملاء، تخلق رؤية مجزأة لأداء الأعمال. وتؤدي هذه الثغرات إلى ضياع فرص الإيرادات، وعدم القدرة على المنافسة في بيئة تجارة التجزئة التي تعتمد بشكل متزايد على البيانات.
Solution: RevenueCraft Solutions addresses these challenges by providing advanced people counting systems (with age and gender detection), heatmap movement tracking, and integrated dashboards powered by artificial intelligence. Retailers gain a unified view of customer activity and sales performance, enabling them to make smarter, faster, and more profitable decisions. Impact: Our idea aligns with Bahrain Vision 2030 by promoting digital transformation and supporting small and medium enterprises, which constitute 90% of Bahrain's businesses. By providing AI-based analytics, people counting systems, and integrated dashboards, we empower retailers to make data-driven decisions, enhancing competitiveness and efficiency. This contributes to Bahrain's goals of economic diversification, fostering a knowledge-based economy, and advancing smart city initiatives. Project: Nova

Project: The Hideout Camp
Problem: In today’s fast-paced and modernized world, many Bahraini’s especially the younger generation are growing increasingly disconnected from their cultural roots and heritage. While there is a growing interest in exploring local traditions, the extreme heat and lack of accessible, comfortable spaces make it difficult for people to experience the authentic Bahraini desert lifestyle. Outdoor heritage activities are often limited to short seasons, leaving few opportunities for year-round cultural engagement. As a result, locals and visitors alike miss out on meaningful experiences that celebrate Bahrain’s rich history and traditions.
Solution: The Hideout Camp addresses this gap by offering Bahrain’s first indoor desert camp a climate controlled, year round destination that authentically reflects Arabian traditions through its architecture, design, and activities. By blending traditional Bahraini elements with modern comfort and service, the Hideout Camp creates an immersive space where people can reconnect with heritage, enjoy leisure time, and explore culture without being hindered by the harsh climate. This unique environment makes it possible to celebrate Bahraini identity in a way that’s accessible, enjoyable, and sustainable.
Impact: 1. It aligns with bahrain’s SDG 8: Decent Work and Economic Growth The Hideout Camp contributes to job creation in hospitality, food services, events, and operations. It promotes sustainable tourism, which is highlighted in Target 8.9: “devise and implement policies to promote sustainable tourism that creates jobs and promotes local culture and products.” 2.SDG 11: Sustainable Cities and Communities The project offers culturally enriched, inclusive, and safe recreational spaces within urban Bahrain. helps preserve traditional cultural elements, like falconry, oud music, and Arabic hospitality, aligning with Target 11.4: “strengthen efforts to protect and safeguard the world’s cultural and natural heritage.” 3.SDG 17: Partnerships for the Goals collaborate with local Bahraini businesses for food and beverage services and may work with Tamkeen for funding, demonstrating a multi-sectoral partnership approach—a major element of Bahrain’s SDG implementation.
Inspiration: Bahrain’s harsh summer weather makes it nearly impossible to enjoy traditional desert camping experiences during most of the year. Project: Dilmune Cloud
Problem: Many businesses struggle with high cloud costs, limited server control, and having to manage multiple tools across different platforms. Even simple deployments require complex setups and ongoing maintenance. Dilmune Cloud solves this by giving users full ownership, dedicated environments, and a unified platform to deploy, scale, and manage applications easily and affordably.
Solution: Dilmune Cloud offers a complete platform where users can deploy, manage, and scale applications without relying on multiple services or complex DevOps. Every server comes with full ownership, dedicated resources, and powerful tools like push-to-deploy, instant databases, and built-in security. This makes cloud hosting faster, more predictable, and easier to control especially for growing teams and developers who want things to just work.
Impact: Dilmune Cloud supports Bahrain’s push for digital growth by giving businesses, startups and developers an easier way to manage cloud infrastructure. It helps reduce costs, speeds up deployment, and gives full control over servers aligning with national goals to boost local tech, support startups, and modernize digital services.
Inspiration: One of my co-founders and I personally faced this problem while working with businesses and developers. Giving teams access to their servers, managing deployments, and maintaining control was always a mess too many tools, too much complexity. That experience is what pushed us to build Dilmune and solve it properly.
Keywords: cloud hosting, app deployment, server control, devops, cloud infrastructure

Project: FixHer
Problem: > The target segment for my project is women and girls of all ages, especially students, employees, and mothers. The main problem they face is the lack of safe maintenance places specifically for women, as many girls worry about the privacy of their personal information when handing over their phones to maintenance centers run by men, especially given the presence of sensitive photos and data on the devices. Some women also feel uncomfortable dealing with male technicians or entering crowded shops that are not equipped to receive women. There is also a lack of fast and high-quality services that combine quality, safety, and feminine taste in dealing and presentation. Original: > الشريحة المستهدفة في مشروعي هنّ النساء والفتيات من مختلف الأعمار، وخاصة الطالبات والموظفات والأمهات. المشكلة الأساسية التي يواجهنها هي نقص أماكن الصيانة الآمنة والخاصة بالنساء، حيث تعاني كثير من البنات من القلق بشأن خصوصية معلوماتهن الشخصية عند تسليم هواتفهن لمراكز الصيانة التي يديرها رجال، خصوصًا في ظل وجود صور وبيانات حساسة على الأجهزة. كما أن بعض النساء يشعرن بعدم الراحة في التعامل مع فنيين رجال أو الدخول لمحلات مزدحمة وغير مهيأة لاستقبال النساء. أيضًا، هناك نقص في الخدمات السريعة والراقية التي تجمع بين الجودة، الأمان، والذوق الأنثوي في التعامل والعرض.
Solution: > The solution is to launch the FixHer project, a women's center specialized in smartphone and mobile device maintenance, dedicated exclusively to serving women. The center provides a safe and comfortable environment for girls, where devices are repaired by trained female technicians, ensuring data privacy and customer comfort. Various services will be provided, including: Repairing screens, batteries, and common faults. Careful cleaning and sterilization of devices. Software services such as formatting, backup, and virus protection. Selling feminine accessories such as cases and headphones with soft designs. Pick-up and delivery service within specific areas for busy customers. In addition, an Instagram and WhatsApp platform will be used for bookings, and step-by-step follow-up with the customer until she receives her device. We are also working on building long-term trust through offers, raffles, and genuine reviews. Original: > الحل هو إطلاق مشروع FixHer، وهو مركز نسائي متخصص في صيانة الهواتف الذكية والأجهزة المحمولة مخصص لخدمة النساء فقط. يقدم المركز بيئة آمنة ومريحة للبنات، حيث يتم إصلاح الأجهزة من قبل فنيات مدربات، لضمان خصوصية البيانات وراحة العميلات. سيتم توفير خدمات متنوعة تشمل: تصليح شاشات وبطاريات وأعطال شائعة. تنظيف وتعقيم الأجهزة بعناية. خدمات برمجية مثل الفورمات، النسخ الاحتياطي، والحماية من الفيروسات. بيع أكسسوارات أنثوية مثل الكفرات والسماعات بتصاميم ناعمة. خدمة استلام وتوصيل داخل مناطق معينة للعميلات المشغولات. بالإضافة لذلك، سيتم استخدام منصة إنستغرام وواتساب للحجوزات، والمتابعة مع الزبونة خطوة بخطوة حتى تسلّم جهازها. كما يتم العمل على بناء ثقة طويلة الأمد من خلال عروض، سحوبات، وتقييمات حقيقية
Impact: > The FixHer project contributes to Bahrain's development plans by empowering women in a technical field that is often male-dominated. First, the project provides job opportunities for girls in maintenance and technology, enhancing the professional diversity of Bahraini women and encouraging them to enter new sectors. Second, the project enhances digital privacy and social safety for women by providing reliable maintenance services that respect user privacy, which aligns with Bahrain's directions in promoting secure digital transformation. The project also supports the trend towards female entrepreneurship and opens innovative fields for girls, which reflects on economic development and expands the base of small and medium enterprises, which are pillars of Bahrain's Economic Vision 2030. Finally, the project focuses on quality and excellence in service, raising the level of technical services in the local market and creating positive competitiveness. Original: > مشروع FixHer يساهم في خطط التنمية في البحرين من خلال تمكين المرأة في مجال تقني يعتبر حكرًا على الرجال في الغالب. أولاً، المشروع يوفر فرص عمل للفتيات في مجال الصيانة والتقنية، مما يعزز التنوع المهني للمرأة البحرينية، ويشجعها على دخول قطاعات جديدة. ثانيًا، يعزز المشروع الخصوصية الرقمية والأمان الاجتماعي للنساء من خلال تقديم خدمات صيانة موثوقة تحترم خصوصية المستخدمات، وهو ما يتماشى مع توجهات البحرين في تعزيز التحول الرقمي الآمن. كما يدعم المشروع التوجه نحو ريادة الأعمال النسائية وفتح مجالات مبتكرة للبنات، مما ينعكس على التنمية الاقتصادية وتوسيع قاعدة المشاريع الصغيرة والمتوسطة، وهي من ركائز رؤية البحرين الاقتصادية 2030. وأخيرًا، المشروع يركز على الجودة والتميز في الخدمة، مما يرفع من مستوى الخدمات التقنية في السوق المحلي ويخلق تنافسية إيجابية.
Inspiration: > As a woman, I noticed that many girls around me – whether my sisters, friends, or even myself – feel unsafe when needing to repair our phones. The fear of losing photos, privacy breaches, or even awkward interactions with technicians, these reasons made me think: "Why isn't there a special place for women that respects their privacy and provides them with a premium service?" This is what inspired me to create the FixHer idea, a project that offers professional maintenance for girls, in a comfortable atmosphere, with female hands that the female customer trusts, giving her a feeling of comfort and safety. The goal is not just repair, but creating a different experience that respects women and serves them in a suitable way. Original: > كوني امرأة، لاحظت أن الكثير من البنات من حولي – سواء أخواتي، صديقاتي أو حتى أنا شخصيًا – نشعر بعدم الأمان عند الحاجة لتصليح تلفوناتنا. الخوف من فقدان الصور، أو اختراق الخصوصية، أو حتى التعامل المحرج مع الفنيين، كلها أسباب خلتني أفكر: "ليش ما يكون في مكان خاص للنساء، يحترم خصوصيتهم ويوفر لهم خدمة راقية؟" هذا اللي ألهمني أبتكر فكرة FixHer، مشروع يقدم صيانة محترفة للبنات، بأجواء مريحة، وأيدٍ نسائية تثق فيهم الزبونة، ويعطيها شعور بالراحة والأمان. الهدف مو بس تصليح، بل خلق تجربة مختلفة تحترم الأنثى وتخدمها بأسلوب يناسبها.
Keywords: women's phone repair, female technicians, data privacy, mobile maintenance, women's safety

Project: Yayek - يايّك
Problem: The target segment faces two main problems: First, many unemployed Bahrainis, especially youth, lack flexible and independent income opportunities that suit their abilities and potential. Second, owners of home businesses and individuals suffer from the difficulty of finding reliable and affordable delivery couriers to deliver their goods immediately and flexibly, especially for small or personal orders. Despite the existence of some delivery applications within Bahrain, they are often owned by private companies that serve only known restaurants or stores, and do not provide appropriate solutions for the average individual or home businesses. This leads to delayed orders, loss of customers, and additional operating costs for business owners. Original: تواجه الشريحة المستهدفة مشكلتين رئيسيتين: أولاً، يفتقر العديد من البحرينيين العاطلين عن العمل إلى فرص دخل مرن ومستقل يتناسب مع قدراتهم وإمكانياتهم، خاصة الشباب. ثانياً، يعاني أصحاب المشاريع المنزلية والأفراد من صعوبة إيجاد مناديب توصيل موثوقين وبأسعار معقولة لتوصيل بضائعهم بشكل فوري ومرن، خصوصاً للطلبات الصغيرة أو الشخصية. ورغم وجود بعض تطبيقات التوصيل داخل البحرين، إلا انها غالباً تابعة لشركات خاصة تخدم مطاعم أو متاجر معروفة فقط، ولا توفر حلولاً مناسبة للفرد العادي أو المشاريع المنزلية. هذا يؤدي إلى تأخير الطلبات، فقدان عملاء، وتكاليف تشغيل إضافية على أصحاب المشاريع.
Solution: The solution is to create a digital application that facilitates the delivery process between individuals and small business owners on one hand, and independent Bahraini couriers on the other. Through an easy-to-use platform, users can request delivery service quickly, while couriers get flexible income opportunities. The application enables the delivery of informal items such as gifts, home products, and documents, directly and immediately. It will also include a rating system, bookings, and a direct tracking system for the order status, in addition to notifications to provide a safe and reliable experience for both parties, creating a tech-supported economic environment that stimulates freelance work. Original: الحل هو إنشاء تطبيق رقمي يُسهّل عملية التوصيل بين الأفراد وأصحاب المشاريع الصغيرة من جهة، والمندوبين البحرينيين المستقلين من جهة أخرى. من خلال منصة سهلة الاستخدام، يمكن للمستخدمين طلب خدمة التوصيل بسرعة، بينما يحصل المندوبون على فرص دخل مرن. التطبيق يتيح توصيل الطلبات غير الرسمية مثل الهدايا، المنتجات المنزلية، والمستندات، بشكل مباشر وفوري. كما سيتضمن نظام تقييم، حجوزات، ونظام تتبع مباشر لحالة الطلب، بالإضافة إلى إشعارات لتوفير تجربة آمنة وموثوقة للطرفين، مما يخلق بيئة اقتصادية مدعومة بالتقنية وتحفز العمل الحر.
Impact: The project idea contributes to supporting economic and social development goals in Bahrain by empowering Bahraini youth and stimulating freelance work, which aligns with Bahrain's Economic Vision 2030, which focuses on developing national competencies and enhancing the role of the private sector. The project also supports the digital economy by providing an innovative technical solution that contributes to improving local logistics services, and enhances the participation of small and medium enterprises in the economy, especially home businesses, which represent a growing segment of entrepreneurs in the kingdom. Original: تساهم فكرة المشروع فيدعم أهداف التنمية الاقتصادية والاجتماعية في البحرين من خلال تمكين الشباب البحريني وتحفيز العمل الحر، وهو ما يتماشى مع رؤية البحرين الاقتصادية 2030 التي تركز على تنمية الكفاءات الوطنية وتعزيز دور القطاع الخاص. كما أن المشروع يدعم الاقتصاد الرقمي من خلال تقديم حل تقني مبتكر يسهم في تحسين الخدمات اللوجستية المحلية، ويعزز مشاركة المشاريع الصغيرة والمتوسطة في الاقتصاد، خاصة المشاريع المنزلية التي تشكل شريحة متنامية من رواد الأعمال في المملكة.
Inspiration: The idea was inspired by situations I saw around me, especially from home business owners who suffer in delivery, and young Bahrainis looking for income opportunities but did not find something flexible that suits them. I felt that there is a real need for a solution that connects them, and from here came the idea of the application as a means to serve and support both parties. Original: ألهمتني الفكرة من مواقف شفتها حولي، خاصة من أصحاب مشاريع منزلية يعانون في التوصيل، وشباب بحرينيين يبحثون عن فرص دخل لكن لم يجدوا شيء مرن يناسبهم. حسّيت ان في حاجة حقيقية لحل يربط بينهم، ومن هنا جاءت فكرة التطبيق كوسيلة تخدم وتدعم الطرفين.
Keywords: delivery app, freelance couriers, home businesses, small orders, gig economy

Project: Too Fresh To Go
Problem: Many people want affordable fresh food while reducing waste, but shops often throw away unsold products. Our business solves this by connecting customers with stores and restaurants offering surplus or near-expiry items at reduced prices. Customers reserve through our app and pick up directly at the shop, saving money and cutting food waste sustainably.
Solution: Our solution is a digital platform that connects customers with local shops and restaurants offering discounted surplus or near-expiry food. Users reserve their orders through our app and pick them up directly at the store. This simple, convenient system reduces food waste, saves customers money, supports local businesses, and promotes sustainable consumption in the community.
Impact: Our idea supports Bahrain’s development goals by promoting sustainability, reducing food waste, and encouraging responsible consumption. It also empowers small businesses through digital transformation and supports food security. By connecting consumers with local shops, we contribute to a circular economy model, aligned with Bahrain’s Vision 2030 for innovation and environmental responsibility.
Inspiration: I was inspired by seeing how much good food is wasted daily while many people struggle to afford fresh produce. Learning about successful models abroad showed me it was possible to reduce waste and help people save money locally. I want to make sustainable, affordable eating accessible for everyone in our community.
Keywords: food waste, surplus food, discounted food, pickup app, sustainable consumption

Project: Fruit Fresca
Problem: Many public beaches and tourist spots in Bahrain lack affordable, healthy, and hygienic snack options. Visitors often have to leave the beach or settle for packaged or unhealthy alternatives. This gap frustrates families, tourists, and event organizers who want fresh, convenient refreshments on-site. Fruit Fresca solves this with live-prepared, fresh fruit.
Solution: Fruit Fresca is a mobile fruit cart that brings freshly cut seasonal fruit directly to beaches, hotels, and private events. Using daily-sourced fruit, ice cooling, and live preparation, it ensures maximum freshness and hygiene. Its portability fills service gaps at public beaches and offers tourists and locals a healthy, convenient alternative on-site.
Impact: Fruit Fresca contributes to Bahrain’s Vision 2030 by boosting tourism quality, creating opportunities for local youth to run sustainable micro-businesses, and promoting healthier lifestyle choices in public leisure spaces. By filling service gaps on beaches and at events, it strengthens the Kingdom’s reputation as a vibrant, visitor-friendly destination while supporting economic diversification and community well-being.
Inspiration: I was inspired to solve this problem after noticing that Bahrain’s beautiful beaches and public spaces often lack convenient, healthy snack options. Seeing tourists and families forced to bring their own refreshments or buy overpriced, unhealthy alternatives made me realize there’s an untapped opportunity.
Keywords: mobile fruit cart, fresh fruit, beach snacks, healthy options, event catering

Project: Comprehensive Event Management System (Bookify)
Problem: key challenges the system may solve:Disorganized Planning – Combines all event services in one platform. Vendor Trust Issues – Ensures verified, rated vendors with portfolios. Difficult Service Discovery – Smart search, filters, and AI suggestions. Booking Hassles – Real-time booking, calendar sync, and confirmations. Payment Complexity – Secure multi-vendor payments with escrow/refunds. Manual Admin Tasks – Automates bookings, messages, and vendor onboarding. Limited Mobile Access – Full-featured mobile and PWA support. Language & Accessibility Gaps – RTL support, Arabic language, WCAG compliant. Lack of Insights – Offers analytics, vendor metrics, and smart reports. Vendor Churn – Vendor tools, subscriptions, and marketing support. Scalability Issues – Cloud-based, scalable microservices architecture. Integration Limits – Syncs with calendars, maps, payment gateways, etc.
Solution: Our solution addresses the common challenge users face when searching for event vendors on platforms like Instagram, where information is scattered, unverified, and difficult to compare. Finding the right vendor often requires browsing multiple accounts, checking reviews manually, and contacting each vendor individually. Our comprehensive event management system solves this by collecting all verified vendors in one unified platform, allowing users to easily search, filter, compare, and book services directly. The system offers real-time availability, smart recommendations, secure payments, and complete event management tools. This not only saves time and effort but also ensures a smooth, trustworthy, and professional planning experience. The system supports multilingual access, including Arabic, and is built on a scalable, secure architecture, making it ideal for managing everything from small gatherings to large-scale events efficiently and professionally.
Impact: The platform strongly aligns with several pillars of Bahrain’s national development vision anchored in its Economic Vision 2030, Digital Government Strategy 2022, and ongoing digital transformation roadmap: 1. Advancing Digital Transformation & Smart Economy Bahrain actively fosters digital innovation across public and private sectors, using AI, cloud-first policies, and data-driven services . AI-powered platform fits perfectly into this ecosystem automating vendor discovery, integrating real-time data, and delivering intelligent recommendations thus reinforcing Bahrain's push for digital economy growth. 2. Enhancing E‑Services Integration & Inclusivity The Digital Government Strategy emphasizes consolidating data, enabling digital-first services, and ensuring all citizens can engage fully online . By bringing diverse vendors together in one verified portal, our system removes fragmentation, empowers event planners and SMEs, and supports Bahrain’s goal to “leave no one behind.” 3. Supporting Private‑Sector Innovation & Entrepreneurial Growth Through initiatives by Tamkeen, the kingdom nurtures tech startups and innovators . The platform not only promotes local vendors spanning catering, entertainment, logistics but also equips them with digital tools, secure payments, and analytics to enter regional and global markets. 4. Boosting Tourism, SME & Cultural Sectors Vision 2030 emphasizes economic diversification tourism, SME growth, cultural initiatives investmentmonitor.ai . A centralized vendor marketplace simplifies event planning weddings, conferences, cultural festivals making Bahrain more attractive to tourists and supporting local businesses. 5. Elevating Data Security and Regulatory Compliance Bahrain has implemented robust e-transaction laws, eKey, and open data initiatives . The platform incorporates secure payments, escrow, and user verification fulfilling national standards for digital trust and governance.
Inspiration: The inspiration came from real challenges people face when planning events especially the frustration of searching for reliable vendors across scattered platforms like Instagram, where information is often incomplete, unverified, and hard to compare. Many users, especially those without prior event planning experience, struggle to organize multiple services efficiently. We saw the need for a centralized, trustworthy, and intelligent platform that simplifies the entire process from discovery and booking to payment and coordination. Our goal is to create a solution that saves time, reduces stress, and transforms the event planning experience into something seamless, enjoyable, and professionally managed. The system can help managing the events from scratch from the planning stage, budget control, adding all the required services and products for the event and searching for the suitable vendor for each service or task, then booking the required service, hall, conference room, etc.., then pay through the app and track the delivery of each service or product related to the event (Conference, Wedding Party, Birthday Party, Ghabqa, Graduation, Seminars, Workshops, etc..).
Keywords: event management platform, vendor marketplace, booking system, ai recommendations, payment gateway

Project: Bike Station
Problem: The main problem facing the target segment is the desire to practice cycling, whether for fitness or muscle recovery, but they encounter several obstacles. First, the high price of purchasing a good bicycle makes it difficult for many to own one, especially if the need is only once a week within sports recovery programs. Second, even those who own bikes face difficulty transporting them from their homes to the roads or designated cycling tracks, which requires effort and additional means of transport and is often exhausting and impractical, especially in areas lacking appropriate infrastructure. Project: Jeelna
Problem: Most children in our region take Arabic lessons at school, but they still can't actually speak the language. That's because Arabic is taught as a subject to memorize, not as a language to live and use. There's little space for real conversation, personal expression, or everyday interaction. Over time, this creates a disconnect, kids pass their exams, but can't hold a sentence in Arabic. Many parents are looking for in-person, fun-based activities to bring the language to life, but these options are limited or not available. Arabic stays in the classroom, while English dominates real life.
Solution: Our solution is an in-person Arabic club that teaches the language through real conversation. It was piloted in schools with both native and non-native speakers, and demand has grown each term. The sessions are designed around how children’s brains actually absorb language at different ages. For younger kids, we use Total Physical Response, movement, and story-based games to build natural listening and speaking skills. For older children, we shift toward creative expression, structured dialogue, and confidence in switching between dialect and MSA. Everything is grounded in research on the critical period, brain lateralization, and diglossia. The goal is to help children actually use Arabic in daily conversation, in class, and in their lives, not just study it.
Impact: My idea aligns closely with Bahrain’s national development plans across three key areas: human capital development, cultural identity, and education innovation. 1. Human Capital Development Bahrain Vision 2030 emphasizes building a productive, globally competitive population through investment in education and lifelong learning. This program supports that goal by helping children build strong Arabic communication skills, which are essential not only for academic success but also for future opportunities in local and regional contexts. When students are able to use Arabic confidently in daily life, they are more equipped to contribute meaningfully to society and the economy. The focus on practical fluency rather than rote memorization is directly in line with Bahrain’s commitment to developing high-quality human capital. 2. Cultural Identity and Language Preservation Arabic fluency is a central part of Bahrain’s national identity. There is growing concern among families and educators that children are losing touch with their mother tongue. This program addresses that gap through engaging, conversational learning methods that reconnect children with Arabic as a living, expressive language. By blending Modern Standard Arabic with dialect in a natural way, the program strengthens both linguistic ability and cultural belonging. This directly supports Bahrain’s efforts to preserve and promote its cultural heritage through education. 3. Education Innovation and Export Potential Bahrain’s Ministry of Education has prioritized creative, student-centered learning models that reflect how children learn best. This program applies research-based methods such as Total Physical Response, storytelling, and roleplay to make Arabic learning active, immersive, and enjoyable. These methods are designed around child development and language acquisition research. If the model proves successful in Bahrain, it can be exported across the GCC, where the same problem exists. This would position Bahrain as a leader in Arabic education innovation and allow the country to contribute meaningfully to regional educational development.
Inspiration: As an educator, I kept seeing the same issue come up. Parents across schools and backgrounds felt that Arabic was the one subject their children were not connecting with. I started experimenting with conversational, play-based methods on a small scale, and the shift in attitude and fluency was clear. Children who once avoided Arabic became more confident, and parents began reporting that their kids were actually enjoying it. Project: توفير بلس
Problem: Although bank cards (such as Visa, MasterCard, and Benefit Pay) offer exclusive offers and discounts, most users do not know about these offers or forget to use them at the right time. Many people do not have time to search for discounts or do not know where to find them, leading to losing real savings opportunities. This challenge is not limited to Bahrain but is a global phenomenon, where millions are wasted in unused offers due to lack of awareness or difficulty in instant access to information. Also, shops and banks face difficulty in marketing their offers effectively and directly to the right customers. Solution: The "Tawfeer Plus" application offers a smart and practical solution to the problem through an instant notification system based on geographical location (GPS), where the user is automatically notified when passing near a shop that offers a discount linked to their bank card. The app also allows users to view all offers available on their cards through an interactive map and a list organized by interests, making it easier for them to make smart and quick purchasing decisions. Instead of manual search or relying on memory, the app links the card type (Visa, MasterCard, Benefit Pay) directly to available offers, ensuring no savings opportunity is missed. This not only serves the user but also enhances direct marketing for shops and banks and increases the effective use of bank cards. Original: يقدم تطبيق “توفير بلس” حلاً ذكياً وعملياً للمشكلة من خلال نظام تنبيهات فورية يعتمد على الموقع الجغرافي (GPS)، بحيث يتم إشعار المستخدم تلقائياً عند مروره بالقرب من محل يقدم خصماً مرتبطاً ببطاقته البنكية. كما يتيح التطبيق للمستخدمين استعراض جميع العروض المتوفرة على بطاقاتهم من خلال خريطة تفاعلية وقائمة مرتبة حسب الاهتمامات، مما يُسهّل عليهم اتخاذ قرارات ذكية وسريعة عند الشراء. وبدلاً من البحث اليدوي أو الاعتماد على الذاكرة، يقوم التطبيق بربط نوع البطاقة (Visa، MasterCard، Benefit Pay) مباشرة بالعروض المتاحة، مما يضمن عدم تفويت أي فرصة توفير. هذا لا يخدم المستخدم فقط، بل يُعزز التسويق المباشر للمحلات والبنوك ويرفع نسبة استخدام البطاقات البنكية بشكل فعّال

Inspiration: The idea of "Tawfeer Plus" started from a difficult personal experience, where I faced financial circumstances that affected my ability to achieve important goals in my life, such as stability and marriage, despite being 27 years old. Project: Trash to Cash
Problem: Organic waste, like food scraps and agricultural leftovers, often ends up in landfills, creating methane, a harmful greenhouse gas. This is a major environmental issue. Instead, this waste can be transformed into valuable products through composting, biogas production, or creating organic fertilizers. Businesses can profit by collecting organic waste from homes or restaurants and converting it into compost or energy, then selling these products to farmers, gardeners, or energy grids. This reduces pollution and supports a circular economy, turning waste into a sustainable resource.
Solution: The black soldier fly (BSF) can rapidly convert organic waste into valuable products. Its larvae consume food waste, reducing landfill use and methane emissions. In just days, they turn waste into protein-rich feed for animals and nutrient-rich compost. Businesses can farm BSF to manage waste sustainably while producing animal feed and fertilizers, creating a profitable, eco-friendly solution.
Impact: BSF supports Bahrain’s sustainable agriculture and waste management goals by converting organic waste into eco-friendly feed and fertilizers.
Inspiration: I work in the F&B industry and see how much food is wasted.
Keywords: black soldier fly, organic waste, composting, animal feed, waste management

Original: سأقوم بتطوير تطبيق يتيح للمستخدمين اختيار خضروات وفواكه طازجة حسب رغباتهم كل أسبوع. من خلال واجهة سهلة الاستخدام، سيتمكن المشتركون من تصفح المنتجات، تحديد الكميات، وإجراء الطلبات بسهولة. كما سيتم توصيل الطلبات إلى المنازل في مواعيد محددة. في المستقبل، يمكن توسيع الخدمة لتلبية احتياجات المطاعم، مما يسهل عليهم الحصول على مكونات طازجة بشكل منتظم، ويضمن لهم جودة عالية وتنوعًا في الخيارات. بذلك، نحل مشكلة نقص الوقت والجهد في التسوق ونساهم في تعزيز نمط حياة صحي.
Impact: My idea (developing a vegetable and fruit delivery app) contributes to enhancing several aspects of national development plans through: 1. Improving public health: By encouraging the consumption of fresh fruits and vegetables, the app will promote a healthy lifestyle, aligning with government goals to improve public health and reduce diet-related diseases. 2. Supporting the local economy: Collaboration with local farmers and farms can support the national economy and enhance sustainability. 3. Facilitating access to food: The app helps ensure various groups have access to fresh food, supporting food security and reducing gaps in food availability. 4. Creating job opportunities: With the app's expansion, new job opportunities can be created in delivery, marketing, and technical support, contributing to reducing unemployment rates. Original: تساهم فكرتي ( تطوير تطبيق توصيل الخضروات والفواكه ) في تعزيز عدة جوانب من خطط التنمية الوطنية من خلال. 1. تحسين الصحة العامة: من خلال تشجيع استهلاك الفواكه والخضروات الطازجة، سيعزز التطبيق من نمط حياة صحي، مما يتماشى مع أهداف الحكومة في تحسين الصحة العامة وتقليل الأمراض المرتبطة بالنظام الغذائي. 2. دعم الاقتصاد المحلي: يمكن التعاون مع المزارعين المحليين والمزارع، مما يدعم الاقتصاد الوطني ويعزز الاستدامة. 3. تيسير الوصول إلى الغذاء: يساهم التطبيق في ضمان وصول الفئات المختلفة إلى المواد الغذائية الطازجة، مما يدعم الأمن الغذائي ويقلل من الفجوات في توفر الطعام. 4. توفير فرص عمل: مع توسع التطبيق، يمكن خلق فرص عمل جديدة في مجال التوصيل، التسويق، والدعم الفني، مما يساهم في تقليل معدلات البطالة.
Inspiration: I was inspired by seeing families and individuals who suffer from the pressures of daily life and the difficulty of maintaining a healthy diet. I also noticed that many people prefer to eat fast food due to lack of time for shopping and food preparation. Additionally, there is a growing interest in health and enjoying a healthy lifestyle, which made me realize the need for a solution that facilitates access to fresh vegetables and fruits. This inspiration drove me to develop an app that combines convenience and healthy options, contributing to improving users' quality of life. Original: ألهمني رؤية العائلات والأفراد الذين يعانون من ضغوط الحياة اليومية وصعوبة الحفاظ على نمط غذائي صحي. كما أنني لاحظت أن الكثير من الناس يفضلون تناول الوجبات السريعة بسبب عدم توفر وقت كافٍ للتسوق وإعداد الطعام. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، هناك اهتمام متزايد بالصحة والتمتع بنمط حياة صحي، مما جعلني أدرك الحاجة إلى حل يسهل الوصول إلى الخضروات والفواكه الطازجة. هذا الإلهام دفعني لتطوير تطبيق يجمع بين الراحة والخيارات الصحية، مما يساهم في تحسين جودة حياة المستخدمين.
Keywords: vegetable delivery app, fresh produce subscription, healthy food delivery, home delivery service, local farm collaboration

Project: Mobile Application for Football Academy
Problem: Sports academies struggle with organizing attendance, performance, and communication processes between the coaching staff, players, and parents. These processes are often managed by traditional, unintegrated means, leading to weak follow-up, scattered information, and a lack of digital documentation of player development. Players and their guardians also lack precise tools to evaluate performance or follow daily notifications, which weakens the sports development experience and reduces management efficiency. Original: تعاني الأكاديميات الرياضية من صعوبة تنظيم عمليات الحضور، الأداء، والتواصل بين الطاقم التدريبي واللاعبين وأولياء الأمور. تُدار هذه العمليات غالبًا بوسائل تقليدية غير مترابطة، مما يؤدي إلى ضعف المتابعة، وتشتت المعلومات، وانعدام التوثيق الرقمي لتطور اللاعب. كما يفتقر اللاعبون وأولياؤهم إلى أدوات دقيقة لتقييم الأداء أو متابعة الإشعارات اليومية، مما يضعف تجربة التطوير الرياضي ويقلل من كفاءة الإدارة.
Solution: The solution is to create a smart digital application that serves sports academies through a unified platform that includes: attendance recording, training scheduling, individual performance tracking, sending notifications, and a management dashboard. The system will contribute to accurately documenting and monitoring player development, enhancing communication with parents, thereby raising management and technical development efficiency, and providing a professional environment based on actual data. Original: الحل يتمثل في إنشاء تطبيق رقمي ذكي يخدم الأكاديميات الرياضية من خلال منصة موحدة تشمل: تسجيل الحضور، جدولة التدريبات، تتبع الأداء الفردي، إرسال الإشعارات، ولوحة تحكم للإدارة. سيسهم النظام في توثيق ومتابعة تطور اللاعبين بدقة، وتعزيز التواصل مع أولياء الأمور، مما يرفع من كفاءة الإدارة والتطوير الفني، ويوفر بيئة احترافية قائمة على البيانات الفعلية
Impact: My idea aligns with Bahrain's development plans by supporting and developing the sports sector and youth categories in a professional and systematic manner. In the first phase, the project will be implemented within academies as a technical and organizational pilot model that enhances administrative and sports efficiency. In the second phase, the project will be expanded in partnership with the Ministry of Education, the General Sports Authority, Tamkeen, private banks, and health centers to form an integrated national system that tracks player development physically and psychologically and links performance to the actual needs of the national team and youth categories. The project will help identify the missing positions in national teams and work to cover them by developing qualified talents, creating a transparent database that contributes to building a professional sports generation qualified locally and internationally. The program will also include awareness and educational lectures that instill in players a culture of commitment and internal professionalism as a prelude to qualifying them for external professionalism in the future. This initiative supports the Bahrain Vision 2030 axis of human capital development and contributes to preparing players capable of representing the national team in major tournaments such as the 2034 and 2038 World Cups through a comprehensive and sustainable development program. Original: تنسجم فكرتي مع خطط التنمية في البحرين من خلال دعم وتطوير القطاع الرياضي والفئات السنية بشكل احترافي وممنهج. في المرحلة الأولى، سيتم تنفيذ المشروع داخل الأكاديميات كنموذج تجريبي تقني وتنظيمي يُعزز الكفاءة الإدارية والرياضية. أما في المرحلة الثانية، فسيتم توسيع المشروع بالشراكة مع وزارة التربية والتعليم، الهيئة العامة للرياضة، تمكين، البنوك الخاصة، والمراكز الصحية، لتكوين نظام وطني متكامل يُتابع تطور اللاعبين بدنيًا ونفسيًا، ويربط الأداء بالاحتياجات الفعلية للمنتخب الوطني والفئات السنية. سيساعد المشروع على تحديد المراكز الناقصة في المنتخبات والعمل على تغطيتها بتطوير المواهب المؤهلة، مما يخلق قاعدة بيانات شفافة تسهم في بناء جيل رياضي محترف مؤهل محليًا ودوليًا. كما سيتضمن البرنامج محاضرات توعوية وتثقيفية تُغرس في اللاعبين ثقافة الالتزام والاحتراف الداخلي، كتمهيد لتأهيلهم للاحتراف الخارجي مستقبلاً. هذه المبادرة تدعم رؤية البحرين 2030 في محور تنمية رأس المال البشري وتساهم في إعداد لاعبين قادرين على تمثيل المنتخب الوطني في بطولات كبرى مثل كأس العالم 2034 و2038 من خلال برنامج تنمية متكامل ومستدام
Inspiration: I was inspired to address this problem from my direct experience in the sports academy environment, where I noticed the daily challenges faced by coaches and administrators in tracking player performance and documenting attendance, in addition to the lack of effective communication with parents. I also found a clear gap in the use of technology within the sports sector compared to the significant developments in education and health fields. This disparity inspired me to provide a practical digital solution that supports academies and elevates the quality of sports work through intelligent tools that ensure accurate follow-up, enhance transparency in development, and pave the way for building a national database serving the future of Bahraini football. Original: استلهمت فكرة معالجة هذه المشكلة من تجربتي المباشرة في بيئة الأكاديميات الرياضية، حيث لاحظت التحديات اليومية التي يواجهها المدربون والإداريون في تتبع أداء اللاعبين وتوثيق حضورهم، إضافة إلى غياب التواصل الفعال مع أولياء الأمور. كما أنني وجدت فجوة واضحة في استخدام التكنولوجيا داخل القطاع الرياضي، مقارنةً بالتطورات الكبيرة في مجالات التعليم والصحة. هذا التفاوت ألهمني لتقديم حل رقمي عملي، يدعم الأكاديميات ويرتقي بجودة العمل الرياضي من خلال أدوات ذكية تضمن المتابعة الدقيقة، وتعزز من شفافية التطوير، وتمهّد لبناء قاعدة بيانات وطنية تخدم مستقبل الكرة البحرينية
Keywords: sports academy management, performance tracking, attendance system, player development, parent communication

Project: Malyoon
Problem: A lot of young people in Bahrain find it hard to manage their money. Whether it's figuring out how to save for a car, go to Hajj, or just keep track of monthly spending, it can all feel overwhelming. Financial advice is either too basic or way too complicated. Many don’t know where to start, and traditional tools don’t really speak their language or fit their lifestyle. Because of that, they often make decisions without understanding the long-term impact, which leads to stress and missed goals. Malyoon helps by making financial planning simple, personal, and genuinely useful for everyday Bahrainis.
Solution: Malyoon is a smart financial planning app built specifically for Bahrainis. It helps users simulate their financial goals based on real income and expenses, showing when and how they can reach them. Whether it's saving for a car, Hajj, or a future home, Malyoon provides clear, personalized guidance. It also answers what-if questions, offers financial tips, and helps users understand their spending through a dynamic income statement. Everything is presented in a simple, bilingual interface that makes money management feel approachable. By giving users control, clarity, and confidence, Malyoon turns financial stress into smart planning.
Impact: Malyoon supports Bahrain’s national development goals by promoting financial literacy, innovation, and youth empowerment. It aligns with Bahrain Economic Vision 2030 by encouraging private sector growth and helping individuals make informed financial decisions. As a bilingual and user-friendly platform, Malyoon contributes to the country’s digital transformation and financial inclusion while addressing the real financial planning needs of young Bahrainis in a simple and accessible way.
Inspiration: What inspired us to address this problem was seeing how many young Bahrainis, including ourselves, felt lost when it came to managing money. We noticed that financial tools on the market were either too advanced, too boring, or not efficient enough. After talking to friends and students, it became clear that many people wanted to save or plan for their future but didn’t know how or where to begin. That gap between good intentions and practical tools is what pushed us to build Malyoon. We wanted to create something that makes financial planning simple, personal, and empowering for our generation.
Keywords: financial planning app, goal simulation, spending analysis, bilingual interface, financial literacy

Project: Blue Falcon
Problem: Bahraini travel agencies often lack the space, materials, or funding to properly market their products and/or services long-term. With the large number of registered travel agencies in Bahrain, it is nearly impossible for smaller agencies to have equal footing with larger ones, and to scale and grow their businesses. At the same time, customers and travelers may find it difficult to adequately choose the correct travel agency due to a lack of trust or publicity, making it hard for both parties to benefit equally from each other.
Solution: Blue Falcon, a website and mobile application, is an eMarketplace for travel agencies, allowing for much easier access for consumers to book lower cost trips through Bahraini travel agencies. The purpose of the website and application is to bridge the divide between travel agencies and consumers, allowing consumers to browse through the many offers for travel, while giving agencies the opportunity to better market themselves, increasing their consumer reach and scope. This also allows smaller travel agencies to have a better chance at competing with larger ones, while also creating a trustworthy network of travel agencies to avoid customers getting scammed by fake or unlicensed travel agencies.
Impact: As part of the Bahrain 2030 vision, there is an emphasis placed on expanding on non-oil income, aside from the financial sector, where tourism is mentioned as a growing sector, with travel agencies contributing to the growth in tourism, whether external or internal.
Inspiration: Multiple testimonies from different people about the difficulty of choosing trusted travel agencies, and the unstreamlined process of booking and sending the appropriate documentation from both parties. Moreover, after reading a study by Smartscapers detailing Bahraini travel agencies, found 276 out of 476 travel agencies in Bahrain have little to no social media presence, relying mostly on word of mouth or minimal social media activity.
Keywords: travel agency marketplace, online booking, tourism marketing, agency consumer connection, trusted network

Project: جهز شنطتك
Problem: The problem facing the target segment: Many travelers, especially families, the elderly, and businessmen, suffer from difficulty in preparing their luggage in a timely manner before travel, or from the hassle of carrying and transporting it to the airport themselves. This pressure increases with early flight times, crowding, or if there is no comfortable means of transportation. Some travelers also face confusion in organizing their luggage, packing it, and ensuring it arrives safely without delay or hassle. These challenges create stress and affect the traveler's comfort, especially when traveling with children or on important trips. The "Jahhez Shanatak" project comes to solve this problem by providing a comprehensive service that ensures peace of mind, time, and effort, with an easy and premium travel experience from door to airport. Original: المشكلة التي تواجهها الشريحة المستهدفة: يعاني العديد من المسافرين، خاصة العائلات وكبار السن ورجال الأعمال، من صعوبة في تجهيز أمتعتهم في الوقت المناسب قبل السفر، أو من عناء حملها ونقلها إلى المطار بأنفسهم. هذا الضغط يزداد مع مواعيد السفر المبكرة، الزحام، أو في حال عدم توفر وسيلة نقل مريحة. كما أن بعض المسافرين يواجهون إرباكًا في تنظيم أمتعتهم، وتغليفها، وضمان وصولها بأمان دون تأخير أو إزعاج. هذه التحديات تخلّف توترًا وتؤثر على راحة المسافر، وتحديدًا عند السفر مع أطفال أو في رحلات مهمة. مشروع "جهّز شنطتك" يأتي ليحل هذه المشكلة بتقديم خدمة شاملة تضمن راحة البال، الوقت، والجهد، مع تجربة سفر سهلة وراقية من الباب إلى المطار.
Solution: The "Jahhez Shanatak" project offers an innovative solution through an integrated logistical service that starts with receiving the traveler's luggage from his home or place of residence, then preparing, organizing, and professionally packing it, and delivering it to the airport before the flight time. The solution relies on providing refrigerated vehicles (if necessary), a smart application for booking and tracking, and a trained team that ensures accuracy, safety, and speed of service. We also provide VIP packages that include distinctive sterilization and packaging, and sending instant notifications to the traveler. In this way, we save the customer time and effort, give them a smooth and comfortable travel experience, and build their trust in our services through quality and commitment. Original: يقدّم مشروع "جهّز شنطتك" حلاً مبتكرًا من خلال خدمة لوجستية متكاملة تبدأ من استلام أمتعة المسافر من منزله أو مكان إقامته، ثم تجهيزها وتنظيمها وتغليفها باحترافية، وتوصيلها إلى المطار قبل موعد الرحلة. يعتمد الحل على توفير مركبات مبرّدة (إن لزم)، وتطبيق ذكي للحجز والتتبع، وفريق مدرّب يضمن الدقة والأمان والسرعة في الخدمة. كما نوفر باقات VIP تشمل تعقيم وتغليف مميز، وإرسال إشعارات لحظية للمسافر. بهذه الطريقة نوفر على العميل الوقت والجهد، ونمنحه تجربة سفر سلسة ومريحة، ونبني ثقته في خدماتنا من خلال الجودة والالتزام.
Impact: The "Jahhez Shanatak" idea contributes to supporting economic and social development plans in the Kingdom of Bahrain through several main aspects. First, the project aligns with Bahrain's Economic Vision 2030, which focuses on improving quality of life, developing the services sector, and enhancing innovation in small and medium enterprises. The project also supports the logistics and tourism services sector, both of which are priority sectors in economic diversification plans. In addition, the project creates job opportunities for Bahraini youth in the fields of delivery, coordination, and customer service, contributing to reducing unemployment and supporting the local economy. The use of technology in providing the service (an app for booking and tracking) also enhances digital transformation and reflects the Kingdom's direction towards a smart and sustainable economy. Original: تساهم فكرة "جهّز شنطتك" في دعم خطط التنمية الاقتصادية والاجتماعية في مملكة البحرين من خلال عدة جوانب رئيسية. أولاً، يتماشى المشروع مع رؤية البحرين الاقتصادية 2030 التي تركز على تحسين جودة الحياة، وتطوير قطاع الخدمات، وتعزيز الابتكار في المشاريع الصغيرة والمتوسطة. كما يدعم المشروع قطاع الخدمات اللوجستية والسياحية، وهما من القطاعات ذات الأولوية في خطط التنويع الاقتصادي. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يخلق المشروع فرص عمل للشباب البحريني في مجالات التوصيل، التنسيق، وخدمة العملاء، مما يساهم في تقليل البطالة ودعم الاقتصاد المحلي. كما أن استخدام التكنولوجيا في تقديم الخدمة (تطبيق للحجز والتتبع) يعزز التحول الرقمي، ويعكس توجه المملكة نحو اقتصاد ذكي ومستدام.
Inspiration: I was inspired by the idea of "Jahhez Shanatak" from real situations that I and members of my family faced while traveling, where we had to wake up early and bear the pressure of preparing bags in a short time, especially with children or elderly people. I noticed that many travelers face the same suffering, despite the existence of advanced logistical solutions in other countries. I felt that the Bahraini market needs a premium service that cares about traveler comfort and gives them an easy and organized travel experience. I wanted to present a project that reflects the development of services in Bahrain, enhances the level of well-being, and is part of developing the travel, tourism, and smart services sector in the Kingdom. Original: استلهمت فكرة "جهّز شنطتك" من مواقف حقيقية واجهتها أنا وأفراد من عائلتي أثناء السفر، حيث كنا نضطر للاستيقاظ مبكرًا، وتحمل ضغط تجهيز الشنط في وقت ضيق، خاصة مع وجود أطفال أو كبار سن. لاحظت أن كثيرًا من المسافرين يواجهون نفس المعاناة، رغم وجود حلول لوجستية متطورة في دول أخرى. شعرت أن السوق البحريني بحاجة إلى خدمة راقية تهتم براحة المسافر وتمنحه تجربة سفر سهلة ومنظمة. أردت أن أقدّم مشروعًا يعكس تطور الخدمات في البحرين، ويعزز مستوى الرفاهية، ويكون جزءًا من تطوير قطاع السفر والسياحة والخدمات الذكية في المملكة.
Keywords: luggage delivery service, airport concierge, travel assistance, smart booking, door to airport

Project: رشة
Problem: Many families and owners of special occasions such as baby showers or weddings face difficulty in obtaining distinctive luxury perfumes suitable for the atmosphere of their occasions without needing to buy large quantities at high prices used only once. Some also look for a luxurious touch that adds value to the occasion, such as a perfume customized with the newborn's name or luxurious packaging, but the local market lacks services for renting luxury seasonal perfumes that are ready for temporary use and returned after use at a lower cost. This shortage leaves a gap in the hospitality and gifts experience and makes some occasions lose the element of distinction and the scent that remains in memory. Solution: Many families and hosts of special occasions, such as baby showers or weddings, face difficulty in obtaining distinctive luxury perfumes suitable for the atmosphere of their events without having to purchase large quantities at high prices that are used only once. Project: Dalleel
Problem: In Bahrain, finding reliable service providers, especially in hands-on fields such as electricians, nurses, tutors, mechanics, home chefs, house cleaners, plumbers, or even out-call doctors, remains a frustrating experience. People often depend on word of mouth, unverified Instagram pages, or scattered Google results, which can be stressful, time-consuming, and unreliable, especially during emergencies like a burst pipe. There is no centralized, trustworthy platform where customers can easily browse, compare, and book services with confidence. This creates confusion, leads to inconsistent quality, and makes it harder to support local businesses that lack a digital presence.
Solution: Dalleel is a mobile application designed to bring structure, trust, and convenience to the way people in Bahrain find everyday service providers. The app organizes services into clear categories such as home maintenance, healthcare, education, beauty, and auto care. Users can browse verified provider profiles, read honest customer reviews, and filter results by values like Bahraini-owned or women-led. All services are delivered directly to the customer’s location. Dalleel makes it easy to book trusted help quickly, while also giving small service providers a digital presence and better access to clients.
Impact: Dalleel directly supports Bahrain’s national development goals by promoting digital transformation, empowering freelancers and small local businesses, and improving access to essential services for citizens and residents. By creating a centralized digital platform for service providers, Dalleel helps Bahraini-owned and women-led ventures expand their visibility and grow sustainably. The platform contributes to job creation, strengthens the gig economy, and encourages the use of digital tools. This aligns with Bahrain’s vision of building a diversified, innovation-driven economy.
Inspiration: My inspiration came from personal experience. Every time I needed to fix something at home, I found myself lost with no clear guidance or reliable references. I had to rely on random Google searches or Instagram pages and book blindly, especially for services like plumbing, electrical work, or car repairs that don’t have a strong digital presence. I’ve also had moments where I was sick and living alone, too tired to go to the hospital, and didn’t know how to find or book an outcall doctor, something I used to see in movies and wish existed in real life. We live in an age where every luxury is one click away, so I asked myself, why can’t essential services be just as accessible?
Keywords: service provider marketplace, home services booking, verified provider profiles, gig economy, digital transformation

Project: Plint
Problem: In Bahrain, individuals who want to sell used items often face limited options. Existing platforms are cluttered, outdated, or lack trust and transparency. Sellers struggle to find serious buyers, and transactions often happen through unregulated chats or social media, which can lead to scams or wasted time. There’s no centralized, user-friendly app dedicated to connecting local buyers and sellers with verified profiles, clear listings, and easy communication. This creates friction in Bahrain’s second-hand market, especially for those wanting to sell quickly and safely. Our app solves this by offering a trusted platform for seamless listing, browsing, and negotiation all in one place.
Solution: Our app provides a simple, secure, and organized platform for users in Bahrain to buy and sell used items. Sellers can create listings in minutes with photos, prices, and item descriptions, while buyers can browse by category, location, or keyword. Verified user profiles, chat features, and optional delivery or meet-up options make transactions safer and more efficient. By centralizing listings and making the experience mobile-friendly and trustworthy, we eliminate the chaos of unregulated selling on social media, reduce scams, and help users save time and money. Our platform empowers everyday people to turn unused items into cash, while helping buyers find affordable deals locally.
Impact: Our app supports Bahrain’s Vision 2030 by promoting economic diversification, sustainability, and digital transformation. By creating a digital marketplace for second-hand goods, we contribute to a circular economy, reduce waste, and encourage responsible consumption, all of which align with Bahrain’s goals for environmental sustainability. The app also supports local entrepreneurship by giving individuals a platform to generate income through selling used items. Furthermore, it advances digital inclusion by offering a mobile-first solution that connects people across the Kingdom, enhancing access to services and boosting local commerce. Our business directly supports Bahrain’s transition to a knowledge-based, tech-driven economy.
Inspiration: Foreigner competition & domination in bahraini market and frustration selling stuff at a reasonable price
Keywords: second-hand marketplace, buying used items, selling used items, circular economy, local e-commerce
